analyzed: iha hi sukham me syāt duḥkham manāk api mā bhūt iti nikhila apekṣita mokṣasya bhagavat aparokṣa jñānam vinā anudayāt tasya ca śravaṇa ādi vinā yogāt tasya ca antar karaṇa śuddhim vinā yogāt tasyāḥ ca smṛti ādi ukta sat karma anuṣṭhānam vinā yogāt paramparayā mokṣa sādhanībhūta jñānāya smṛti ukta prakāreṇa sat karma anuṣṭhānam kartavyam iti prāptam sarvaiḥ

original: tadāha manuḥ -- vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ| taddhi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim|| śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhan hi mānavaḥ| iha kīrtimavāpnoti pretya cānuttamaṃ sukham|| iti ca| sadācāreṇa bhāvyamityatra vyāsaḥ -- vedādhyayanahīno'pi śraddadhāno jiteṃdriyaḥ| ācārayukto viprastu puṇyāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt|| iti|
analyzed: tat āha manuḥ veda uditam svakam karma nityam kuryāt atandritaḥ tat hi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramām gatim śruti smṛti uditam dharmam anutiṣṭhan hi mānavaḥ iha kīrtim avāpnoti pretya ca anuttamam sukham iti ca sat ācāreṇa bhāvyam iti atra vyāsaḥ veda adhyayana hīnaḥ api śraddadhānaḥ jita iṃdriyaḥ ācāra yuktaḥ vipraḥ tu puṇyām gatim avāpnuyāt iti

original: tadakaraṇe doṣamāha viṣṇuḥ -- śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca yatkiñcidvidhānaṃ sarvamādarāt| gṛhe nivasatāṃ kāryamanyathā doṣamṛcchati|| saṃvartaḥ -- sadācāreṇa devatvamṛṣitvaṃ ca tathaiva ca| prāpnuvanti kuyonitvaṃ mānuṣyaṃ tadviparyaye|| iti| gītāyāṃ -- yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ| na saḥ siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim||
analyzed: tad akaraṇe doṣam āha viṣṇuḥ śrautam smārtam ca yat kiñcid vidhānam sarvam ādarāt gṛhe nivasatām kāryam anyathā doṣam ṛcchati saṃvartaḥ sat ācāreṇa deva tvam ṛṣi tvam ca tathā eva ca prāpnuvanti ku yoni tvam mānuṣyam tad viparyaye iti gītāyām yaḥ śāstra vidhim utsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ na saḥ siddhim avāpnoti na sukham na parām gatim

original: vyāsaḥ -- nāstikyādathavālasyācchāstroktaṃ na karoti yaḥ| sa yāti narakān ghorān tiryagyoniṣu jāyate|| pramāṇasaṅgrahe -- śrutismṛtyuktamācāraṃ yastu nācarati dvijaḥ| sa pāṣaṇḍīti vijñeyaḥ sarvalokeṣu garhitaḥ|| iti| viṣṇupurāṇe'pi -- samullaṅghya sadācāraṃ kaścinnāpnoti śobhanam| ityāha bhagavānaurvo maitreyāya ca pṛcchate|| ityādi|
analyzed: vyāsaḥ nāstikyāt athavā ālasyāt śāstra uktam na karoti yaḥ sa yāti narakān ghorān tiryagyoniṣu jāyate pramāṇasaṅgrahe śruti smṛti uktam ācāram yaḥ tu na ācarati dvijaḥ sa pāṣaṇḍī iti vijñeyaḥ sarva lokeṣu garhitaḥ iti viṣṇupurāṇe api samullaṅghya sat ācāram kaścid na āpnoti śobhanam iti āha bhagavān aurvaḥ maitreyāya ca pṛcchate ityādi

original: tasmāt smṛtyādyuktaprakāreṇa karmāṇyanuṣṭheyānīti siddham|
analyzed: tasmāt smṛti ādi ukta prakāreṇa karmāṇi anuṣṭheyāni iti siddham

original: tāni ca karmāṇi niṣkāmena viṣṇuprītyarthaṃ kṛtāni svagatiheturityatra pramāṇāni| niṣkāmaḥ phalāntarābhisandhirahitaḥ| yajñavalkyaḥ -- varṇāśramoktaṃ yaḥ kuryād vidhyuktaṃ kāmavarjitaḥ| vidhivat kurvatastasya muktirgārgi kare sthitā||
analyzed: tāni ca karmāṇi niṣkāmena viṣṇu prīti artham kṛtāni sva gati hetuḥ iti atra pramāṇāni niṣkāmaḥ phala antara abhisandhi rahitaḥ yajñavalkyaḥ varṇa āśrama uktam yaḥ kuryāt vidhi uktam kāma varjitaḥ vidhivat kurvataḥ tasya muktiḥ gārgi kare sthitā

original: caturṇāmapi varṇānāmahanyahani ni yaśaḥ| vidhyuktaṃ karma kartavyaṃ kāmasaṃkalpavarjitam|| iti| kāmanāpūrvakatve doṣastatraivoktaḥ -- varṇāśramoktaṃ karmaiva vidhyuktaṃgoṣṭhipūrvakam (kāmapūrvakam)| yena yatra kriyate gārgi bandhastasya kare sthitaḥ|| ityādi| hariprītyarthaṃ kartavyānītyatra "nānyo vimuktaye panthā uktāśramavidhiḥ sukham|
analyzed: caturṇām api varṇānām ahani ahani yaśaḥ vidhi uktam karma kartavyam kāma saṃkalpa varjitam iti kāmanā pūrvaka tve doṣaḥ tatra eva uktaḥ varṇa āśrama uktam karma eva vidhi uktam goṣṭhi pūrvakam kāma pūrvakam yena yatra kriyate gārgi bandhaḥ tasya kare sthitaḥ ityādi hari prīti artham kartavyāni iti atra na anyaḥ vimuktaye panthāḥ ukta āśrama vidhiḥ sukham

original: tasmāt karmāṇi kurvīta tuṣṭaye paramātmanaḥ||" iti vyāsaḥ| vāyupurāṇe'pi -- dehināṃ svāḥ pravartante prātarārabhya yāḥ kriyāḥ| tāśca viṣṇavarpaṇaṃ kurvan karmapāśaiḥ pramucyate|| gītāyāṃ -- yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam| svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ|| iti| `kāyena vācā manasendriyairi'tyādi bhāgavate||
analyzed: tasmāt karmāṇi kurvīta tuṣṭaye paramātmanaḥ iti vyāsaḥ vāyupurāṇe pi dehinām svāḥ pravartante prātar ārabhya yāḥ kriyāḥ tāḥ ca viṣṇo arpaṇam kurvan karma pāśaiḥ pramucyate gītāyām yatas pravṛttiḥ bhūtānām yena sarvam idam tatam sva karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhim vindati mānavaḥ iti kāyena vācā manasā indriyaiḥ ityādi bhāgavate

original: hārītaḥ -- tasmād dāsyaṃ parāṃ bhaktimālambya nṛpasattam| nityaṃ naimittikaṃ karma kuryāt prītyai hareḥ sadā|| dānaṃ tapaśca yajñaśca trividhaṃ karma kīrtitam| tatsarvaṃbhagavatprītyai kurvīta susamāhitaḥ|| śāṇḍilyaḥ -- pravṛttaiśca nivṛttaiśca svargadairmokṣadairapi| ārādhyo bhagavāneva vedadharmaiḥ sanātanaiḥ|| iti|
analyzed: hārītaḥ tasmāt dāsyam parām bhaktim ālambya nṛpa sattam nityam naimittikam karma kuryāt prītyai hareḥ sadā dānam tapaḥ ca yajñaḥ ca trividham karma kīrtitam tat sarvam bhagavat prītyai kurvīta su samāhitaḥ śāṇḍilyaḥ pravṛttaiḥ ca nivṛttaiḥ ca svarga daiḥ mokṣa daiḥ api ārādhyaḥ bhagavān eva veda dharmaiḥ sanātanaiḥ iti

original: sa eva sarvathopāsyo nānyaḥ saṃsāratārakaḥ| ubhābhyāṃ jñānakarmabhyāmārādhyo bhagavān prabhuḥ|| iti| aurvaḥ -- brahmacārīgṛhasthaśca bhikṣurvaikhānasastathā| kurvāṇā nijakarmāṇi viṣṇumeva yajanti te|| agnikāryaṃ japaṃ snānaṃ tapaḥ svādhyāyameva ca| tamevoddiśya deveśaṃ kuru nityamatandritaḥ|| hārītaḥ -- tameva cārcayennityaṃ namaskuryāt tameva hi|
analyzed: saḥ eva sarvathā upāsyaḥ na anyaḥ saṃsāra tārakaḥ ubhābhyām jñāna karmabhyām ārādhyaḥ bhagavān prabhuḥ iti aurvaḥ brahmacārī gṛhasthaḥ ca bhikṣuḥ vaikhānasaḥ tathā kurvāṇāḥ nija karmāṇi viṣṇum eva yajanti te agni kāryam japam snānam tapaḥ svādhyāyam eva ca tam eva uddiśya deveśam kuru nityam atandritaḥ hārītaḥ tam eva ca arcayet nityam namaskuryāt tam eva hi

original: dhyātvā japet tameveśaṃ tamevādhyāpayecchutim|| vratopavāsaniyamāṃstamevoddiśya kārayet| tatsamarpitabhogī syādannapānādibhakṣaṇaiḥ|| ratiḥ svārthasvadāreṣu netaratra kadācana|| iti|| viṣṇupurāṇe'pi -- varṇāśramācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān| viṣṇurārādhyate panthā nānyastattoṣakārakaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: dhyātvā japet tam eva īśam tam eva adhyāpayet śutim vrata upavāsa niyamān tam eva uddiśya kārayet tad samarpita bhogī syāt anna pāna ādi bhakṣaṇaiḥ ratiḥ sva artha sva dāreṣu na itaratra kadācana iti viṣṇupurāṇe api varṇa āśrama ācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān viṣṇuḥ ārādhyate panthāḥ na anyaḥ tad toṣa kārakaḥ iti

original: vāyupurāṇe'pi -- sevārthaṃ bhagavān viṣṇurdeśaṃ kālaṃ ca yāḥ kriyāḥ| sṛṣṭavān bhagavānādau tasmāt paricare'niśam|| iti saṃkalpya cotthāya sarvakarma samārabhet| viṣṇorarthe kariṣyāmi cāharāmi dadāmi ca|| nātmārthamiti vai kvāpi vadet karmakaro naraḥ|| iti| gītāyāṃ -- yat karoṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat|
analyzed: vāyupurāṇe api sevā artham bhagavān viṣṇuḥ deśam kālam ca yāḥ kriyāḥ sṛṣṭavān bhagavān ādau tasmāt paricare niśam iti saṃkalpya ca utthāya sarva karma samārabhet viṣṇoḥ arthe kariṣyāmi ca āharāmi dadāmi ca na ātma artham iti vai kvāpi vadet karma karaḥ naraḥ iti gītāyām yat karoṣi yat aśnāsi yat juhoṣi dadāsi yat

original: yat tapasyasi kaunteya! tat kuruṣva madarpaṇam|| iti| `naiṣkarmyamapyacyutabhāvavarjitami'tyādi bhāgavate| `yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāmi'ti ca gītāyām, `mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sanyasyādhyātmacetase'tyādi ca| `akṣayaṃ karma yasmin para' iti, `yasmin sarvāṇi karmāṇi' ityādyata evaitadabhiprāyeṇoktamācāryaiḥ sadācārasmṛtyādau||
analyzed: yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣva mad arpaṇam iti naiṣkarmyam api acyuta bhāva varjitam ityādi bhāgavate yatas pravṛttiḥ bhūtānām iti ca gītāyām mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi san yasya adhyātma cetasā ityādi ca akṣayam karma yasmin paraḥ iti yasmin sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityādi atas eva etat abhiprāyeṇa uktam ācāryaiḥ sat ācāra smṛti ādau

original: kṛṣṇāmṛtamahārṇave ca -- pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam| tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ puruṣaḥ sarvamūrtiḥ sa ijyate|| ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirmārgaiḥ pravṛttairijyate hyāsau| yajñeśvaro yajñapumān puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ|| jñānātmā jñānayogena jñānamūrtiḥ sa ijyate| nivṛtte yogibhirmārge viṣṇurmuktiphalapradaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: kṛṣṇa amṛta mahā arṇave ca pravṛttam ca nivṛttam ca dvividham karma vaidikam tābhyām ubhābhyām puruṣaḥ sarva mūrtiḥ saḥ ijyate ṛk yajuḥ sāmabhiḥ mārgaiḥ pravṛttaiḥ ijyate hi asau yajñeśvaraḥ yajña pumān puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ jñāna ātmā jñāna yogena jñāna mūrtiḥ saḥ ijyate nivṛtte yogibhiḥ mārge viṣṇuḥ mukti phala pradaḥ iti

original: taduddeśenākaraṇe pratyavāyamāha hārītaḥ -- bhagavantamanuddiśya yaḥ karma kurute naraḥ| sa pāṣaṇḍīti vijñeyaḥ sarvalokeṣu garhitaḥ|| aśvamedhaśatairiṣṭvā vājapeyaśatairapi| na prāpnuvanti sugatiṃ nārāyaṇaparāṅmukhāḥ|| iti| vāyupurāṇe'pi -- anuṣṭhātā tapasvī vā sarvadharmaparo'pi vā| vinā tadarpaṇaṃ samyak phalaṃ nāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: tad uddeśena akaraṇe pratyavāyam āha hārītaḥ bhagavantam an uddiśya yaḥ karma kurute naraḥ sa pāṣaṇḍī iti vijñeyaḥ sarva lokeṣu garhitaḥ aśvamedha śataiḥ iṣṭvā vājapeya śataiḥ api na prāpnuvanti sugatim nārāyaṇa parāṅmukhāḥ iti vāyupurāṇe api anuṣṭhātā tapasvī vā sarva dharma paraḥ api vā vinā tad arpaṇam samyak phalam na āpnoti asaṃśayaḥ iti

original: gāruḍe'pi -- vedoktaṃ yāgahomādi keśavoddeśataḥ kṛtam| dharmamāhuradharmastu sa eva harivipriyaḥ|| tatraivānyatra -- yajñādīni ca karmāṇi yāni vedoditāni vai| devatāyai parāyai taditi matvā kṛtāni ca|| bhaveyustāni bhadrāṇi no cenmoghaphalāni hi|| iti| bhāgavate ca -- tapasvino dānaparāyaśasvino manasvino mantravidaḥ sumaṅgalāḥ|
analyzed: gāruḍe api veda uktam yāga homa ādi keśava uddeśataḥ kṛtam dharmam āhuḥ adharmaḥ tu saḥ eva hari vipriyaḥ tatra eva anyatra yajña ādīni ca karmāṇi yāni veda uditāni vai devatāyai parāyai tat iti matvā kṛtāni ca bhaveyuḥ tāni bhadrāṇi no ced mogha phalāni hi iti bhāgavate ca tapasvinaḥ dāna para ayaśasvinaḥ manasvinaḥ mantra vidaḥ su maṅgalāḥ

original: kṣemaṃ vindanti vinā yadarpaṇaṃ tasmai subhadraśravase namo namaḥ|| iti śukastutau| ityādi| granthagauravabhayāduparamyate| evaṃ karmāṇi viṣṇuprītyarthaṃ kṛtāni pūrvoktadiśā mokṣaphalakāni|| tadāha gītābhāṣye -- nivṛttādīni karmāṇi hyaparokṣeśadṛṣṭaye| aparokṣeśadṛṣṭistu muktyai kiṃcinna mārgate||
analyzed: kṣemam vindanti vinā yad arpaṇam tasmai su bhadraśravase namaḥ namaḥ iti śuka stutau ityādi grantha gaurava bhayāt uparamyate evam karmāṇi viṣṇu prīti artham kṛtāni pūrva ukta diśā mokṣa phalakāni tat āha gītā bhāṣye nivṛtta ādīni karmāṇi hi aparokṣa īśa dṛṣṭaye aparokṣa īśa dṛṣṭiḥ tu muktyai kiṃcid na mārgate

original: sarvaṃ tāma(tada)ntarādhāya muktaye sādhanaṃ bhavet|| gītāyāṃ ca -- `sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate', `karmaṇā jñānamātanoti jñānenāmṛtībhavatī'tyādeḥ| tasmād mokṣasādhanībhūtajñānāya viṣṇuprītyarthaṃ karmāṇi kartavyānīti siddham|
analyzed: sarvam tāmata dantar ādhāya muktaye sādhanam bhavet gītāyām ca sarvam karma akhilam pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate karmaṇā jñānam ātanoti jñānena amṛtībhavati ityādeḥ tasmāt mokṣa sādhanībhūta jñānāya viṣṇu prīti artham karmāṇi kartavyāni iti siddham

original: nanvevaṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ viṣṇuprītiphalakatve jyotiṣṭomacitrayāgādeḥ svargapaśvādiphalakatvaṃ na syāt| anyahetoranyaphalakatvābhāvāditi ced, ucyate| jyotiṣṭomādikarmaṇāṃ svargādiphalakatve'pi tatsādhanatvena hariprīteravāṃtaravyāpāratvena vyāpāraphalabhāvāpannobhayakāryajanakatve virodhābhāvāt|

original: viṣṇorindrādiprātipadikārthatvaṃ, ca `yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva', `nāmāni sarvāṇi yamāviśantī'tyādiśrutyā `mukhyataḥ sarvaśabdaiśca vācya eko janārdana' ityādyācāryavacanena cāvagamyate| yadvā, aṅgāṅgibhāvāpannatvenopapattiḥ `devatāḥ kañcukāyanta' ityādeḥ| taṃtrabhāgavate ca -- karmaṇā nirapekṣeṇa viṣṇāvevārpitena ca|
analyzed: viṣṇoḥ indra ādi prātipadika artha tvam ca yaḥ devānām nāmadhāḥ ekaḥ eva nāmāni sarvāṇi yam āviśanti ityādi śrutyā mukhyatas sarva śabdaiḥ ca vācyaḥ ekaḥ janārdanaḥ ityādi ācārya vacanena ca avagamyate yat vā aṅga aṅgibhāva āpanna tvena upapattiḥ devatāḥ kañcukāyante ityādeḥ taṃtra bhāgavate ca karmaṇā nirapekṣeṇa viṣṇau eva arpitena ca

original: samyag jñānaṃ bhavet puṃsāṃ devatātṛptipūrvakam|| nirdeśād bhagavatyeva tṛptāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ| tadaṅgatvena nirdeśāt teṣu tṛptiṃ vrajanti te|| tṛpteṣu teṣu deveśe viṣṇau cotpadyate param| jñānaṃ tenaiva samyaktvaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanāt|| iti| bhāgavate'pi -- trayyā ca vidyayā kecit tvāṃ vai vaitānikā dvijāḥ|
analyzed: samyak jñānam bhavet puṃsām devatā tṛpti pūrvakam nirdeśāt bhagavati eva tṛptāḥ syuḥ sarva devatāḥ tad aṅga tvena nirdeśāt teṣu tṛptim vrajanti te tṛpteṣu teṣu deveśe viṣṇau ca utpadyate param jñānam tena eva samyaktvam mokṣyase karma bandhanāt iti bhāgavate pi trayyā ca vidyayā kecid tvām vai vaitānikāḥ dvijāḥ

original: yajante vividhairyajñairnānārūpāmarākhyayā|| iti| brāhmapurāṇe'pi -- dattaṃ yuṣmanmukhādbhuṅkte haviḥ svargepsubhirhariḥ| mumukṣubhistathā bhuṅkte svayameva janārdanaḥ|| phaladātā hi sarveṣāṃ sa eva paramaḥ pumān| na cānyaḥ karmaṇāṃ bhoktā phalado vāpi kaścana|| svātaṃtryāt kurvate ye tu karma vedoditaṃ mahat|
analyzed: yajante vividhaiḥ yajñaiḥ nānā rūpa amara ākhyayā iti brāhmapurāṇe pi dattam yuṣmad mukhāt bhuṅkte haviḥ svarga īpsubhiḥ hariḥ mumukṣubhiḥ tathā bhuṅkte svayam eva janārdanaḥ phala dātā hi sarveṣām saḥ eva paramaḥ pumān na ca anyaḥ karmaṇām bhoktā phala daḥ vā api kaścana svātaṃtryāt kurvate ye tu karma veda uditam mahat

original: vinā vai bhagavatprītyā te vai pāṣaṇḍinaḥ smṛtā|| samastayajñabhoktāramaviditvācyutaṃ harim| uddiśya devatā yaśca juhoti ca dadāti ca|| sa pāṣaṇḍīti vijñeyaḥ svatantro vāpi karmasu|| iti| tasmāt purandarādiviśiṣṭasya viṣṇorindrādipadārthatvāt tasya sarvakarmoddeśyatā nānupapanneti siddham|
analyzed: vinā vai bhagavat prītyā te vai pāṣaṇḍinaḥ smṛtā samasta yajña bhoktāram a viditvā acyutam harim uddiśya devatāḥ yaḥ ca juhoti ca dadāti ca sa pāṣaṇḍī iti vijñeyaḥ svatantraḥ vā api karmasu iti tasmāt purandara ādi viśiṣṭasya viṣṇoḥ indra ādi padārtha tvāt tasya sarva karma uddeśya tā na anupapannā iti siddham

original: na ca teṣāṃ tattvajñānitve vivādaḥ| `na devapadavīṃ prāptā brahmadarśanavarjitā' ityādigītātātparyoktasmṛteḥ| devatānāmapi pumarthitvādeḥ sattvena karmādhikārasya devatādhikaraṇe `taduparyapi bādarāyaṇaḥ sambhavād' ityādibhāṣyādau samyagabhidhānāt| śrutiṣu bahuśo devānāṃ karmādhikāritvasya darśanācca|

original: tathāhi -- `yajñenayajñamayajanta devā' iti, `devā vai satramāsate'ti, `devā vai yajñamatanvate'ti, `devā vai caturhotṛbhiryajñamatanvate'ti, `yadviśvedevāḥ samayajante'ti, `indro'śvamedhān śatamiṣṭavāni'ti, devā va varuṇamayājayanni'tyādiśruteśca| tatastu devatāḥ sarvā brahmā caiva maharṣayaḥ| vedadṛṣṭena vidhinā vaiṣṇavaṃ kratumāharan||

original: ityādi(smṛteśca) na ca jñānottarakarmaṇāṃ phalābhāvena vaiyarthyam| tathāpi `yathā yathā karma kurute tathā tathādhiko bhavatīti kauṇvaravyaśrutau, jñānenaivāpyate sarvaṃ karmaṇā cādhikaṃ bhavet| jñānināmapi devānāṃ viśeṣaḥ karmabhirbhavet|| ityādibhāṣyoktasmṛtau cānandavṛdhyādestatphala(tvāt? tvakathanāt)|

original: na ca tatra mānābhāvaḥ, `saiṣānandasya mīmāṃsetyādi śruteḥ| nṛpādyāḥ śatadhṛtyantā muktigā uttarottaram| guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ śataguṇā modante iti hi śrutiḥ|| iti pādme|' `muktānāmapi siddhānāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ| sudurlabhaḥ praśāntātme'tyādinā bhāgavatādau ca tathokteḥ| vistarabhayād na likhyate|

original: athaitadgranthapratipādyadharme setihāsapurāṇapañcarātrasaṃhitānāṃ manvādipraṇītaśāstrāṇāmeva pramāṇatvādupayogitayā tatpraṇetāraḥ tāni ca purāṇāni (tāśca saṃhitāḥ?) prathamaṃ nirūpyante| tatra yājñavalkyaḥ -- manvatriviṣṇuhārītayājñavalkyośanoṅgirāḥ| yamāpastambasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī|| parāśaravyāsaśaṅkhalikhitā dakṣagautamau|

original: śātātapo vasiṣṭhaśca dharmaśāstrapravartakāḥ (prayojakāḥ)|| iti| paiṭhīnasiḥ -- teṣāṃ manvaṅgirovyāsagautamātryuśanoyamāḥ| vasiṣṭhadakṣasaṃvartaśātātapaparāśarāḥ|| viṣṇvāpastambahārītāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kātyāyano guruḥ| pracetā nārado yogī bodhāyanapitāmahau|| sumantuḥ kāśyapo babhruḥ paiṭhīno vyāghra eva ca| satyavrato bharadvājo gārgiḥ kārṣṇājinistathā||
analyzed: śātātapaḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ ca dharma śāstra pravartakāḥ prayojakāḥ iti paiṭhīnasiḥ teṣām manu aṅgiraḥ vyāsa gautama atri uśanaḥ yamāḥ vasiṣṭha dakṣa saṃvarta śātātapa parāśarāḥ viṣṇu āpastamba hārītāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kātyāyanaḥ guruḥ pracetāḥ nāradaḥ yogī bodhāyana pitāmahau sumantuḥ kāśyapaḥ babhruḥ paiṭhīnaḥ vyāghraḥ eva ca satyavrataḥ bharadvājaḥ gārgiḥ kārṣṇājiniḥ tathā

original: vyāsaḥ kātyāyanaścaiva jātūkarṇyaḥ kapiñjalaḥ| bodhāyanaḥ kaṇādaśca viśvāmitrastathaiva ca|| paiṭhīnasirgobhilaśca upasmṛtividhāyakāḥ|| iti| purāṇāni ca pādmapurāṇe parigaṇitāni -- brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā| tathānyannāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyaṃ tu saptamam|| āgneyamaṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ navamaṃ smṛtam|
analyzed: vyāsaḥ kātyāyanaḥ ca eva jātūkarṇyaḥ kapiñjalaḥ bodhāyanaḥ kaṇādaḥ ca viśvāmitraḥ tathā eva ca paiṭhīnasiḥ gobhilaḥ ca upasmṛti vidhāyakāḥ iti purāṇāni ca pādma purāṇe parigaṇitāni brāhmam pādmam vaiṣṇavam ca śaivam bhāgavatam tathā tathā anyat nāradīyam ca mārkaṇḍeyam tu saptamam āgneyam aṣṭamam proktam bhaviṣyam navamam smṛtam

original: daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgamekādaśaṃ smṛtam|| dvādaśaṃ vāmanaṃ proktaṃ vārāhaṃ tu trayodaśam| mātsyaṃ caturdaśaṃ proktaṃ kaurmaṃ pañcadaśaṃ smṛtam|| ṣoḍaśaṃ gāruḍaṃ proktaṃ skāndaṃ saptadaśaṃ smṛtam| aṣṭadaśaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇāni yathākramam|| iti| vāyavyaṃ bhārgavaṃ somaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ kauśikaṃ tathā|

original: mātsyaṃ kaurmaṃ tathā laiṅgaṃ śaivaṃ skāndaṃ tathaiva ca|| āgneyaṃ ca ṣaḍetāni tāmasāni nibodha me| sātvikā mokṣadāḥ proktā rājasāḥ svargadāḥ śubhāḥ|| tathaiva tāmasā devi nirayaprāptihetavaḥ|| iti| evaṃ smṛtayo'pi tatraivoktāḥ -- tathaiva smṛtayaḥ proktā ṛṣibhistriguṇānvitaiḥ| sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasāḥ śubhadarśane!||

original: tāmasānāṃ tyājyatvamuktaṃ tatraiva -- kimatra bahunoktena purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi| tāmasā narakāyaiva varjayet tānvicakṣaṇaḥ|| iti| nanu tāmasasmṛtipurāṇānāmagrāhyatve kathaṃ tatroktavacanānāṃ sammatitvenodāharaṇam| na ca `skānde'pyuktaṃ śivenaiva ṣaṇmukhāyaiva sādaram| śivaśāstre'pi tad grāhyaṃ bhagavacchāstrayogi yat||

original: eṣāṃ yanna virodhi syāttatroktaṃ tannavāryata' iti tātparyanirṇaye tāmaseṣvapyavirodhyaṃśasya grāhyatvamuktamiti vācyam| uktavacanena tāmaseṣu bhagavacchāstrāvirodhyaṃśasya grāhyatve'pyanuṣṭheyakarmabhāgaparavacanānāṃ grāhyatā na syāt| anugrāhakābhāvāditi ceducyate| tāmaseṣu sāttvikabhāgasya sāttvikaśāstrānusāritvena svīkaraṇīyatvāt|

original: sa dharmo yaṃ vigarhante tamadharmaṃ pracakṣate|| iti| atra viśeṣato dharmānāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- deśe kāla upāyena dravyaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam| pātre pradīyate yattat sakalaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| iti| vedoktaḥ prathamo dharmo dharmaśāstreṇa cāparaḥ| śiṣṭācārastṛtīyastu trividhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| iti|
analyzed: sa dharmaḥ yam vigarhante tam adharmam pracakṣate iti atra viśeṣataḥ dharmān āha yājñavalkyaḥ deśe kāle upāyena dravyam śraddhā samanvitam pātre pradīyate yat tat sakalam dharma lakṣaṇam iti veda uktaḥ prathamaḥ dharmaḥ dharma śāstreṇa ca aparaḥ śiṣṭa ācāraḥ tṛtīyaḥ tu trividham dharma lakṣaṇam iti

original: smṛtyantare'pi -- śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ mārge dvijocchiṣṭāvamārjanam| vedamārgānusaraṇaṃ trividhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| iti| skande'pi satyā vāṇī prapādānaṃ jāgaraṃ harivāsare| pālanaṃ poṣyavargasya dharmasāracatuṣṭayam|| iti| nissve dānaṃ kriyā viṣṇorniṣiddhasya ca varjanam| satkāraḥ sādhuvṛttānāṃ dharmaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ||
analyzed: smṛti antare api śrānta saṃvāhanam mārge dvija ucchiṣṭa avamārjanam veda mārga anusaraṇam trividham dharma lakṣaṇam iti skande pi satyā vāṇī prapā dānam jāgaram harivāsare pālanam poṣya vargasya dharma sāra catuṣṭayam iti nissve dānam kriyā viṣṇoḥ niṣiddhasya ca varjanam satkāraḥ sādhu vṛttānām dharmaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: śayyādānaṃ ratirdharme mahābhāratakīrtanam| caritaṃ raghunāthasya mahāpātakanāśanam|| iti| dhātrīsnānaṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ vedābhyāso hareḥ kathā| bhikṣāśanaṃ guroḥ pūjā ṣaṅ‌vidhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| smṛtyantare -- dānaṃ pātre matiḥ kṛṣṇe mātāpitrostu pūjanam| premṇā vāṇī gavā grāsaḥ ṣaṅ‌vidhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam||
analyzed: śayyā dānam ratiḥ dharme mahābhārata kīrtanam caritam raghunāthasya mahāpātaka nāśanam iti dhātrī snānam hitam vākyam veda abhyāsaḥ hareḥ kathā bhikṣā aśanam guroḥ pūjā ṣaṅvidham dharma lakṣaṇam smṛti antare dānam pātre matiḥ kṛṣṇe mātā pitroḥ tu pūjanam premṇā vāṇī gavā grāsaḥ ṣaṅvidham dharma lakṣaṇam

original: yājñavalkyaḥ -- dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo'steyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ| hrīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| iti| dhṛtiḥ dhairyam| aparādhe'pi cittasyāvikāraḥ kṣamā| manaḥsaṃyamo damaḥ| asteyamadattāsvīkāraḥ| śaucaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ ca| indriyanigrahaḥ niṣiddhebhya indriyāṇāṃ nivāraṇam| hrīrakāryanivṛttiḥ| vidyā ātmajñānam|
analyzed: yājñavalkyaḥ dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damaḥ usteyam śaucam indriya nigrahaḥ hrīḥ vidyā satyam akrodhaḥ daśakam dharma lakṣaṇam iti dhṛtiḥ dhairyam aparādhe pi cittasya avikāraḥ kṣamā manaḥ saṃyamaḥ damaḥ asteyam adatta asvīkāraḥ śaucam bāhyam ābhyantaram ca indriya nigrahaḥ niṣiddhebhyaḥ indriyāṇām nivāraṇam hrīḥ akārya nivṛttiḥ vidyā ātma jñānam

original: satyaṃ yathārthavacanam| tacca priyameva veditavyam| tathāca manuḥ -- satyaṃ brūyāt priyaṃ brūyānna brūyāt satyamapriyam| priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ|| iti| akrodhaḥ koparāhityam| etaddaśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| bṛhaspatirdharmāntarāṇyāha -- dayā kṣamānasūyā ca śaucanāyāsamaṅgalam|

original: akārpaṇyaṃ cāspṛhatvaṃ sarvasādhāraṇāni tu|| teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ sa evāha -- pare vā bandhuvarge vā mitre dveṣṭari vā sadā| āpanno rakṣitavyo yaddayaiṣā parikīrtitā|| bāhye cādhyātmike caiva duḥkhe cotpatite kvacit| na kupyati na vā hanti sā kṣamā parikīrtitā|| na guṇān guṇino hanti stauti mandaguṇānapi| nānyadoṣeṣu ramate sānasūyā prakīrtitā|
analyzed: akārpaṇyam ca aspṛha tvam sarva sādhāraṇāni tu teṣām svarūpam saḥ eva āha pare vā bandhu varge vā mitre dveṣṭari vā sadā āpannaḥ rakṣitavyaḥ yat dayā eṣā parikīrtitā bāhye ca ādhyātmike ca eva duḥkhe ca utpatite kvacid na kupyati na vā hanti sā kṣamā parikīrtitā na guṇān guṇinaḥ hanti stauti manda guṇān api na anya doṣeṣu ramate sā anasūyā prakīrtitā

original: abhakṣyaparihāraśca saṃsargaścāpyaninditaiḥ| svadharme ca vyavasthānaṃ śaucametatprakīrtitam|| śarīraṃ pīiyate yenasuśubhenāpi karmaṇā| atyantaṃ tanna kartavyamanāyāsaḥ sa ucyate|| praśastācaraṇaṃ nityamapraśastavivarjanam| etaddhi maṅgalaṃ proktamṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ|| stokādapi pradātavyaṃ na dīnenāntarātmanā|

original: ahanyahani yatkiñcidakārpaṇyaṃ hi tat smṛtam|| iti| yathotpannena santoṣaḥ kartavyo hyalpavastuni| parasyācintayitvārthaṃ sāspṛhā parikīrtitā|| iti||

original: atha dharmabhedāḥ| mahābhārate -- dharmo bahuvidho loke śrutibhedamukhodbhavaḥ| deśadharmāśca dṛśyante kuladharmāstathaiva ca|| jātidharmā vayodharmā guṇadharmāśca śobhane! śarīrakāladharmāśca āpaddharmāstathaiva ca|| etaddharmasya nānātvaṃ kriyate lokavāsibhiḥ|| iti| sumanturapi -- varṇatvamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate|
analyzed: atha dharma bhedāḥ mahābhārate dharmaḥ bahuvidhaḥ loke śruti bheda mukha udbhavaḥ deśa dharmāḥ ca dṛśyante kula dharmāḥ tathā eva ca jāti dharmāḥ vayaḥ dharmāḥ guṇa dharmāḥ ca śobhane śarīra kāla dharmāḥ ca āpad dharmāḥ tathā eva ca etad dharmasya nānātvam kriyate loka vāsibhiḥ iti sumantuḥ api varṇa tvam ekam āśritya yaḥ dharmaḥ saṃpravartate

original: varṇadharmaḥ sa uktastu yathopanayanāt kila|| yastvāśramatvamāśritya adhikāraḥ pravartate| sa evāśramadharmaḥ syād bhikṣādiścodito yathā|| varṇatvamāśramatvaṃ ca yo'dhikṛtya pravartate| sa varṇāśramadharmastu yathā mauñjī ca mekhalā|| yo guṇena pravarteta guṇadharmaḥ sa ucyate| yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ paripālanam||
analyzed: varṇa dharmaḥ saḥ uktaḥ tu yathā upanayanāt kila yaḥ tu āśrama tvam āśritya adhikāraḥ pravartate saḥ eva āśrama dharmaḥ syāt bhikṣā ādiḥ coditaḥ yathā varṇa tvam āśrama tvam ca yaḥ adhikṛtya pravartate sa varṇa āśrama dharmaḥ tu yathā mauñjī ca mekhalā yaḥ guṇena pravarteta guṇa dharmaḥ saḥ ucyate yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānām paripālanam

original: nimittamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ sampravartate| naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā|| iti| iti dharmalakṣaṇam||
analyzed: nimittam ekam āśritya yaḥ dharmaḥ sampravartate naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścitta vidhiḥ yathā iti iti dharma lakṣaṇam

original: dharme pramāṇāni
analyzed: dharme pramāṇāni

original: atha dharme pramāṇāni| tatra yājñavalkyaḥ -- purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrāṅgamiśritāḥ| vedāḥ sthānāni vidyānāṃ dharmasya ca caturdaśa|| iti| aparārke -- āyurvedo dhanurvedo gāndharvaśceti te trayaḥ| arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ tu vidyā hyaṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ|| iti| yājñavalkyaḥ -- śrutismṛtī sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyamātmanaḥ|
analyzed: atha dharme pramāṇāni tatra yājñavalkyaḥ purāṇa nyāya mīmāṃsā dharma śāstra aṅga miśritāḥ vedāḥ sthānāni vidyānām dharmasya ca caturdaśa iti apara arke āyurvedaḥ dhanurvedaḥ gāndharvaḥ ca iti te trayaḥ arthaśāstram caturtham tu vidyāḥ hi aṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ iti yājñavalkyaḥ śruti smṛtī sat ācāraḥ svasya ca priyam ātmanaḥ

original: samyak saṅkalpajaḥ kāmo dharmamūlamidaṃ smṛtam|| iti| manuḥ -- vdo'khilo dharmamūlaṃ smṛtiśīle ca tadvidām| ācāraścaiva sādhūnāmātmanastuṣṭireva ca|| ātmanastuṣṭiḥ vaikalpikeṣu padārtheṣu yasmin kriyamāṇe ātmanaḥ prītiḥ sāpi pramāṇam| sādhavaḥ śiṣṭāḥ| tathāca manuḥ -- śiṣṭācāraḥ smṛtirvedāstrividhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam| lakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: samyak saṅkalpa jaḥ kāmaḥ dharma mūlam idam smṛtam iti manuḥ vdokhilaḥ dharma mūlam smṛti śīle ca tad vidām ācāraḥ ca eva sādhūnām ātmanaḥ tuṣṭiḥ eva ca ātmanaḥ tuṣṭiḥ vaikalpikeṣu padārtheṣu yasmin kriyamāṇe ātmanaḥ prītiḥ sā api pramāṇam sādhavaḥ śiṣṭāḥ tathā ca manuḥ śiṣṭa ācāraḥ smṛtiḥ vedāḥ trividham dharma lakṣaṇam lakṣaṇam pramāṇam iti arthaḥ

original: śiṣṭalakṣaṇamapi sa evāha -- dharmeṇādhigato yaistu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ| te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ|| iti| itihāsapurāṇānyaṅgāni vedasya paribṛṃhaṇāniṣa| tathāca bṛhaspatiḥ -- itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet| bibhetyalpaśrutād vedo māmayaṃ pracaliṣyati|| iti|
analyzed: śiṣṭa lakṣaṇam api saḥ eva āha dharmeṇa adhigataḥ yaiḥ tu vedaḥ sa paribṛṃhaṇaḥ te śiṣṭāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ jñeyāḥ śruti pratyakṣa hetavaḥ iti itihāsa purāṇāni aṅgāni vedasya tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ itihāsa purāṇābhyām vedam samupabṛṃhayet bibheti alpa śrutāt vedaḥ mām ayam pracaliṣyati iti

original: bodhāyanaḥ -- śiṣṭāḥ khalu vigatamatsarā nirahaṅ‌kārāḥ kumbhyādidhānyā alolupā ḍambhadarpalobhamohamadakrodhavarjitā iti| tathāraṇyaparvaṇi -- akrudhyanto'nasūyanto nirahaṅkāramatsarāḥ| ṛjavaḥ śamasampannāḥ śiṣṭācārā bhavanti te|| traividyavṛddhāḥ śucayo buddhimanto yaśasvinaḥ| guruśuśrūṣavo dāntāḥ śiṣṭācārā bhavanti te|| iti|
analyzed: bodhāyanaḥ śiṣṭāḥ khalu vigata matsarāḥ nirahaṅkārāḥ kumbhī ādi dhānyāḥ a lolupāḥ ḍambha darpa lobha moha mada krodha varjitāḥ iti tathā araṇya parvaṇi akrudhyantaḥ anasūyantaḥ nirahaṅkāra matsarāḥ ṛjavaḥ śama sampannāḥ śiṣṭa ācārāḥ bhavanti te traividya vṛddhāḥ śucayaḥ buddhimantaḥ yaśasvinaḥ guru śuśrūṣavaḥ dāntāḥ śiṣṭa ācārāḥ bhavanti te iti

original: hārīto'pi -- sādhavaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ syuḥ sacchabdaḥ sādhuvācakaḥ| teṣāmācaraṇaṃ yattu sadācāraḥ sa ucyate|| iti| śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇamiti devatādyācaraṇaṃ nācaritavyaṃ, pratyavāyaśravaṇāt| tadāha manuḥ -- dharmavyatikramo dṛṣṭo mahatāṃ sāhasaṃ tathā| tadanvīkṣya prayuñjānaḥ sa sīdatyavaro'balaḥ| tejo balāni pūrveṣāṃ śarīrāṇīndriyāṇi ca|
analyzed: sādhavaḥ kṣīṇa doṣāḥ syuḥ sat śabdaḥ sādhu vācakaḥ teṣām ācaraṇam yat tu sat ācāraḥ saḥ ucyate iti śiṣṭa ācāraḥ pramāṇam iti devatā ādi ācaraṇam na ācaritavyam pratyavāya śravaṇāt tat āha manuḥ dharma vyatikramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ mahatām sāhasam tathā tat anvīkṣya prayuñjānaḥ sa sīdati avaraḥ balaḥ tejaḥ balāni pūrveṣām śarīrāṇi indriyāṇi ca

original: doṣaistu nopalipyante padmapatramivāmbhasā|| iti| bodhāyanaḥ -- anuṣṭhitaṃ ca yaddevairmunibhuryadanuṣṭhitam| nānuṣṭheyaṃ manuṣyaistu(stad) uktaṃ karma samācaret|| iti| aṅgirāḥ -- pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca śāstraṃ ca vividhāgamam| tat‌traye vihitaṃ kāryaṃ dharmasiddhimabhīpsatā|| iti|
analyzed: doṣaiḥ tu na upalipyante padma patram iva ambhasā iti bodhāyanaḥ anuṣṭhitam ca yat devaiḥ munibhuḥ yat anuṣṭhitam na anuṣṭheyam uktam karma samācaret iti aṅgirāḥ pratyakṣam anumānam ca śāstram ca vividha āgamam tat traye vihitam kāryam dharma siddhim abhīpsatā iti

original: yatra punaḥ śrutyādayo na santi tatra pariṣadvacanaṃ pramāṇamityāha manuḥ -- anāmnāteṣu dharmeṣu kathaṃ syāditi ced bhavet| yaṃ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ syādaśaṅkitaḥ|| iti| dharmeṣu dharmapramāṇeṣvityarthaḥ| te'pi śiṣṭā daśāvarāḥ| tadāha gautamaḥ -- anāmnāte daśāvaraiḥ śiṣṭairūhavadbhiḥ praśastaṃ kāryamiti||
analyzed: yatra punar śruti ādayaḥ na santi tatra pariṣad vacanam pramāṇam iti āha manuḥ an āmnāteṣu dharmeṣu katham syāt iti ced bhavet yam śiṣṭāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ syāt aśaṅkitaḥ iti dharmeṣu dharma pramāṇeṣu iti arthaḥ te api śiṣṭāḥ daśa avarāḥ tat āha gautamaḥ an āmnāte daśa avaraiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ ūhavadbhiḥ praśastam kāryam iti

original: yattaiḥ praśastamityuktaṃ tatkāryamityarthaḥ| manurapi -- ṛgvedavid yajurvicca sāmavedavideva ca| tryavarāḥ pariṣañjñeyā dharmasaṃśayanirṇaye|| iti| adhyātmavidyāśreṣṭho dharmajñaśca sa eko vā yamarthaṃ dharmavattayā brūte, so'pi dharmaḥ syāt|
analyzed: yat taiḥ praśastam iti uktam tat kāryam iti arthaḥ manuḥ api ṛgveda vid yajuḥ vid ca sāmaveda vid eva ca tryavarāḥ dharma saṃśaya nirṇaye iti adhyātma vidyā śreṣṭhaḥ dharma jñaḥ ca saḥ ekaḥ vā yam artham dharmavat tayā brūte saḥ api dharmaḥ syāt

original: pariṣadvākyamapi vedānusāriṇāmeva grāhyamityāha hārītaḥ -- vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ smṛtayaḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmārthayuktaṃ vacanaṃ pramāṇam| yasya pramāṇaṃ na bhavet pramāṇaṃ kastasya kuryādvacanaṃ pramāṇam|| iti| dharmavyavasthāḥ kaḥ kuryādvirodhe sādhuyuktibhiḥ| nyāyaviddharmaśāstrajño haitukaḥ pariṣanmataḥ|| avratānāmantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām|
analyzed: pariṣad vākyam api veda anusāriṇām eva grāhyam iti āha hārītaḥ vedāḥ pramāṇam smṛtayaḥ pramāṇam dharma artha yuktam vacanam pramāṇam yasya pramāṇam na bhavet pramāṇam kaḥ tasya kuryāt vacanam pramāṇam iti dharma vyavasthāḥ kaḥ kuryāt virodhe sādhu yuktibhiḥ nyāya vid dharmaśāstra jñaḥ haitukaḥ pariṣad mataḥ avratānām antrāṇām jāti mātra upajīvinām

original: sahasnaśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate|| yāṃ yāṃvedavido brūyustrayo'pyenassu niṣkṛtiḥ| sā teṣāṃ pāvanāya syāt pavitraṃ viduṣāṃ hi vāk|| iti| etadalpapāpaviṣayam| dharmajñasamayo'pi kvacit pramāṇam| tadāhāpastambaḥ -- dharmajñasamayaḥ pramāṇaṃ vedāśceti| kvacit sampradāyo'pi pramāṇam| tatra manuḥ yenāsya phtiro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ|
analyzed: sahasnaśas sametānām pariṣad tvam na vidyate yām yām veda vidaḥ brūyuḥ trayaḥ api enaḥsu niṣkṛtiḥ sā teṣām pāvanāya syāt pavitram viduṣām hi vāc iti etat alpa pāpa viṣayam dharma jña samayaḥ api kvacid pramāṇam tat āha āpastambaḥ dharma jña samayaḥ pramāṇam vedāḥ ca iti kvacid sampradāyaḥ api pramāṇam tatra manuḥ yena asya phtiraḥ yātāḥ yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ

original: tena yāyāt satāṃ mārge tena gacchanna dṛṣyati|| svakulakramāgatācāraḥ sampradāyaḥ| so'pi śāstravipratipattau pramāṇam| yatra śāstragatirbhinnā sarvakarmasu bhārata| udite'nudite caiva homabhedo yathā bhavet|| yasmin kule kramāyātamācāraṃ tvācared‌budhaḥ| sa garīyān mahābāho sarvaśāstroditādapi|| iti sumantuvacanāditi| iti dharmapramāṇāni|
analyzed: tena yāyāt satām mārge tena gacchan na dṛṣyati sva kula krama āgata ācāraḥ sampradāyaḥ saḥ api śāstra vipratipattau pramāṇam yatra śāstra gatiḥ bhinnā sarva karmasu bhārata uditena in udite ca eva homa bhedaḥ yathā bhavet yasmin kule krama āyātam ācāram tu ācaret budhaḥ sa garīyān mahā bāho sarva śāstra uditāt api iti sumantu vacanāt iti iti dharma pramāṇāni

original: smṛtiprāmāṇyasamarthanam

nanūktasmṛtyādīnāṃ kiṃtvena prāmāṇyamiti ced, vedamūlatveneti brūmaḥ| naca tāsāṃ tanmūlatve tatpraṇayanavaiyarthyam| vaidikaśabdānāṃ duradhigamārthatvena sukhapratipattaye vikṣiptasaṅgrahāya ca smṛtipraṇayanasya saphalatvāt| taduktaṃ marīcinā -- durbodhā vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ prakīrṇatvācca ye'khilāḥ|
analyzed: nanu ukta smṛti ādīnām kiṃtvena prāmāṇyam iti ced veda mūla tvena iti brūmaḥ na ca tāsām tad mūla tve tad praṇayana vaiyarthyam vaidika śabdānām duradhigama artha tvena sukha pratipattaye vikṣipta saṅgrahāya ca smṛti praṇayanasya saphala tvāt tat uktam marīcinā durbodhāḥ vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ prakīrṇa tvāt ca yekhilāḥ

original: tañjñaista eva spaṣṭārthāḥ smṛtitantre pratiṣṭhitāḥ|| iti| evaṃ ca itihāsapurāṇabodhāyanādyaṣṭādaśasūtrāṇāmapi tulyatayā prāmāṇyam| atra śrutismṛtyorvirodhe śrutireva prābalyam| smṛtīnāṃ parasparavirodhe niravakāśena sāvakāśasya prabalena durbalasya bādhaḥ| prābalyaṃ ca niravakāśatvena bahutvena pramāṇāntarasaṃvāditvena sāttvikatvādineti bodhyam|
analyzed: tañjñaiḥ te eva spaṣṭa arthāḥ smṛti tantre pratiṣṭhitāḥ iti evam ca itihāsa purāṇa bodhāyana ādi aṣṭādaśa sūtrāṇām api tulya tayā prāmāṇyam atra śruti smṛtyoḥ virodhe śrutiḥ eva prābalyam smṛtīnām paraspara virodhe niravakāśena sa avakāśasya prabalena durbalasya bādhaḥ prābalyam ca niravakāśa tvena bahutvena pramāṇa antara saṃvādi tvena sāttvika tva ādinā iti bodhyam

original: vistarastu candrikāyāmantarnaye bodhyaḥ||
analyzed: vistaraḥ tu candrikāyām antar naye bodhyaḥ

original: tāni cāṣṭādaśasūtrāṇyāgniveśyasūtre parigaṇitāni -- athātaḥ sūtragaṇanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| bodhāyanamāpastambaṃ satyāṣāḍhaṃ dākṣāyaṇamāgastyaṃ śākalyamāśvalāyanaṃ śāmbarīyaṃ kātyāyanamiti navāni pūrvasūtrāṇi| vaikhānasaṃ śaunakīyaṃ bhāradvājamāgniveśyaṃ jaiminīyaṃ mādhulyaṃ mādhyandinaṃ kauṇḍinyaṃ gautamamiti navānyaparasūtrāṇi|
analyzed: tāni ca aṣṭādaśa sūtrāṇi āgniveśya sūtre parigaṇitāni atha atas sūtra gaṇanām vyākhyāsyāmaḥ bodhāyanam āpastambam satyāṣāḍham dākṣāyaṇam āgastyam śākalyam āśvalāyanam śāmbarīyam kātyāyanam iti navāni pūrva sūtrāṇi vaikhānasam śaunakīyam bhāradvājam āgniveśyam jaiminīyam mādhulyam mādhyandinam kauṇḍinyam gautamam iti navāni apara sūtrāṇi

original: tathācāṣṭādaśasaṃkhyākāḥ śārīrāḥ saṃskārā iti| tathāca manuḥ -- śrutiṃ paśyanti munayaḥ smaranti ca tathā smṛtamṣa tasmāt pramāṇamubhayaṃ pramāṇaiḥ pramitaṃ bhuvi|| yo'vamanyeta te tūbhe hetuśāstrāśrayānnaraḥ| sa sādhubhirbahiṣkāryo nāstiko vedanindakaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: tathā ca aṣṭādaśa saṃkhyākāḥ śārīrāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti tathā ca manuḥ śrutim paśyanti munayaḥ smaranti ca tathā smṛtam tasmāt pramāṇam ubhayam pramāṇaiḥ pramitam bhuvi yaḥ u vamanyeta te tu ubhe hetu śāstra āśrayāt naraḥ sa sādhubhiḥ bahiṣkāryaḥ nāstikaḥ veda nindakaḥ iti

original: etāni smṛtyādīni na nirākāryāṇītyatra yamo'pi -- etairyāni praṇītāni dharmaśāstrāṇi vai purā| tānyetāni pramāṇāni na hātavyāni hetubhiḥ|| iti| yastāni hetubhirhanyāt so'ndhe tamasi majjatīti|| vasiṣṭho'pi -- aprāmāṇyaṃ ca vedānāmāryāṇāṃ caiva kutsanam| avyavasthā ca sarvatra etannāśanamātmanaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: etāni smṛti ādīni na nirākāryāṇi iti atra yamaḥ upi etaiḥ yāni praṇītāni dharma śāstrāṇi vai purā tāni etāni pramāṇāni na hātavyāni hetubhiḥ iti yaḥ tāni hetubhiḥ hanyāt saḥ undhe tamasi majjati iti vasiṣṭhaḥ upi a prāmāṇyam ca vedānām āryāṇām ca eva kutsanam avyavasthā ca sarvatra etat nāśanam ātmanaḥ iti

original: smṛtiprāmāṇyameva paripālayitavyamityatrāṅgirāḥ -- pramāṇāni pramāṇajñaiḥ paripālyāni yatnataḥ| sīdanti hi pramāṇāni pramāṇairavyavasthitaiḥ|| iti| vedatulyatvenetihāsapurāṇayoḥ prāmāṇyamityatra bhaviṣyatpurāṇam -- ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāśca mūlarāmāyaṇaṃ tathā| bhārataṃ pañcarātraṃ ca vedā ityeva śabditāḥ|| purāṇāni ca yānīha vaiṣṇavāni vido viduḥ|
analyzed: smṛti prāmāṇyam eva paripālayitavyam iti atra aṅgirāḥ pramāṇāni pramāṇa jñaiḥ paripālyāni yatnataḥ sīdanti hi pramāṇāni pramāṇaiḥ avyavasthitaiḥ iti veda tulya tvena itihāsa purāṇayoḥ prāmāṇyam iti atra bhaviṣyat purāṇam ṛk yajuḥ sāma atharvāḥ ca mūlarāmāyaṇam tathā bhāratam pañcarātram ca vedāḥ iti eva śabditāḥ purāṇāni ca yāni iha vaiṣṇavāni vidaḥ viduḥ

original: svataḥ prāmāṇyameteṣāṃ nātra kiñcidvicāryate|| iti| śrutirapi vedacatuṣṭayaṃ darśayitvā `itihāsapurāṇaḥ pañcama' iti|| iti smṛtiprāmāṇyasamarthanam||
analyzed: svatas prāmāṇyam eteṣām na atra kiñcid vicāryate iti śrutiḥ api veda catuṣṭayam darśayitvā itihāsa purāṇaḥ pañcamaḥ iti iti smṛti prāmāṇya samarthanam

original: dharmaśāstrādhyayanam
analyzed: dharmaśāstra adhyayanam

original: atha dharmaśāstramapi vedavadadhyetavyam| tadāha manuḥ -- yathaiva vedādhyayanaṃ dharmaśāstramidaṃ tathā| adhyetavyaṃ pramāṇena niyataṃ svargamicchatā|| iti| tacca vedādhyayanānantaramityāha bṛhaspatiḥ -- evaṃ daṇḍādikairyuktaṃ saṃskṛtya tanayaṃ pitā| vedamadhyāpayet paścācchāstraṃ manvādikaṃ tathā|| iti|
analyzed: atha dharma śāstram api veda vat adhyetavyam tat āha manuḥ yathā eva veda adhyayanam dharma śāstram idam tathā adhyetavyam pramāṇena niyatam svargam icchatā iti tat ca veda adhyayana anantaram iti āha bṛhaspatiḥ evam daṇḍa ādikaiḥ yuktam saṃskṛtya tanayam pitā vedam adhyāpayet paścāt śāstram manu ādikam tathā iti

original: anadhyayane doṣamāha sa eva -- śrutismṛtī hi viprāṇāṃ cakṣuṣī parame mate| kāṇastatraikayā hīno dvābhyāmandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| iti| adhītya caturo vedān ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca padakramān| smṛtihīnā na śobhante candrahīneva śarvarī|| iti ca| tadadhyayanasya phalamadhikāriṇaścāha yamaḥ -- idaṃ śāstramadhīyāno brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo'tha viṭ|
analyzed: anadhyayane doṣam āha saḥ eva śruti smṛtī hi viprāṇām cakṣuṣī parame mate kāṇaḥ tatra ekayā hīnaḥ dvābhyām andhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ iti adhītya caturaḥ vedān ṣaḍaṅgam ca padakramān smṛti hīnāḥ na śobhante candra hīnā iva śarvarī iti ca tad adhyayanasya phalam adhikāriṇaḥ ca āha yamaḥ idam śāstram adhīyānaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaḥ utha viṭ

original: punātīha pitṛn sarvān sapta sapta parāvarān|| iti| manurapi -- idaṃ śāstramadhīyāno brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ| manovāgdehajairnityaṃ karmadoṣairna lipyate|| viduṣā brāhmaṇenedamadhyetavyaṃ prayatnataḥ| vidvad‌bhyaśca pravaktavyaṃ samyaṅnānyena kenacit|| iti caḥ śūdrādhikāranivṛttiparaḥ| śūdrasya nādhikāro'sti na vedeṣu na ca smṛtāviti yamokteḥ|
analyzed: punāti iha pitṛn sarvān sapta sapta para avarān iti manuḥ api idam śāstram adhīyānaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ saṃśita vrataḥ manaḥ vāc deha jaiḥ nityam karma doṣaiḥ na lipyate viduṣā brāhmaṇena idam adhyetavyam prayatnataḥ vidvadbhyaḥ ca pravaktavyam samyak na anyena kenacid iti caḥ śūdra adhikāra nivṛtti paraḥ śūdrasya na adhikāraḥ usti na vedeṣu na ca smṛtau iti yama ukteḥ

original: etadadhyayanasya pravṛttinivṛttī phalamāhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau -- cikitsā dharmaśāstrāṇi vyādhīnāmiva bheṣajam| kupathapratipannānāṃ vyākulendriyacetasām|| nivartakaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ vyādhīnāmeva bheṣajam|| iti| taddhāraṇe phalaviśeṣamāha yamaḥ -- dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ svargyaṃ tathaiva ca| dhāraṇaṃ dharmaśāstrasya brahmalokamavāpnuyāt||
analyzed: etad adhyayanasya pravṛtti nivṛttī phalam āhatuḥ śaṅkha likhitau cikitsā dharma śāstrāṇi vyādhīnām iva bheṣajam kupatha pratipannānām vyākula indriya cetasām nivartakam dharma śāstram vyādhīnām eva bheṣajam iti tad dhāraṇe phala viśeṣam āha yamaḥ dharmyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam puṇyam svargyam tathā eva ca dhāraṇam dharma śāstrasya brahma lokam avāpnuyāt

analyzed: iti manuḥ api punāti paṅktim vaṃśyān ca sapta sapta para avarān pṛthivīm api ca eva imām kṛtsnam ekaḥ api idam svastyayanam śreṣṭham idam buddhi vivardhanam idam yaśasyam satatam idam naiśreyasam śroyaskaram param dhanyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam puṇyam svarga apavarga dam dhāraṇam dharmaśāstrasya vedānām dhāraṇam yathā

original: mriyate nānapatyaśca nārthakṛcchraṃ hi gacchati| grahaṇādeva śāstrasya sadbhiḥ sāmyaṃ ca gacchati|| iti| iti smṛtyadhyayanaphalam||
analyzed: mriyate na anapatyaḥ ca na artha kṛcchram hi gacchati grahaṇāt eva śāstrasya sadbhiḥ sāmyam ca gacchati iti iti smṛti adhyayana phalam

original: atha śrutismṛtyorvirodhe nirṇayaḥ| tatra manuḥ -- śrutidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāttatra dharmāvubhau smṛtau| ubhāvapi hi tau dharmau samyaguktau manīṣibhiḥ|| iti| yatra śrutyordvaidhaṃ parasparavirodhaḥ tatra śrutipratipāditau dvāvapi dharmau| yasmād manvādibhiḥ pūrvatarairapi tau dharmāvuktau|
analyzed: atha śruti smṛtyoḥ virodhe nirṇayaḥ tatra manuḥ śruti dvaidham tu yatra syāt tatra dharmau ubhau smṛtau ubhau api hi tau dharmau samyak uktau manīṣibhiḥ iti yatra śrutyoḥ dvaidham paraspara virodhaḥ tatra śruti pratipāditau dvau api dharmau yasmāt manu ādibhiḥ pūrvataraiḥ api tau dharmau uktau

original: ekaṃ pramāṇamitaradapramāṇaṃ bhaveditī' tyuktarītyā sarvātmanā bādhāyogena viṣayāntarasañcāreṇa vā kālabhedena vādhikāribhedena vā deśabhedena vā saṅkocaparatvena vā gauṇārthaparatvena vā prayogāntaraparatvena vā tātparyāntaraparatvena vā mānāntarasyopapannatvena dvāvapi śrutipratipāditau dharmau pramāṇasiddhāviti manuvacanasya tātparyam|
analyzed: ekam pramāṇam itarat apramāṇam bhavet iti ti ukta rītyā sarva ātmanā bādhā yogena viṣaya antara sañcāreṇa vā kāla bhedena vā adhikāri bhedena vā deśa bhedena vā saṅkoca paratvena vā gauṇa artha paratvena vā prayoga antara paratvena vā tātparya antara paratvena vā māna antarasya upapannatvena dvau api śruti pratipāditau dharmau pramāṇa siddhau iti manu vacanasya tātparyam

original: yadvā virodhe bādho'pyastu yatraikatarasya prābalyaṃ, yatra tulyabalatā tatra bādhābhāvena vikalpasyāvaśyakatvād dvāvapi dharmāvityevaṃparaṃ manuvacanam| evaṃ ca tulyanyāyatayā smṛtyoḥ purāṇayorācārayośca parasparavirodhe dvāvapi dharmāviti|| iti śrutyādīnāṃ virodhe nirṇayaḥ|
analyzed: yat vā virodhe bādhaḥ upi astu yatra ekatarasya prābalyam yatra tulya balatā tatra bādhā abhāvena vikalpasya āvaśyaka tvāt dvau api dharmau iti evaṃparam manu vacanam evam ca tulya nyāyatayā smṛtyoḥ purāṇayoḥ ācārayoḥ ca paraspara virodhe dvau api dharmau iti iti śruti ādīnām virodhe nirṇayaḥ

original: śrutismṛtyuditabahuvidhakarmāṇi|
analyzed: śruti smṛti udita bahuvidha karmāṇi

original: atha śrutismṛtyuditakarmāṇi kānicitpradhānakarmāṇi kānicidaṅgakarmāṇi kānicidupāṅkarmāṇi kānicid gauṇakarmāṇi kānicitpratinidhikarmāṇītyādiprakāreṇa bahuvidhānīti prasaṅgāt saṃkṣepata ucyate| tatrāhāpastambaḥ -- udagayanapūrvapakṣāhaḥ puṇyāheṣu kāryāṇi| yajñopavītināṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ purastādudagvopakramaḥ| tathāpavargopakramaḥ|
analyzed: atha śruti smṛti udita karmāṇi kānicid pradhāna karmāṇi kānicid aṅga karmāṇi kānicid upāṅkarmāṇi kānicid gauṇa karmāṇi kānicid pratinidhi karmāṇi ityādi prakāreṇa bahuvidhāni iti prasaṅgāt saṃkṣepataḥ ucyate tatra āha āpastambaḥ udagayana pūrvapakṣa ahar puṇya aheṣu kāryāṇi yajña upavītinām pradakṣiṇam purastāt udak vā upakramaḥ tathā apavarga upakramaḥ

original: tathāpavargo'parapakṣe pitryāṇi prācīnāvītināpasavyadakṣiṇato'pavargaḥ|| iti| vāyupurāṇe pradhānakarmaṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgānītyuktam -- ṣaḍapyaṅgāni caitāni kriyamāṇasyaṃ karmaṇaḥ| śrutismṛtivicāraśca śradhdā satsaṅgatistathā|| ārādhyadevatābhaktistathā kartṛtvavarjanam| niyamaśceti catvāri tatsādhyāṅgāni tāni tu||
analyzed: tathā apavarga uparapakṣe pitryāṇi iti vāyupurāṇe pradhāna karmaṇaḥ ṣaḍ aṅgāni iti uktam ṣaḍ api aṅgāni ca etāni karmaṇaḥ śruti smṛti vicāraḥ ca sat saṅgatiḥ tathā ārādhya devatā bhaktiḥ tathā kartṛ tva varjanam niyamaḥ ca iti catvāri tad sādhya aṅgāni tāni tu

original: kāle kāle prabodhaśca yathāśakti vimarśanam| manaḥsvāsthyaṃ śucitvaṃ ca pradhānāṅgaṃ tvidaṃ matam|| ityetadaṅgacatuṣṭayamapi kriyamāṇakarmaṇa iti bodhyam| aṅgāntarāṇyapyāha sa eva -- viṣṇorarpaṇamevaikamāstikyaṃ tu dvitīyakam| niṣkāmatvaṃ hariprītikāmanālocanadvayam|| iti| ṣaḍupāṅgānyāha sa eva -- tathaiva ṣaḍupāṅgāni tānyetāni vido viduḥ|
analyzed: kāle kāle prabodhaḥ ca yathāśakti vimarśanam manaḥ svāsthyam śuci tvam ca pradhāna aṅgam tu idam matam iti etat aṅga catuṣṭayam api kriyamāṇa karmaṇaḥ iti bodhyam aṅga antarāṇi api āha saḥ eva viṣṇoḥ arpaṇam eva ekam āstikyam tu dvitīyakam niṣkāma tvam hari prīti kāmanā locana dvayam iti ṣaḍ upāṅgāni āha saḥ eva tathā eva ṣaḍ upāṅgāni tāni etāni vidaḥ viduḥ

original: gaṇḍūṣadantakāṣṭhe ca śaucācāme tathaiva ca|| snānaṃ vastraparīdhānaṃ saptamaṃ puṇḍradhāraṇam| evaṃ karma vijānīyāt paścāt karma samācaret|| karmaṇānena sañjñānaṃ jāyate mokṣasādhanam| etañjñānaṃ vinā karma kṛtaṃ vā bahuśo naraiḥ|| na tena vardhate kvāpi no kanīyān bhavet kvacit|| iti|
analyzed: gaṇḍūṣa dantakāṣṭhe ca śauca ācāme tathā eva ca snānam vastra parīdhānam saptamam puṇḍra dhāraṇam evam karma vijānīyāt paścāt karma samācaret karmaṇā anena sañjñānam jāyate mokṣa sādhanam etat jñānam vinā karma kṛtam vā bahuśas naraiḥ na tena vardhate kvāpi no kanīyān bhavet kvacid iti

original: kātyāyanaḥ prakārāntareṇa ṣaḍaṅgānyāha -- manaḥ prasādāt satyoktyā tapasā snānakarmaṇā| ācamya cātmanaḥ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā karma samācaret|| iti| pradhānakarmaṇaḥ sakāśādādau kartavyānīmāni karmāṇi| sa eva viśeṣamāha -- yatropadiśyate karma karturaṅgaṃ na tūcyate| dakṣiṇastatra vijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥ||
analyzed: kātyāyanaḥ prakāra antareṇa ṣaḍaṅgāni āha manaḥ prasādāt satya uktyā tapasā snāna karmaṇā ācamya ca ātmanaḥ śuddhim kṛtvā karma samācaret iti pradhāna karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt ādau kartavyāni imāni karmāṇi saḥ eva viśeṣam āha yatra upadiśyate karma kartuḥ aṅgam na tu ucyate dakṣiṇaḥ tatra vijñeyaḥ karmaṇām pāragaḥ karaḥ

original: manurapi -- kutsite vāmahastaḥ syāddakṣiṇaḥ syādakutsite| yajñopavītinā kāryaṃ sarvakarma pradakṣiṇam|| kātyāyano viśeṣamāha -- yatra diṅ‌niyamo na syājjapahomādikarmasu| tistrastatra diśaḥ proktā aindrīsaumyāparājitāḥ|| aparājitā aiśānī dik| sa eva dharmāntare viśeṣamāha -- āsīna ūrdhvaṃ prahvo vā niyamo yatra nedṛśaḥ|
analyzed: manuḥ api kutsite vāma hastaḥ syāt dakṣiṇaḥ syāt akutsite yajña upavītinā kāryam sarva karma pradakṣiṇam kātyāyanaḥ viśeṣam āha yatra diś niyamaḥ na syāt japa homa ādi karmasu tistraḥ tatra diśaḥ proktāḥ aindrī saumya aparājitāḥ aparājitā aiśānī diś saḥ eva dharma antare viśeṣam āha āsīnaḥ ūrdhvam prahvaḥ vā niyamaḥ yatra na īdṛśaḥ

original: tadāsīnena kartavyaṃ na prahvena na tiṣṭhatā|| iti| dharme viśeṣāntaramāha kātyāyanaḥ -- pravṛttamanyathā kuryād vidhimohāt kathañcana| yatastadanyathābhūtaṃ tata eva samīrayet|| samāptau yadi jānīyānmayaitadayathākṛtam| tāvadeva punaḥ kuryānnāvṛttiḥ sarvakarmaṇaḥ|| pradhānasya(syā)kriyāyāṃ tu sāṅgaṃ tatkriyate punaḥ|
analyzed: tat āsīnena kartavyam na prahvena na tiṣṭhatā iti dharme viśeṣa antaram āha kātyāyanaḥ pravṛttam anyathā kuryāt vidhi mohāt kathañcana yatas tat anyathābhūtam tatas eva samīrayet samāptau yadi jānīyāt mayā etat ayathākṛtam tāvat eva punar kuryāt na avṛttiḥ sarva karmaṇaḥ tu sa aṅgam tat kriyate punar

original: tadaṅgasya(syā)kriyāyāṃ tu nāvṛttirnaivatkriyā|| gārgyo viśeṣamāha -- yo vaidikamanādṛtya karma smārtetihāsakam| mohāt samācared vipro na sa puṇyena yujyate|| etacchaktaviṣayam| aśaktaviṣaye -- śrautaṃ karma na cecchaktaḥ kartuṃ smārtaṃ samācaret| aśaktau smārtamapyanyaṃ kuryādācāramantataḥ||
analyzed: tad aṅga syasya akriyāyām tu na avṛttiḥ na eva kriyā gārgyaḥ viśeṣam āha yaḥ vaidikam an ādṛtya karma smārta itihāsakam mohāt samācaret vipraḥ na sa puṇyena yujyate etat śakta viṣayam aśakta viṣaye śrautam karma na ced śaktaḥ kartum smārtam samācaret aśaktau smārtam api anyam kuryāt ācāram antatas

original: tatraiva vyāsaḥ -- śrautakarma na cecchaktaḥ kartuṃ smārtaṃ samācaret| tatrāpyaśaktaḥ karaṇe sadācāraṃ labhedbudhaḥ|| iti| svaśākhāyāmanāmnātaṃ karma śākhāntarādhikaraṇanyāyena smṛtyantarādupasaṃhṛtyānuṣṭheyamityāha kātyāyanaḥ -- yannāmnātaṃ svaśākhāyāṃ pārakyamavirodhi ca| vidvadbhistadanuṣṭheyamagnihotrādikarmavat|| iti|
analyzed: tatra eva vyāsaḥ śrauta karma na ced śaktaḥ kartum smārtam samācaret tatra api aśaktaḥ karaṇe sat ācāram labhet budhaḥ iti sva śākhāyām anāmnātam karma śākhā antara adhikaraṇa nyāyena smṛti antarāt upasaṃhṛtya anuṣṭheyam iti āha kātyāyanaḥ yat na āmnātam sva śākhāyām pārakyam avirodhi ca vidvadbhiḥ tat anuṣṭheyam agnihotra ādi karma vat iti

original: ātmatantre tu yannoktaṃ tatkuryātpāratantrikamiti ca| smṛtiratnāvalyāṃ kāladravyasampattyoḥ kālasyaiva mukhyatvamuktam -- mukhyakāle hi mukhyaṃ cet sādhanaṃ naiva labhyate| tatkāladravyayoḥ kasya mukhyatvaṃ gauṇatāpi vā|| mukhyakālaṃ samāśritya gauṇamapyastu sādhanam| na mukhyadravyalebhena gauṇakālapratīkṣaṇam|| iti|
analyzed: ātmatantre tu yat na uktam tat kuryāt pāratantrikam iti ca smṛtiratnāvalyām kāla dravya sampattyoḥ kālasya eva mukhya tvam uktam mukhya kāle hi mukhyam ced sādhanam na eva labhyate tad kāla dravyayoḥ kasya mukhya tvam gauṇa tā api vā mukhya kālam samāśritya gauṇam api astu sādhanam na mukhya dravya lebhena gauṇa kāla pratīkṣaṇam iti

original: pulastyaḥ karmaṇi viśeṣamāha -- akāle cet (ca) kṛtaṃ karma kālaṃ prāpya punaḥ kriyā| kālātītaṃ tu yatkuryādakṛtaṃ tadvinirdiśet||
analyzed: pulastyaḥ karmaṇi viśeṣam āha akāle ced ca kṛtam karma kālam prāpya punar kriyā kāla atītam tu yat kuryāt akṛtam tat vinirdiśet

original: gauṇasyāpyupādānam
analyzed: gauṇasya api upādānam

original: tatrāpavādaḥ| yadā tu kathañcinmukhyakālātikramastadāha kātyāyanaḥ -- mukhyakāle yadāvaśyaṃ karma kartuṃ na śakyate| gauṇakāle'pi kartavyaṃ gauṇo'pyatre (pyetā) dṛśo bhavet| gauṇakālalakṣaṇaṃ smṛtiratnāvalyāmuktam -- svakālāduttare gauṇaḥ kālaḥ pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ| āgāminī kriyā mukhyakālasyāpyantarālavat||
analyzed: tatra apavādaḥ yadā tu kathañcid mukhya kāla atikramaḥ tat āha kātyāyanaḥ mukhya kāle yadā avaśyam karma kartum na śakyate gauṇa kāle api kartavyam gauṇaḥ upi atre pi etāḥ dṛśaḥ bhavet gauṇa kāla lakṣaṇam smṛtiratnāvalyām uktam sva kālāt uttare gauṇaḥ kālaḥ pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ āgāminī kriyā mukhya kālasya api antarāla vat

original: gauṇakālatvamicchanti kecit prāktanakarmaṇaḥ| gauṇeṣveteṣu kāleṣu karma coditamācaret|| prāyaścittaprakāreṇa proktaṃ niṣkṛtimācaret| prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu gauṇakāle tamācaret|| divoditāni karmāṇi pramādādakṛtāni vai| yāminyāḥ praharaṃ yāvattāvatkarmāṇi kārayet|| asyārthaḥ -- pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ āgāmikarmamukhyakālasya ca yo'ntarālaḥ kālaḥ sa gauṇaḥ|
analyzed: gauṇa kāla tvam icchanti kecid prāktana karmaṇaḥ gauṇeṣu eteṣu kāleṣu karma ca uditam ācaret prāyaścitta prakāreṇa proktam niṣkṛtim ācaret prāyaścittam a kṛtvā tu gauṇa kāle tam ācaret divā uditāni karmāṇi pramādāt akṛtāni vai yāminyāḥ praharam yāvat tāvat karmāṇi kārayet asya arthaḥ pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ āgāmi karma mukhya kālasya ca yaḥ ntarālaḥ kālaḥ sa gauṇaḥ

original: kecittu āgāmikriyāmukhyakālo'pi gauṇakāla iti vadanti| gauṇamukhyakālayorubhayorapyatikrame prāyaścittavidhyuktaprakāreṇa prāyaścittamevācaret| tatra karma(ṇo)gauṇakāle ca prāyaścittamakṛtvaiva karma kuryāditi|| atra saṅgrahe viśeṣo darśitaḥ -- rātrau praharaparyaṃtaṃ divākṛtyāni kārayet| brahmayajñaṃ ca sauraṃ ca varjayitvā viśeṣataḥ|| iti|
analyzed: kecid tu āgāmi kriyā mukhya kālaḥ api gauṇa kālaḥ iti vadanti gauṇa mukhya kālayoḥ ubhayoḥ api atikrame prāyaścitta vidhi ukta prakāreṇa prāyaścittam eva ācaret tatra karmaṇaḥ gauṇa kāle ca prāyaścittam a kṛtvā eva karma kuryāt iti atra saṅgrahe viśeṣaḥ darśitaḥ rātrau prahara paryantam divākṛtyāni kārayet brahmayajñam ca sauram ca varjayitvā viśeṣataḥ iti

original: smṛtiratnāvalyāṃ viśeṣo darśitaḥ -- kālātītāni karmāṇi prāpnuvantyuttarāṇi ca| kālātītāni kṛtvaiva vidadhyāduttarāṇi tu| akṛtvātītakarmāṇi yaḥ kuryāduttarāṇi tu| na ca devānna ca pitṛn na ca gacchanti mānuṣān|| hemādrau viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ -- lājahome ca sīmante devatāvāhane care| arghye tiṣṭhedupasthāne ṣaḍete bhṛguṇo (bhārgavo) ditāḥ||
analyzed: smṛtiratnāvalyām viśeṣaḥ darśitaḥ kāla atītāni karmāṇi prāpnuvanti uttarāṇi ca kāla atītāni kṛtvā eva vidadhyāt uttarāṇi tu a kṛtvā atīta karmāṇi yaḥ kuryāt uttarāṇi tu na ca devān na ca pitṛn na ca gacchanti mānuṣān hemādrau viśeṣaḥ abhihitaḥ lāja home ca sīmante devatā vāhane care arghye tiṣṭhet upasthāne ṣaṭ ete bhṛguṇaḥ bhārgavaḥ ditāḥ

original: bharadvājo viśeṣamāha -- ajñātā yadi vā mantrāḥ svasvagṛhyeṣu coditāḥ| upavītipramukhyānāṃ teṣāṃ vai dhāraṇe dvijaḥ| kevalaṃ praṇave vāpi vyāhṛtitritayaṃ tu vāṣa| syātāṃ viprādivarṇeṣu dvāvetau sarvaśākhinām|| iti| smṛtyarthasāre dharmāntaramuktam -- upātte tu pratinidhau mukhyārtho yadi labhyate| tatra mukhyamanādṛtya gauṇenaiva samāpayet||
analyzed: bharadvājaḥ viśeṣam āha ajñātāḥ yadi vā mantrāḥ sva sva gṛhyeṣu coditāḥ upavīti pramukhyānām teṣām vai dhāraṇe dvijaḥ kevalam praṇave vā api vyāhṛti tritayam tu vāṣa syātām vipra ādi varṇeṣu dvau etau sarva śākhinām iti smṛtyarthasāre dharma antaram uktam upātte tu pratinidhau mukhya arthaḥ yadi labhyate tatra mukhyam an ādṛtya gauṇena eva samāpayet

original: mukhyābhāve yadā gauṇamupāttaṃ tadvinaśyati| tatra mukhyopamaṃ gauṇaṃ grāhyaṃ gauṇopamaṃ na tu|| mukhyadravyāpacāre tu pratinidhyabhisandhinā| prayuñjānasya mukhyārthālābhe grāhyaḥ sa eva hi|| yasmin kasminnupātte tu mukhyopacarite sati| anyadravyaṃ sajātīyaṃ vijātīyamathāpi vā|| upādāya prayuñjāno pūrvaṃ kṛtsnamavāpnuyāt|
analyzed: mukhya abhāve yadā gauṇam upāttam tat vinaśyati tatra mukhya upamam gauṇam grāhyam gauṇa upamam na tu mukhya dravya apacāre tu pratinidhi abhisandhinā prayuñjānasya mukhya artha alābhe grāhyaḥ saḥ eva hi yasmin kasmin upātte tu mukhya upacarite sati anya dravyam sajātīyam vijātīyam atha api vā upādāya prayuñjānaḥ u pūrvam kṛtsnam avāpnuyāt

original: saṃskārāṇāmayogyo'pi mukhya eva hi gṛhyate|| na tu saṃskārayogyo'pi gṛhyate pratirūpakaḥ| kāryo rūpaistathā varṇaiḥ kṣīraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairapi|| gandhai rasaiḥ sadṛggrāhyaṃ pūrvābhāve paraṃ param| havyārthe goghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ tadabhāve tu māhiṣam|| ājyaṃ vā tadalābhe tu lākṣātailaṃgrahīṣyate| yeṣāṃ keṣāñcidanyeṣāṃ haviṣāmapyasambhave||
analyzed: saṃskārāṇām ayogyaḥ api mukhyaḥ eva hi gṛhyate na tu saṃskāra yogyaḥ api gṛhyate pratirūpakaḥ kāryaḥ rūpaiḥ tathā varṇaiḥ kṣīraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ api gandhaiḥ rasaiḥ sadṛś grāhyam pūrva abhāve param param havya arthe go ghṛtam grāhyam tad abhāve tu māhiṣam ājyam vā tad alābhe tu lākṣā tailam grahīṣyate yeṣām keṣāṃcid anyeṣām haviṣām api asambhave

original: sarvatrāntyamupādeyaṃ bharadvājamunermatāt| nimittānāmihaiteṣāṃ nirdeśaikyaṃ yaducyate|| tatsarveṣu nimitteṣujānīyāt pratipāditam| ikṣūnāpaḥ phalaṃ tāmbūlaṃ paya auṣadham|| bhakṣayitvāpi kartavyāḥ snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ| godāsīkanyakāścaiva tiṣṭhanneva prayojayet|| bālaṃ keśaṃ tathā hastaṃ yasya haste jalaṃ kṣipet|| ityādidharmaviśeṣāḥ||
analyzed: sarvatra antyam upādeyam bharadvāja muneḥ matāt nimittānām iha eteṣām nirdeśa aikyam yat ucyate tat sarveṣu nimitteṣu jānīyāt pratipāditam ikṣūn āpaḥ phalam tāmbūlam payaḥ auṣadham bhakṣayitvā api kartavyāḥ snāna dāna ādikāḥ kriyāḥ godāsī kanyakāḥ ca eva tiṣṭhan eva prayojayet bālam keśam tathā hastam yasya haste jalam kṣipet iti ādi dharma viśeṣāḥ

original: dharmadeśaḥ
analyzed: dharma deśaḥ

original: pūrvoktadharmānuṣṭhānāya dharmadeśo nirūpyate| tatra manuḥ -- sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadantaram| taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate|| kurukṣetraṃ ca mātsyaṃ ca pañcālāḥ śūrasenayaḥ| eṣa brahmarṣideśo vai brahmāvartādanantaraḥ|| himavadvindhyayormadhyaṃ yatprāgvinaśanādapi| pratyageva prayāgācca madhyadeśaḥprakīrtitaḥ||
analyzed: pūrva ukta dharma anuṣṭhānāya dharma deśaḥ nirūpyate tatra manuḥ sarasvatī dṛṣadvatyoḥ deva nadyoḥ yat antaram tam deva nirmitam deśam brahmāvartam pracakṣate kurukṣetram ca mātsyam ca pañcālāḥ śūrasenayaḥ eṣa brahmarṣi deśaḥ vai brahmāvartāt anantaraḥ himavat vindhyayoḥ madhyam yat prāk vinaśanāt api pratyak eva prayāgāt ca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

original: vinaśanaṃ nāma sarasvatyā antardhānadeśaḥ| ā samudrāttu vai pūrvādā samudrācca paścimāt| tayorevāntaraṃ giryorāryāvartaṃ vidurbudhāḥ|| iti| uktadeśeṣu pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśasyate| tathāca sumantuḥ -- brahmāvartaḥ paro deśa ṛṣideśastvanantaraḥ| madhyadeśastato nūnamāryāvartastathāparaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: vinaśanam nāma sarasvatyāḥ antardhāna deśaḥ samudrāt tu vai pūrvāt ā samudrāt ca paścimāt tayoḥ eva antaram giryoḥ āryāvartam viduḥ budhāḥ iti ukta deśeṣu pūrvam pūrvam praśasyate tathā ca sumantuḥ brahmāvartaḥ paraḥ deśaḥ ṛṣi deśaḥ tu anantaraḥ madhyadeśaḥ tatas nūnam āryāvartaḥ tathā aparaḥ iti

original: etaccatuṣṭayālābhe punardeśāntaramāha manuḥ -- kṛṣṇasārastu carati mṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ| yajñadeśaḥ sa vijñeyo mlecchadeśastataḥ paraḥ|| iti| uktālābhe'pi yasmin deśe cāturvarṇyavyavasthā dṛśyate so'pi puṇyadeśa ityāha viṣṇuḥ -- cāturvarṇyavyavasthānaṃ yasmin deśe ca vidyate| dharmadeśaḥ sa vijñeyo hyāryāvartastataḥ paraḥ|| iti|
analyzed: etad catuṣṭaya alābhe punar deśa antaram āha manuḥ kṛṣṇasāraḥ tu carati mṛgaḥ yatra svabhāvataḥ yajña deśaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ mleccha deśaḥ tatas paraḥ iti ukta alābhe api yasmin deśe cāturvarṇya vyavasthā dṛśyate saḥ api puṇya deśaḥ iti āha viṣṇuḥ cāturvarṇya vyavasthānam yasmin deśe ca vidyate dharma deśaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ hi āryāvartaḥ tatas paraḥ iti

original: saṃvarto yājñavalkyaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ śaṅkha eva ca| āryāvartaṃ vadantyete deśaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgāśrayam|| ukteṣveṣu kvacidapavādamāha manuḥ -- na śūdrarājye nivasennādhārmikajanāvṛte| na pāṣaṇḍajanākrānte nopaspṛṣṭe'ntyajairnṛbhiḥ|| iti| atrāpyapavādamāha pitāmahaḥ -- śūdradeśe'pi nivasedyatra madhye tu jāhnavī| so'pi puṇyatamo deśo'nāryairapi samāśritaḥ||
analyzed: saṃvartaḥ yājñavalkyaḥ ca vasiṣṭhaḥ śaṅkhaḥ eva ca āryāvartam vadanti ete deśam kṛṣṇa mṛga āśrayam ukteṣu eṣu kvacid apavādam āha manuḥ na śūdra rājye nivaset na adhārmika jana āvṛte na pāṣaṇḍa jana ākrānte na upaspṛṣṭā intyajaiḥ nṛbhiḥ iti atra api apavādam āha pitāmahaḥ śūdra deśe api nivaset yatra madhye tu jāhnavī saḥ api puṇyatamaḥ deśaḥ ūna āryaiḥ api samāśritaḥ

original: iti| atra jāhnavīśabdaḥ puṇyatīrthadevatāyatanasaṃyuktadeśamātropalakṣakaḥ||
analyzed: iti atra jāhnavī śabdaḥ puṇya tīrtha devatāyatana saṃyukta deśa mātra upalakṣakaḥ

original: niṣiddhadeśāḥ
analyzed: niṣiddha deśāḥ

original: atha niṣiddhadeśāḥ| atra bodhāyanaḥ -- ānartāścāṅgamagadhāḥ saurāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ| upāvṛtsindhusauvīrā ete saṅkīrṇayonayaḥ|| ādityapurāṇe taddeśagamane doṣamāha -- narmadāsindhukauśikyāḥ pāraṃ padmasya paścimam| gatvā narakamāpnoti tīrthakālādhikaṃ vasan|| aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāśca ugramālavikāstathā| narmadādakṣiṇaṃ yacca sindhoruttarameva ca||
analyzed: atha niṣiddha deśāḥ atra bodhāyanaḥ ānartāḥ ca aṅga magadhāḥ saurāṣṭrāḥ dakṣiṇāpathāḥ upāvṛt sindhusauvīrāḥ ete saṅkīrṇa yonayaḥ ādityapurāṇe tad deśa gamane doṣam āha narmadā sindhukauśikyāḥ pāram padmasya paścimam gatvā narakam āpnoti tīrtha kāla adhikam vasan aṅga vaṅga kaliṅgāḥ ca ugra mālavikāḥ tathā narmadā dakṣiṇam yat ca sindhoḥ uttaram eva ca

original: pauṇḍrāścaiva caidyamāgadhikāḥ kaṣāḥ| na vivāhaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ yajñaṃ caiṣu samācaret|| pāpadeśāśca ye kecitpāpairadhyuṣitā janaiḥ| gatvā deśānapuṇyāṃstu kṛtsnaṃ pāpaṃ samaśnute|| saurāṣṭraṃ sindhusauvīraṃ cāvantyaṃ dakṣiṇāpatham| pañcaitān kāmato gatvā kaliṅgāṃśca pated‌dvijaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: pauṇḍrāḥ ca eva caidya māgadhikāḥ kaṣāḥ na vivāham tathā śrāddham yajñam ca eṣu samācaret pāpa deśāḥ ca ye kecid pāpaiḥ adhyuṣitāḥ janaiḥ gatvā deśān apuṇyān tu kṛtsnam pāpam samaśnute saurāṣṭram sindhusauvīram ca avantyam dakṣiṇāpatham pañca etān kāmataḥ gatvā kaliṅgān ca patet dvijaḥ iti

original: teṣāṃ dvijānāmāpadi vṛttyarthaṃ deśānugrahaḥ skāndapurāṇe darśitaḥ -- aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāndhrapārvateyān kaṣāṃstathā| sindhusauvīrasaurāṣṭrān pāradārāṃśca mālavān|| nivāsayedvijo nityamanāpadi vivarjayet| etānatyāpadi gṛhī saṃśrayedvṛttikarśitaḥ|| iti| ityādiniṣaddhadeśanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: teṣām dvijānām āpadi vṛtti artham deśa anugrahaḥ skāndapurāṇe darśitaḥ aṅga vaṅga kaliṅga andhra pārvateyān kaṣān tathā sindhusauvīra saurāṣṭrān pāradārān ca mālavān nivāsayet vijaḥ nityam anāpadi vivarjayet etān ati āpadi gṛhī saṃśrayet vṛtti karśitaḥ iti ityādi niṣaddha deśa nirūpaṇam

original: niṣiddhadeśāpavādaḥ|
analyzed: niṣiddha deśa apavādaḥ

original: atha niṣiddhadeśeṣu keṣucidapavāda ucyate| pitāmahaḥ -- śūdrarājye'pi nivasedyatra madhye tu jāhnavī| so'pi puṇyatamo deśo'nāryairapi samāśritaḥ| dharmaśāstrasāre -- candrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi mahāsāntapanāni ca| prāyaścittānyudīryante yatra gaṅgā na vidyate|| gaṅgāśabdārtho'pi tatraiva nirūpitaḥ -- kāverī tuṅgabhadrā ca kṛṣṇaveṇī ca gautamī|
analyzed: atha niṣiddha deśeṣu keṣucid apavādaḥ ucyate pitāmahaḥ śūdra rājye api nivaset yatra madhye tu jāhnavī saḥ api puṇyatamaḥ deśaḥ ūna āryaiḥ api samāśritaḥ dharmaśāstra sāre candrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi mahāsāntapanāni ca prāyaścittāni udīryante yatra gaṅgā na vidyate gaṅgā śabda arthaḥ api tatra eva nirūpitaḥ kāverī tuṅgabhadrā ca kṛṣṇaveṇī ca gautamī

original: bhāgīrathīti vikhyātāḥ pañca gagāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| iti| ādityapurāṇe -- yatra gaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā sa deśastūttamo vanam| siddhakṣetraṃ ca tañjñeyaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam|| prabhāse puṣkare kāṃśyāṃ naimiśe'marakuṇḍake| gaṅgāyāṃ sarayūtīre nivaseddhārmiko janaḥ|| ityādi| iti niṣiddhadeśāpavādaḥ||
analyzed: bhāgīrathī iti vikhyātāḥ pañca gagāḥ prakīrtitāḥ iti ādityapurāṇe yatra gaṅgā sarit śreṣṭhā sa deśaḥ tu uttamaḥ vanam siddha kṣetram ca tat jñeyam gaṅgā tīra samāśritam prabhāse puṣkare kāṃśyām naimiśa imarakuṇḍake gaṅgāyām sarayū tīre nivaset dhārmikaḥ janaḥ ityādi iti niṣiddha deśa apavādaḥ

original: deśadharmāḥ
analyzed: deśa dharmāḥ

original: atha deśadharmāḥ| pañcadhā pratipattirhi dākṣiṇātyeṣu dṛśyate| putreṇānupanītena pantyā ca sahabhojanam|| pitṛṣvasurmātulasya putryāścodvāhanaṃ tathā| tathā paryuṣitānnasya bhojanaṃ paridṛśyate|| tathā vikraya ūrṇāyā jīvanaṃ cāyudhīyakam| vyavahāraścobhayatodadbhirvāridhiyānakam|| sindhuyānamudīcyānāṃ pratipattiśca pañcadhā|
analyzed: atha deśa dharmāḥ pañcadhā pratipattiḥ hi dākṣiṇātyeṣu dṛśyate putreṇa anupanītena pantyā ca sahabhojanam pitṛṣvasuḥ mātulasya putryāḥ ca udvāhanam tathā tathā paryuṣita annasya bhojanam paridṛśyate tathā vikrayaḥ ūrṇāyāḥ jīvanam ca āyudhīyakam vyavahāraḥ ca ubhayatas dadbhiḥ vāridhi yānakam sindhuyānam udīcyānām pratipattiḥ ca pañcadhā

original: evamanye viruddhāni dṛśyante deśabhedataḥ|| abhartṛkabhrātṛbhāryāgrahaṇaṃ cātidūṣitam| kule kanyāpradānaṃ ca deśeṣvanyeṣu dṛśyate|| tathā mātṛvivāho'pi pārasīkeṣu dṛśyate| viruddheṣveṣu dharmeṣu prāmāṇyaṃ deśato bhavet|| atra bṛhaspatiḥ -- deśajātikulānāṃ ca ye dharmāstatpravartitāḥ| tathaiva te pālanīyāḥ prajā prakṣubhyate'nyathā||
analyzed: evam anye viruddhāni dṛśyante deśa bhedataḥ abhartṛka bhrātṛ bhāryā grahaṇam ca ati dūṣitam kule kanyā pradānam ca deśeṣu anyeṣu dṛśyate tathā mātṛ vivāhaḥ api pārasīkeṣu dṛśyate viruddheṣu eṣu dharmeṣu prāmāṇyam deśataḥ bhavet atra bṛhaspatiḥ deśa jāti kulānām ca ye dharmāḥ tad pravartitāḥ tathā eva te pālanīyāḥ prajā prakṣubhyate nyathā

original: devalo'pi -- yeṣu deśeṣu ye vedā yeṣu deśeṣu ye dvijāḥ| yeṣu deśeṣu yattoyaṃ yā ca tatraivamṛttikā|| yeṣu sthāneṣu yacchaucaṃ dharmācāraśca yādṛśaḥ| tatra tānnāvamanyeta dharmastatraiva tādṛśaḥ|| yasmin deśe pure grāme traividye nagare'pi vā| yo yatra vihito dharmastaṃ dharmaṃ na vicāla(ra) yet|| iti|
analyzed: yeṣu deśeṣu ye vedāḥ yeṣu deśeṣu ye dvijāḥ yeṣu deśeṣu yat toyam yā ca tatra eva mṛttikā yeṣu sthāneṣu yat śaucam dharma ācāraḥ ca yādṛśaḥ tatra tān na avamanyeta dharmaḥ tatra eva tādṛśaḥ yasmin deśe pure grāme traividye nagare api vā yaḥ yatra vihitaḥ dharmaḥ tam dharmam na iti

original: aviśeṣeṇa deśadharmaprāmāṇyaprasaktau mānāviruddhaṃ grāhyamityāha manuḥ -- sadbhirācaritaṃ yatsyāddhārmikaiśca dvijātibhiḥ| taddeśakulajātānāmaviruddhaṃ prakalpayet|| iti| yat sadbhirācaritaṃ tat śrutyādipramāṇāviruddhaṃ taddeśakulajātānāṃ dharmatvena prakalpayedityarthaḥ| `śāstraduṣṭaṃ yathā tyājyaṃ tathā lokavirodhyapi'|
analyzed: aviśeṣeṇa deśa dharma prāmāṇya prasaktau māna aviruddham grāhyam iti āha manuḥ sadbhiḥ ācaritam yat syāt dhārmikaiḥ ca dvijātibhiḥ tat deśa kula jātānām aviruddham prakalpayet iti yat sadbhiḥ ācaritam tat śruti ādi pramāṇa aviruddham tat deśa kula jātānām dharma tvena prakalpayet iti arthaḥ śāstra duṣṭam yathā tyājyam tathā loka virodhi api

original: tatra mihiraḥ dośācārastāvadādau vicintyo deśe deśe yā sthitiḥ saivakāryā| lokadviṣṭaṃ paṇḍitā varjayanti daivajño'to lokamārgeṇa yāyāt|| ityādi| iti deśadharmanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: tatra mihiraḥ dośa ācāraḥ tāvat ādau vicintyaḥ deśe deśe yā sthitiḥ sa eva kāryā loka dviṣṭam paṇḍitāḥ varjayanti daiva jña ūtaḥ loka mārgeṇa yāyāt ityādi iti deśa dharma nirūpaṇam

original: yugadharmāḥ|
analyzed: yuga dharmāḥ

original: atha yugadharmāḥ| āraṇyaparvaṃṇi -- kṛtaṃ nāma yugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ| kṛtameva na kartavyaṃ tasmin kāle yugottame|| na tatra sīmāḥ sīdanti na jīryante ca vai prajāḥ| tataḥ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālena guṇatāṃ gatam|| kṛte yuge catuṣpādaṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ ca śāśvatam| etat kṛtayugaṃ nāma traiguṇyaparivarjanam||
analyzed: atha yuga dharmāḥ āraṇyaparvaṃṇi kṛtam nāma yugam śreṣṭham yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ kṛtam eva na kartavyam tasmin kāle yuga uttame na tatra sīmāḥ sīdanti na jīryante ca vai prajāḥ tatas kṛta yugam nāma kālena guṇatām gatam kṛte yuge catuṣpādam cāturvarṇyam ca śāśvatam etat kṛta yugam nāma traiguṇya parivarjanam

original: pādena hrasate dharmo raktatāṃ yāti cācyutaḥ| jñānapravṛttāśca narāḥ kriyādharmaparāyaṇāḥ|| tato yajñāḥ pravartante dharmāśca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ| svadharmasthāḥ kriyāvanto janāstretāyuge'bhavan|| viṣṇuḥ pītatvamāyāti caturdhā veda eva ca| satyasyaiva hi vibhraṃśo satye kaścidavasthitaḥ|| satyāt pracyavamānānāṃ vyādhayo bahavo'bhavan|
analyzed: pādena hrasate dharmaḥ rakta tām yāti ca acyutaḥ jñāna pravṛttāḥ ca narāḥ kriyā dharma parāyaṇāḥ tatas yajñāḥ pravartante dharmāḥ ca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ svadharma sthāḥ kriyāvantaḥ janāḥ tretā yuge bhavan viṣṇuḥ pīta tvam āyāti caturdhā vedaḥ eva ca satyasya eva hi satye kaścid avasthitaḥ satyāt pracyavamānānām vyādhayaḥ bahavaḥ bhavan

original: kāmāścopadravāścaiva tathā daivatakāritāḥ|| kāmakāmā hyarthakāmā yajñāṃstanvanti cāpare| evaṃ dvāparamāsādya prajāḥ kṣīyantyadharmataḥ|| pādenaikena kaunteya dharmaḥ kaliyuge sthitaḥ| vedācārāḥ praśāmyante dharmā yajñāḥ kriyāstathā|| ītayo vyādhayastandrī doṣāḥ krodhādayastathā|| iti| bhidyante yugadharmāste yugabhedānusārataḥ|

original: kālasvarūpaṃ, tadviśeṣāśca athedānīṃ karmaṇaḥ kālasādhyatvāt kālasvarūpaṃ tadviśeṣāśca nirṇīyante| śrutismṛtyuktakarmaṇaśca kālādhīnatvam `amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena carantī'ti śrutau piṇḍapitṛyajñasyāmāvāsyāparāhṇādikālasāpekṣatvena, tathā `darśe snātvā pitṛbhyastu dadyātkṛṣṇatilodakam|
