original: annaṃ ca vidhivaddadyāt santatistena vardhata'ti smṛtau tilodakadānāderuktakālasāpekṣatvena ca, tathā `amāvāsyāyāṃ nādhīyīta nādhyāpayennacchindyādārdrān dārūn nādyādannaṃ parasye'ti, `amāvāsyāyāṃ na gacchet prāptakālāmapi striyam|
analyzed: annam ca vidhivat dadyāt santatiḥ tena smṛtau tila udaka dāna ādeḥ ukta kāla sāpekṣa tvena ca tathā amāvāsyāyām na adhīyīta na adhyāpayet na chindyāt ārdrān dārūn na adyāt annam parasya iti amāvāsyāyām na gacchet prāpta kālām api striyam

original: tailaṃ ca na spṛśedāmaṃ vṛkṣādīṃśca na chedayedi'ti vidhiniṣedhayoruktakālasāpekṣatvena, tathā `paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yajet,' `amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ sāyaṃ juhoti prātarjuhotī'tyādau ca kālasāpekṣatvenāvagamyate| ata eva kālaḥ karmāṅgameva, na pradhānamityavagantavyam| sa ca kālo dvividhaḥ| sāmānyarūpo viśeṣarūpaśceti|
analyzed: tailam ca na spṛśet āmam vṛkṣa ādīn ca na chedayet iti vidhi niṣedhayoḥ ukta kāla sāpekṣa tvena tathā paurṇamāsyām paurṇamāsyām yajet amāvāsyāyām amāvāsyāyām sāyam juhoti prātar juhoti ityādau ca kāla sāpekṣa tvena avagamyate atas eva kālaḥ karma aṅgam eva na pradhānam iti avagantavyam sa ca kālaḥ dvividhaḥ sāmānya rūpaḥ viśeṣa rūpaḥ ca iti

original: kālaviśeṣeṣu sarveṣvapyanusyūtaḥ nakṣatragrahaparatvādyanumeyaḥ sāmānyakālaḥ, nimeṣādistadviśeṣaḥ| taduktaṃ bhāratekarṣeṇāpyadhikaiḥ ṣaṅ‌bhiḥ palaistāmrasya bhājanam| triṃśadaṅ‌gulavistāramucchritaṃ caturaṅgulam|| svarṇamātreṇa kṛtvā ca caturaṅgulakārṣikāḥ| madhyabhāgatayā viddhā nāḍikā ghaṭikā smṛtā||
analyzed: kāla viśeṣeṣu sarveṣu api anusyūtaḥ nakṣatra graha paratva ādi anumeyaḥ sāmānya kālaḥ nimeṣa ādiḥ tad viśeṣaḥ tat uktam bhārate karṣeṇa api adhikaiḥ ṣaṅbhiḥ palaiḥ tāmrasya bhājanam triṃśat aṅgula vistāram ucchritam catur aṅgulam svarṇa mātreṇa kṛtvā ca catur aṅgula kārṣikāḥ madhya bhāga tayā viddhāḥ nāḍikāḥ ghaṭikā smṛtā

original: tadranghreṇāmbhasā pātraṃ yāvatkālena pūryate| sa kālo nāḍikā tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭibhāgo vināḍikā|| nāḍīdvayaṃ muhūrtastu te pañcadaśa vāsaraḥ| evaṃ rātristathā pakṣamāsartvayanavatsarāḥ|| iti||
analyzed: tad ranghreṇa ambhasā pātram yāvat kālena pūryate sa kālaḥ nāḍikā tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭi bhāgaḥ vināḍikā nāḍī dvayam muhūrtaḥ tu te pañcadaśa vāsaraḥ evam rātriḥ tathā pakṣa māsa ṛtu ayana vatsarāḥ iti

original: saṃvatsaranāmāni| ete saṃvatsarāḥ prabhavādibhedena ṣaṣṭisaṅkhyākāḥ| taduktam -- prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodo'tha prajāpatiḥ āṅgīrasaḥ śrīmukhaśca bhāvo'tha yuvavatsaraḥ|| dhātvīśvarau bahudhānyaḥ pramāthī vikramo viṣuḥ| citrabhānuḥ svabhānuśca tāraṇaḥ pārthivo vyayaḥ|| sarvajit sarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtiḥ kharaḥ|
analyzed: saṃvatsara nāmāni ete saṃvatsarāḥ prabhava ādi bhedena ṣaṣṭi saṅkhyākāḥ tat uktam prabhavaḥ vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodaḥ utha prajāpatiḥ āṅgīrasaḥ śrīmukhaḥ ca yuvavatsaraḥ dhātvīśvarau bahudhānyaḥ pramāthī vikramaḥ viṣuḥ citrabhānuḥ svabhānuḥ ca tāraṇaḥ pārthivaḥ vyayaḥ sarvajit sarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtiḥ kharaḥ

original: nandano vijayaścaiva jayo manmathadurmukhau(khī)|| hemalambī vilambī ca vikārī śārvarī plavaḥ| śubhakṛt krodhī viśvāvasuparābhavau|| plavaṅgaḥ kīlakaḥ saumyaḥ sādhāraṇavirodhikṛte| parīdhāvī pramādī ca ānando rākṣaso nalaḥ|| piṅgalaḥ kālayuktākṣī siddhārthī raudridurmatī| dundubhī rudhurodgārī raktākṣī krodhanaḥ kṣayaḥ|| iti||
analyzed: nandanaḥ vijayaḥ ca eva jayaḥ manmatha durmukha okhī hemalambī vilambī ca vikārī śārvarī plavaḥ śubhakṛt krodhī viśvāvasu parābhavau plavaṅgaḥ kīlakaḥ saumyaḥ sādhāraṇa virodhi kṛte parīdhāvī pramādī ca ānandaḥ rākṣasaḥ nalaḥ piṅgalaḥ kāla yukta akṣī siddhārthī raudri durmatī dundubhī rudhura udgārī raktākṣī krodhanaḥ kṣayaḥ iti

original: cāndrādisaṃvatsaranirṇayaḥ| tatra cāndraprabhavādīnāmupakramaścaitrapratipadītyuktaṃ dīpikāyām -- `cāndromadhuśuklapratipadārambha' iti| meṣasthe sūrye sauraprabhavādīnāmupakramaḥ| sāvanastvaicchikaḥ| yattu viṣṇudharmottare māghaśuklasamārambhe candrārkau vāsavarkṣagau| jīvaśukrau yathā syātāṃ ṣaṣṭyabdādistathā smṛtaḥ||
analyzed: cāndra ādi saṃvatsara nirṇayaḥ tatra cāndra prabhava ādīnām upakramaḥ caitra pratipadī iti uktam dīpikāyām cāndraḥ madhu śukla pratipad ārambhaḥ iti meṣa sthe sūrye saura prabhava ādīnām upakramaḥ sāvanaḥ tu aicchikaḥ yat tu viṣṇudharmottare māgha śukla samārambhe candra arkau vāsava ṛkṣa gau jīva śukrau yathā syātām ṣaṣṭi abda ādiḥ tathā smṛtaḥ

original: iti māghaśuklapratipadupakramatvaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāmuktam| tajjyotiḥ śāstraprasiddhaśubhāśubhaphalapratipādanārthaṃ, na tu karmānuṣṭhānārthamityavagantavyam| vatsarādau pravṛttasyaivānuṣṭhānopayogitvāt| tadāhārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ -- smaret sarvatra karmādau cāndraṃ saṃvatsaraṃ sadā| nānyaṃ yasmādvatsarādau pravṛttistasya kīrtitā|| iti|
analyzed: iti māgha śukla pratipad upakrama tvam saṃvatsarāṇām uktam tat jyotiḥ śāstra prasiddha śubha aśubha phala pratipādana artham na tu karma anuṣṭhāna artham iti avagantavyam vatsara ādau pravṛttasya eva anuṣṭhāna upayogi tvāt tat āha ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ smaret sarvatra karma ādau cāndram saṃvatsaram sadā na anyam yasmāt vatsara ādau pravṛttiḥ tasya kīrtitā iti

original: tatra cāndrasyāvāntarabhedā ucyante -- saṃvatsarastu prathamo dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ| iḍāvatsarastṛtīyaśca caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ|| udvatsaraḥ pañcamastu tatsaṅgho yugasaṃ (jñakaḥ)jñitaḥ|| iti| prabhavamārabhya kṣayānteṣu sarveṣu dvādaśa pañcakāni| tatraikasmin pañcake krameṇa saṃvatsarādayo bhavanti| etatsarvaṃ jyotiśśāstre prasiddham|
analyzed: tatra cāndrasya avāntarabhedāḥ ucyante saṃvatsaraḥ tu prathamaḥ dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ iḍāvatsaraḥ tṛtīyaḥ ca caturthaḥ ca anuvatsaraḥ udvatsaraḥ pañcamaḥ tu tad saṅghaḥ iti prabhavam ārabhya kṣaya anteṣu sarveṣu dvādaśa pañcakāni tatra ekasmin pañcake krameṇa saṃvatsara ādayaḥ bhavanti etat sarvam jyotiśśāstre prasiddham

original: vistarabhayānna likhyate| saurādīnāṃ trayāṇāmupayogo jyotirgargeṇa darśitaḥ -- sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ| ābdike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate|| iti| atra prathamādiśabdena upanayanapūjāvrataniyamapratiṣṭhāgṛhakaraṇayātrādayo gṛhyante| dvitīyādiśabdena dānahomagarbhādhānasīmantonnayanajātakarmaṛṇakrayavyāpārāṇāṃ grahaṇam|
analyzed: vistara bhayāt na likhyate saura ādīnām trayāṇām upayogaḥ jyotirgargeṇa darśitaḥ sauraḥ māsaḥ vivāha ādau yajña ādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ ābdike pitṛ kārye ca cāndraḥ māsaḥ praśasyate iti atra prathama ādi śabdena upanayana pūjā vrata niyama pratiṣṭhā gṛha karaṇa yātrā ādayaḥ gṛhyante dvitīya ādi śabdena dāna homa garbha ādhāna sīmantonnayana jātakarma ṛṇa kraya vyāpārāṇām grahaṇam

original: ābdike sāṃvatsaripamṛtāhaśrāddhe| pitṛkārya
analyzed: ābdike

original: e ṣāṇmāsikaśrāddhādau| caśabdānmāsasaṃvatsarasādhyayajñavyatirikte sarvasminneva kārye cāndro māsaḥ praśasyata ityuktaṃ hemādau|
analyzed: ṣāṇmāsika śrāddha ādau caśabdāt māsa saṃvatsara sādhya yajña vyatirikte sarvasmin eva kārye cāndraḥ māsaḥ praśasyate iti uktam hemādau

original: nanu vivāhādīnā `maṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīte'tyādau sāvanapuraskāreṇa pravṛttatvāt, `sauro māso vivāhādāvi'ti katham? tathā `yāsau vaiśākhyāmāvāsyāmādadhīte'ti cāndrāmāvāsyāyāmādhānavidhānād `vivāhavratayajñeṣu sauraṃ mānaṃ praśasyata' iti vacanena saure'pi vidhānādyajñādau sāvana iti katham?, tathā `kanyākumbhavṛṣasthe'rke kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu
analyzed: nanu vivāha ādīnām aṣṭa varṣam brāhmaṇam upanayīta ityādau sāvana puraskāreṇa pravṛtta tvāt sauraḥ māsaḥ vivāha ādau iti katham tathā yā asau vaiśākhyā amāvāsyām ādadhīta iti cāndra amāvāsyāyām ādhāna vidhānāt vivāha vrata yajñeṣu sauram mānam praśasyate iti vacanena saure api vidhānāt yajña ādau sāvane iti katham tathā kanyā kumbha vṛṣa stha irke kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu

original: sarvadā| anena vidhinā śrāddhaṃ paitṛvyamiha nirvapedi'tyādau sauramānenāpi pitṛkāryavidhānāt `ābdike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyata' iti kathamiti ced, na| ete saurādayaḥ keṣucit karmaviśeṣeṣūpasthitāḥ, keṣucidvikalpāḥ| te yathā bhaviṣyottare -- `caitraśuklapratipadamārabhya tilakavrataṃ kāryami'tyuktam| taccāndreṇaiva kartavyam|
analyzed: sarvadā anena vidhinā śrāddham paitṛvyam iha nirvapet ityādau saura mānena api pitṛ kārya vidhānāt ābdike pitṛ kārye ca cāndraḥ māsaḥ praśasyate iti katham iti ced na ete saura ādayaḥ keṣucid karma viśeṣeṣu upasthitāḥ keṣucid vikalpāḥ te yathā bhaviṣyottare caitra śukla pratipadam ārabhya tilaka vratam kāryam iti uktam tat cāndreṇa eva kartavyam

original: śuklakṛṣṇapratipadādīnāṃ saurasāvanānupajīvanāt| yattu viṣṇudharmottare -- `meṣasaṅkramaṇe bhānau sopavāso narottame'ti sujanmāvāptivratādikamuktam, tatsaureṇaiva kartavyam| yattu saṃvatsarasādhyagavāmayanādikaṃ, tatsāvanenaiva kartavyam| cāndrasya ṣaḍ‌bhirahorātrairnyūnatvāt| saurasya pañcabhurahorātrairadhikatvāt|
analyzed: śukla kṛṣṇa pratipad ādīnām saura sāvana anupajīvanāt yat tu viṣṇudharmottare meṣa saṅkramaṇe bhānau sa upavāsaḥ nara uttama iti sujanma avāpti vrata ādikam uktam tat saureṇa eva kartavyam yat tu saṃvatsara sādhya gavāmayana ādikam tat sāvanena eva kartavyam cāndrasya ṣaḍbhiḥ ahorātraiḥ nyūna tvāt saurasya pañca ahorātraiḥ adhika tvāt

original: nirūḍhapaśubandhe'pi cāndra eva| `amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ce'ti sūtrakāraiścāndratithau tadanuṣṭhānavidhānāt| tathāca etādṛśasthaleṣūpasthitaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ| anyatra tu upanayanavivāhādiṣu vikalpā iti mādhavīye'bhihitam| apare tu `praśasyata' iti vacanasvārasyāt kvacit kasyacit praśastatvamityāhuḥ| tadevaṃ cāndrādīnāmupayogo draṣṭavya iti||
analyzed: nirūḍhapaśubandhe api cāndraḥ eva amāvāsyāyām paurṇamāsyām ca iti sūtrakāraiḥ cāndra tithau tad anuṣṭhāna vidhānāt tathā ca etādṛśa sthaleṣu upasthitaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ anyatra tu upanayana vivāha ādiṣu vikalpāḥ iti mādhavīye abhihitam apare tu praśasyate iti vacana svārasyāt kvacid kasyacid praśasta tvam iti āhuḥ tat evam cāndra ādīnām upayogaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti

original: itisaṃvatsaranirṇayaḥ||
analyzed: iti saṃvatsara nirṇayaḥ

original: saṃvatsaranirṇayopayogaḥ| etadvatsaranirṇayasyopayoga ucyate -- bhagavan! karmaṇā kena tiryagyonau na jāyate| mlecchadeśe ca puruṣastanmamācakṣva vai mune!|| mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- `meṣasaṃkramaṇe bhānau sopavāso dvijottamaḥ|
analyzed: saṃvatsara nirṇaya upayogaḥ etad vatsara nirṇayasya upayogaḥ ucyate bhagavan karmaṇā kena tiryagyonau na jāyate mleccha deśe ca puruṣaḥ tat mama ācakṣva vai mune mārkaṇḍeyaḥ meṣa saṃkramaṇe bhānau sa upavāsaḥ dvijottamaḥ

original: pūjayedbhārgavaṃ devaṃ rāmaṃ śaktyā yathāvidhī'tyārabhya `mīnasaṃkramaṇe matsyaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca pūjayedi'tyantena mārkaṇḍeyoktasujanmavrataṃ, māsike cābdike vastradhānyasvarṇādivṛddhiṣu| bhṛtyopakalpanādau ca māsābdau saurasāvanau||
analyzed: pūjayet bhārgavam devam rāmam śaktyā yathāvidhi iti ārabhya mīna saṃkramaṇe matsyam vāsudevam ca pūjayet iti antena mārkaṇḍeya ukta sujanma vratam māsike ca ābdike vastra dhānya svarṇa ādi vṛddhiṣu bhṛtya upakalpanā ādau ca māsa abdau saura sāvanau

original: ityādiko vyāpāraḥ, tathā `anantasya vrataṃ kāryaṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ce'tyādyuktānantavratādikaṃ, tathā bhāgavatoktamaśūnyaśayanavratādikaṃ ca, tathā vatsaranirvartyasarvāṇyapi karmāṇyetasya phalam||
analyzed: ityādikaḥ vyāpāraḥ tathā anantasya vratam kāryam nava varṣāṇi pañca ca ityādi ukta ananta vrata ādikam tathā bhāgavata uktam a śūnya śayana vrata ādikam ca tathā vatsara nirvartya sarvāṇi api karmāṇi etasya phalam

original: yuganirṇayaḥ atha yuganirṇayaḥ -- pitryadaivādyahorātrādikrameṇa yugasvarūpamāha manuḥ -- pitrye rātryahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgastu pakṣayoḥ| karmaceṣṭāsvahaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī|| pravibhāga ucyata iti śeṣaḥ| karmaceṣṭāsu karmaceṣṭārthamityarthaḥ| daive rātryahanī varṣaṃ pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ| ahastatrodagayanaṃ rātriḥ syāddakṣiṇāyanam||
analyzed: yuga nirṇayaḥ atha yuga nirṇayaḥ pitrya daiva ādi ahorātra ādi krameṇa yuga svarūpam āha manuḥ pitrye rātri ahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgaḥ tu pakṣayoḥ karma ceṣṭāsu ahar kṛṣṇaḥ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī pravibhāgaḥ ucyate iti śeṣaḥ karma ceṣṭāsu karma ceṣṭā artham iti arthaḥ daive rātri ahanī varṣam pravibhāgaḥ tayoḥ punar ahar tatra udagayanam rātriḥ syāt dakṣiṇāyanam

original: brāhmasya tu kṣapāhasya pramāṇaṃ yatsamāsataḥ| ekaikaśo yugānāṃ tu kramaśastannibodhata|| brāhmasya hairaṇyagarbhasya| pramāṇaṃ parimāṇam| catvāryāhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ yugam| tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tathāvidhaḥ|| varṣāṇāṃ devavarṣāṇām| sandhyā yugārambhakālaḥ| sandhyāṃśaḥ yugāvasānakālaḥ|
analyzed: brāhmasya tu kṣapā ahasya pramāṇam yat samāsatas ekaikaśas yugānām tu kramaśas tat nibodhata brāhmasya hairaṇyagarbhasya pramāṇam parimāṇam catvāri āhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇām tu kṛtam yugam tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyā aṃśaḥ ca tathāvidhaḥ varṣāṇām deva varṣāṇām sandhyā yuga ārambha kālaḥ sandhyāṃśaḥ yuga avasāna kālaḥ

original: itareṣu sasandhyeṣu sasandhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu| ekāpāyena vartante sahastrāṇi śatāni ca|| itareṣu tretādvāparakaliṣu| ekāpāyena ekalopena| yadetat parisaṅkhyātamādāveva caturyugam| etad dvādaśasāhastraṃ devānāṃ yugamucyate|| daivikānāṃ yugānāṃ tu sahastraparisaṃkhyayā| brāhmamekamaharjñeyaṃ tāvatī rātrireva ca|| iti|
analyzed: itareṣu sa sandhyeṣu sa sandhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu eka apāyena vartante sahastrāṇi śatāni ca itareṣu tretā dvāpara kaliṣu eka apāyena eka lopena yat etat parisaṅkhyātam ādau eva caturyugam etat dvādaśa sāhastram devānām yugam ucyate daivikānām yugānām tu sahastra parisaṃkhyayā brāhmam ekam ahar jñeyam tāvatī rātriḥ eva ca iti

original: mahābhārate āraṇyaparvaṇyapi -- catvāryāhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ yugam| tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tataḥ paraḥ| trīṇi varṣasahastrāṇi tretāsyātparimāṇataḥ| tasyāstāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tataḥ paraḥ|| atha varṣasahastre dve dvāparaṃ parimāṇataḥ| tasyāpi dviśatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tataḥ paraḥ||
analyzed: mahābhārate āraṇyaparvaṇi api catvāri āhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇām tu kṛtam yugam tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyā aṃśaḥ ca tatas paraḥ trīṇi varṣa sahastrāṇi tretā āsyāt parimāṇataḥ tasyāḥ tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyā aṃśaḥ ca tatas paraḥ atha varṣa sahastre dve dvāparam parimāṇataḥ tasya api dviśatī sandhyā sandhyā aṃśaḥ ca tatas paraḥ

original: sahastramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tathā kaliyugaṃ smṛtam| tasya varṣaśataṃ sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca tataḥ paraḥ|| sandhyāsandhyāṃśayostulyaṃ pramāṇamavadhāraya| kṣīṇe kaliyuge caiva pravartati kṛtaṃ yugam|| eṣā dvādaśasāhastrī yugasaṃkhyā prakīrtitā| etatsahastraparyantamaho brāhmamudāhṛtam|| ityādi| iti yuganirṇayaḥ||
analyzed: sahastram ekam varṣāṇām tathā kali yugam smṛtam tasya varṣa śatam sandhyā sandhyā aṃśaḥ ca tatas paraḥ sandhyā sandhyāṃśayoḥ tulyam pramāṇam avadhāraya kṣīṇe kali yuge ca eva pravartati kṛtam yugam eṣā dvādaśa sāhastrī yuga saṃkhyā prakīrtitā etat sahastra paryantam ahar brāhmam udāhṛtam ityādi iti yuga nirṇayaḥ

original: ṛtunirṇayaḥ atha yathākramamayananirṇayaḥ| yātyanena ṛtutrayeṇa sūryo dakṣiṇādidiśamiti ṛtutrayamayanam|| tathāca śrutiḥ -- `tasmādādityaḥ ṣāṇmāso dakṣiṇenaiti ṣaḍḍattareṇaitī'ti| idaṃ tu saurameva| sūryamupajīvya pravṛttatvāt|
analyzed: ṛtu nirṇayaḥ atha yathākramam ayana nirṇayaḥ yāti anena ṛtu trayeṇa sūryaḥ dakṣiṇā ādidiśam iti ṛtu trayam ayanam tathā ca śrutiḥ tasmāt ādityaḥ ṣāṇmāsaḥ dakṣiṇena eti ṣaṣ attareṇa eti iti idam tu sauram eva sūryam upajīvya pravṛtta tvāt

original: atrottarāyaṇe kartavyaṃ dakṣiṇāyane niṣiddhaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstre pratipāditam -- gṛhapraveśastridaśapratiṣṭhā vivāhacaula (mauñjī)vratabandhapūrvam| saumyāyane karma śubhapradaṃ syādyadgarhitaṃ tatkhalu dakṣiṇāyane|| iti| dakṣiṇāyane ugradevatāpratiṣṭhādikaṃ kartavyamityuktaṃ vaikhānasasaṃhitāyām -- mātṛbhairavavārāhanārasiṃhatrivikramāḥ|
analyzed: atra uttarāyaṇe kartavyam dakṣiṇāyane niṣiddham ca jyotiḥśāstre pratipāditam gṛha praveśaḥ tridaśa pratiṣṭhā vivāha caula mauñjīvrata bandha pūrvam saumyāyane karma śubha pradam syāt yat garhitam tat khalu dakṣiṇāyane iti dakṣiṇāyane ugra devatā pratiṣṭhā ādikam kartavyam iti uktam vaikhānasasaṃhitāyām mātṛ bhairava vārāha nārasiṃha trivikramāḥ

original: mahiṣāsurasaṃhartrī sthāpyā vai dakṣiṇāyane|| iti| ityayananirṇayaḥ||
analyzed: mahiṣa asura saṃhartrī sthāpyā vai dakṣiṇāyane iti iti ayana nirṇayaḥ

original: atha ṛtunirṇayaḥ| `ṛ gatāvi' tyasmāddhātorniṣpanna ṛtuśabdaḥ| iyarti gacchatīti vasantādikālaviśeṣavācaka ṛtuśabdaḥ| sa cāśokapuṣpavikāsādyasādhāraṇaliṅgenānumeya iti mādhavīye| saṃvatsarāvayavabhūtamāsadvandve rūḍho'yam ṛtuśabda ityeke | sa ca ṛtuḥ ṣoḍhā -- vasantagrīṣmavarṣāśca śaraddhemantaśiśirā iti| tatra śrutiḥ -- `ṣaḍ‌vā ṛtava' iti|
analyzed: atha ṛtu nirṇayaḥ ṛ gatau iti asmāt dhātoḥ niṣpannaḥ ṛtu śabdaḥ iyarti gacchati iti vasanta ādi kāla viśeṣa vācakaḥ ṛtu śabdaḥ sa ca aśoka puṣpa vikāsa ādya sādhāraṇa liṅgena anumeyaḥ iti mādhavīye saṃvatsara avayava bhūta māsa dvandve rūḍhaḥ yam ṛtu śabdaḥ iti eke sa ca ṛtuḥ ṣoḍhā vasanta grīṣma varṣāḥ ca śarad hemanta śiśirāḥ iti tatra śrutiḥ ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ iti

original: nanu `dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartava' iti śruteḥ kathaṃ ṣāḍ‌vidhyamiti cenna| hemantaśiśirayoraikyābhiprāyeṇa pañcatvasyo (saṃkhyo) papatteḥ| `hemantaśiśirāvṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmī'ti śruteḥ| ete vasantādaya ṛtavo dvividhāḥ| cāndrāḥ saurāśceti| candragatiprakalpyatvāccāndraḥ|
analyzed: nanu dvādaśa māsāḥ pañca ṛtavaḥ iti śruteḥ katham ṣāḍvidhyam iti ced na hemanta śiśirayoḥ aikya abhiprāyeṇa pañcatvasya u saṃkhyā upapatteḥ hemanta śiśirau ṛtūnām prīṇāmi iti śruteḥ ete vasanta ādayaḥ ṛtavaḥ dvividhāḥ cāndrāḥ saurāḥ ca iti candra gati prakalpya tvāt cāndraḥ

original: saureṣu(tu) ṛtuṣu bodhāyanena `mīnameṣayormeṣavṛṣabhayorvā vasanta' ityabhidhānānmīnāditvaṃ meṣāditvaṃ ca vaikalpikaṃ vasantasyāṅgī kṛtam| tathāca tadanusārād grīṣmādayo'pi yathāyathaṃ vikalpyante| teṣāmupayogo `vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta, vasante brāhmaṇamupanayīte'tyādinā draṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: saureṣu tu ṛtuṣu bodhāyanena mīna meṣayoḥ meṣa vṛṣabhayoḥ vā vasantaḥ iti abhidhānāt mīna ādi tvam meṣa ādi tvam ca vaikalpikam vasantasya aṅgī kṛtam tathā ca tad anusārāt grīṣma ādayaḥ api yathāyatham vikalpyante teṣām upayogaḥ vasante brāhmaṇaḥ agnīn ādadhīta vasante brāhmaṇam upanayīta ityādinā draṣṭavyaḥ

original: atra cāndrāṇāmatiśayamāha trikāṇḍiḥ -- śrautasmārtakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kuryāccāndramasartuṣu| tadabhāve tu saurartuṣviti jyotirvidāṃmatam|| iti| iti ṛtunarṇayaḥ||
analyzed: atra cāndrāṇām atiśayam āha trikāṇḍiḥ śrauta smārta kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kuryāt cāndramasa ṛtuṣu tad abhāve tu saura ṛtuṣu iti jyotirvidām matam iti iti ṛtunā ṛṇayaḥ

original: māsanirṇayaḥ atha māsanirṇayaḥ kriyate| masyate parimīyate candravṛddhikṣayādiryeṣu kālaviśeṣeṣu sa māsaḥ| sa trividhaḥ cāndrasāvanasaurabhedāt| taduktaṃ brahmasiddhānte -- cāndraḥ śuklādidarśāntaḥ sāvanastriṃśatā dinaiḥ| ekarāśau raviryāvatkālaṃ māsaḥ sa bhāskaraḥ|| iti|
analyzed: māsa nirṇayaḥ atha māsa nirṇayaḥ kriyate masyate parimīyate candra vṛddhi kṣaya ādiḥ yeṣu kāla viśeṣeṣu sa māsaḥ sa trividhaḥ cāndra sāvana saura bhedāt tat uktam brahmasiddhānte cāndraḥ śukla ādi darśa antaḥ sāvanaḥ triṃśatā dinaiḥ eka rāśau raviḥ yāvatkālam māsaḥ sa bhāskaraḥ iti

original: cāndro māsaḥ śuklapratipadādidarśāntaḥ kṛṣṇapratipadādipūrṇimāntaśceti dvividhaḥ| tatrādyo `amāvāsyayā māsān sampādyāharutsṛjantī'ti, `indrāgni yatra hūyete māsādiḥ samprakīrtitaḥ| agnīṣomau tathā madhye samāptau pitṛsomakāvi'ti `cāndraḥ śuklādidarśānta' ityādiśrutismṛtisiddhaḥ| dvitīyastu `paurṇamāsyā māsān sampādyāharutsṛjanti|
analyzed: cāndraḥ māsaḥ śukla pratipad ādi darśa antaḥ kṛṣṇa pratipad ādi pūrṇimā antaḥ ca iti dvividhaḥ tatra ādyaḥ amāvāsyayā māsān sampādya ahar utsṛjanti iti indra agni yatra hūyete māsādiḥ samprakīrtitaḥ agnīṣomau tathā madhye samāptau pitṛ somakau iti cāndraḥ śukla ādi darśa antaḥ ityādi śruti smṛti siddhaḥ dvitīyaḥ tu paurṇamāsyā māsān sampādya ahar utsṛjanti

original: paurṇamāsyāṃ hi māsān sampaśyatī'tyādi śrutyādisiddhaḥ| atrobhayormadhye pūrṇimānte māse śruteḥ kaṭākṣo bhūyānityavagamyate|
analyzed: paurṇamāsyām hi māsān sampaśyati ityādi śruti ādi siddhaḥ atra ubhayoḥ madhye pūrṇimā ante māse śruteḥ kaṭākṣaḥ bhūyān iti avagamyate

original: `yo vai pūrṇa āśaṃcatī'tyādinā `yajñaṃ pratyavarohantī'tyantenārthavādena, `māso vai prajāpatiḥ tasya kṛṣṇapakṣa eva rayiḥ śuklaḥ prāṇa' ityātharvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣasyāditvenoktyā, tathā `āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine| māsi bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe'rdharātrake||
analyzed: yaḥ vai pūrṇaḥ āśaṃcati ityādinā yajñam pratyavarohanti iti antena arthavādena māsaḥ vai prajāpatiḥ tasya kṛṣṇa pakṣe eva rayiḥ śuklaḥ prāṇaḥ iti ātharvaṇe kṛṣṇa pakṣasya ādi tvena uktyā tathā āśvayuj kṛṣṇa pakṣe tu śrāddham kāryam dine dine māsi bhādrapade ṣṭamyām

original: bhavetproṣṭhapade māsi jayantī nāma sā smṛte'tyādi smṛtyādau āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayasya bhādrapadakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ jayantītyasya vidhānānyathānupapattyā cāvagamyate| tathāhi -- atra mahālayakṛṣṇapakṣasyāśvayugantargatatvaṃ jayantyāśca bhādrabhadāntargatatvaṃ ca darśāntatve'nupapannaṃ sat paurṇimāntatvaṃ māsasyāvagamayatīti|
analyzed: bhavet proṣṭhapade māsi jayantī nāma sā smṛtā ityādi smṛti ādau āśvayuj kṛṣṇapakṣe mahālayasya bhādrapada kṛṣṇa aṣṭamyām jayantī iti asya vidhāna anyathā anupapattyā ca avagamyate tathā hi atra mahālaya kṛṣṇapakṣasya āśvayuj antargata tvam jayantyāḥ ca bhādrabhada antargata tvam ca darśa anta tvena upapannam sat paurṇimā anta tvam māsasya avagamayati iti

original: tathā yatiprakaraṇe `ṛtusandhiṣu vāpayedi'tyādismṛtyā yatīnām ṛtusandhaukṣauraṃ tāvatprasiddham| tathā śiṣṭācārāt| tacca vapanaṃ māsasya paurṇimāntatvābhāve darśasyaiva ṛtusandhitvāt tatraiva vapanaṃ prasajyeteti paurṇamāsyāṃ na syāt| asti ca tat| tadanyathānupapattyā cāvagamyata iti|
analyzed: tathā yati prakaraṇe ṛtu sandhiṣu vāpayet ityādi smṛtyā yatīnām ṛtu sandhau kṣauram tāvat prasiddham tathā śiṣṭa ācārāt tat ca vapanam māsasya paurṇimā anta tva abhāve darśasya eva ṛtu sandhi tvāt tatra eva vapanam prasajyeta iti paurṇamāsyām na syāt asti ca tat tad anyathā anupapattyā ca avagamyate iti

original: tathā māghasnānādau paurṇamāsyantasya māsasya śiṣṭānāmācāradarśanāt| tathā kvaciccāturmāsyavratādiṣu śuklapakṣadaśamīmārabhya śuklapakṣadaśamīparyantaṃ śākavratādikaṃ kartavyamiti vidhīyata iti so'pyeko māso'vagantavyaḥ| atra vacanānyuttaratra spaṣṭīkariṣyante| tasmāt paurṇamāsyanto māso bhūyān|
analyzed: tathā māgha snāna ādau paurṇamāsī antasya māsasya śiṣṭānām ācāra darśanāt tathā kvacid cāturmāsya vrata ādiṣu śukla pakṣa daśamīm ārabhya śukla pakṣa daśamī paryantam śāka vrata ādikam kartavyam iti vidhīyate iti saḥ api ekaḥ māsaḥ avagantavyaḥ atra vacanāni uttaratra spaṣṭīkariṣyante tasmāt paurṇamāsī antaḥ māsaḥ bhūyān

original: tathā viṣṇudharmottare nākṣatro māso darśitaḥ -- sarvarkṣaparivartaistu nākṣatro māsa ucyate| saurasyādyantau rāśīnāmādyantābhyāṃ vyavasthitau|| sāvanastu triṃśaddinagaṇanāyāṃ māsa ucyate| tatra puruṣecchādirniyāmakaḥ| nākṣatre nakṣatraṃ niyāmakamiti sarvatra vyavasthā draṣṭavyā|
analyzed: tathā viṣṇudharmottare nākṣatraḥ māsaḥ darśitaḥ sarva ṛkṣa parivartaiḥ tu nākṣatraḥ māsaḥ ucyate saurasya ādi antau rāśīnām ādi antābhyām vyavasthitau sāvanaḥ tu triṃśat dina gaṇanāyām māsaḥ ucyate tatra puruṣa icchā ādiḥ niyāmakaḥ nākṣatre nakṣatram niyāmakam iti sarvatra vyavasthā draṣṭavyā

original: darśāntādimāsopayogastu brahmasiddhānte darśitaḥ -- amāvāsyāparicchinno māsaḥ syād brāhmaṇasya tu| saṅkrāntipaurṇamāsībhyāṃ tathaiva nṛpavaiśyayoḥ|| iti| tathā vāyupurāṇe mādyamāhātmye viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ -- daśamyādidaśamyantaḥ sa māsaḥ śubhakarmaṇi| pūrṇimādiryājñikānāṃ pitṛṇāṃ saṅkramādikaḥ|| eteṣvanyatamaṃ pakṣaṃ samārabhya vrataṃ caret|| ityādi|
analyzed: darśa anta ādi māsa upayogaḥ tu brahmasiddhānte darśitaḥ amāvāsyā paricchinnaḥ māsaḥ syāt brāhmaṇasya tu saṅkrānti paurṇamāsībhyām tathā eva nṛpa vaiśyayoḥ iti tathā vāyupurāṇe mādya māhātmye viśeṣaḥ abhihitaḥ daśamī ādi daśamī antaḥ sa māsaḥ śubha karmaṇi pūrṇimā ādiḥ yājñikānām pitṛṇām saṅkrama ādikaḥ eteṣu anyatamam pakṣam samārabhya vratam caret ityādi

original: evaṃ dvividhānāṃ cāndradvādaśamāsānāṃ caitrādisaṃjñā nakṣatrasambandhaprayuktā| yasmin māse pūrṇimā citrādinakṣatreṇa yujyate, sa caitrādiḥ| sākṣāttadayoge'pi caitrādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ nakṣatradvandvaṃ prayojakam| ṣaṣṭhasaptamayostrikaṃ trikam, aṣṭamādyekādaśāntānāṃ caturṇāṃ dvikaṃ dvikam, antyasya tu trikamiti vibhāgo draṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: evam dvividhānām cāndra dvādaśa māsānām caitra ādi saṃjñā nakṣatra sambandha prayuktā yasmin māse pūrṇimā citra ādi nakṣatreṇa yujyate sa caitra ādiḥ sākṣāt tad ayoge pi caitra ādīnām pañcānām nakṣatra dvandvam prayojakam ṣaṣṭha saptamayoḥ trikam trikam aṣṭama ādi ekādaśa antānām caturṇām dvikam dvikam antyasya tu trikam iti vibhāgaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: taduktaṃ saṅkarṣaṇakāṇḍe -- dve dve citrāditārāṇāṃ paripūrṇendusaṅgame| māsāścaitrādayo jñeyāstrikaiḥ ṣaṣṭhāntyasaptamāḥ|| iti| anyatrāpi -- antyopāntyau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaśca tribho mataḥ| śeṣamāsā dvibhā jñeyāḥ kṛttikādivyavasthayā|| iti| bṛhadāraṇyakabhāṣye'pi -- `citrāditārakādvandvaṃ yadā pūrṇendusaṃyutam| caitrādimāsā vijñeyā' ityādi|
analyzed: tat uktam saṅkarṣaṇakāṇḍe dve dve citra ādi tārāṇām paripūrṇa indu saṅgame māsāḥ caitra ādayaḥ jñeyāḥ trikaiḥ ṣaṣṭha antya saptamāḥ iti anyatra api antya upāntyau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaḥ ca tribhaḥ mataḥ śeṣa māsāḥ dvi bhāḥ jñeyāḥ kṛttikā ādi vyavasthayā iti bṛhadāraṇyaka bhāṣye pi citra ādi tārakā dvandvam yadā pūrṇa indu saṃyutam caitra ādi māsāḥ vijñeyāḥ ityādi

original: atra māsasāmānyasyopayogaḥ taittirīyakādau -- `māsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyata' iti `māsi māsi pṛṣṭhanyupayanti māsi māsyatigrāhyā gṛhyanta' iti ca| śākhāntare -- kuṇḍapāyināmayane māsamagnihotraṃ juhotī'ti siddho draṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: atra māsa sāmānyasya upayogaḥ taittirīyaka ādau māsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate iti māsi māsi pṛṣṭhanyupayanti māsi māsi atigrāhyāḥ gṛhyante iti ca śākhā antare kuṇḍapāyinām ayane māsam agnihotram juhoti iti siddhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: māsaviśeṣopayogaḥ māsaviśeṣopayogāstu vaiśākhamāhātmye skānde -- dadhno'dhikaṃ ghṛtaṃ yadvadūrjo māso'dhikastathā| kārtikādadhiko māgho māghādvaiśākha uttamaḥ| tasmin māse kṛto dharmo vardhate vaṭabījavat|| iti| tathā vāyupurāṇe māghamāhātmye -- prātaḥ snāne'pyaśaktaścet kuryānmāsatrayaṃ budhaḥ| tulāsaṃsthe dinakare makarasthe ca bhāsvati|
analyzed: māsa viśeṣa upayogaḥ māsa viśeṣa upayogāḥ tu vaiśākhamāhātmye skānde dadhnaḥ adhikam ghṛtam yadvat ūrjaḥ māsa adhikaḥ tathā kārtikāt adhikaḥ māghaḥ māghāt vaiśākhaḥ uttamaḥ tasmin māse kṛtaḥ dharmaḥ vardhate vaṭa bīja vat iti tathā vāyupurāṇe māghamāhātmye prātar snāne ipi aśaktaḥ ced kuryāt māsa trayam budhaḥ tulā saṃsthe dinakare makara sthe ca bhāsvati

original: meṣage ca sadā kuryāt prātaḥ snānamatandritaḥ| na kuryāt triṣu māseṣu prātaḥ snānaṃ narādhamaḥ|| rauravaṃ narakaṃ yāti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa|| iti| tathā skānde kārtikamāsamāhātmye -- māghamāsotsavo viṣṇorgṛhe yasmin pratīyate| na pāpaiḥ kalikālotthairlipyate ca kṛtairapi|| iti| tathā tatraiva -- kārtikaṃ sarvamāsebhyaḥ sahastraphaladaṃ viduḥ|

original: dhanurmāsaviśeṣaḥ tathā tatraiva dhanurmāsaviṣaye dvipañcāśe'dhyāye -- dhanurmāse hariḥ prīta uṣaḥkālārcane dhruvam| dadātyabhīṣṭamakṣayyaṃ satyameva bravīmi te|| uṣaḥkāle dhanurmāse snātvā samyag janārdanam| samabhyarcya ca mudgānnaṃ dadhnā saha nivedaya|| bhojaya dvijavaryāṃśca prātaḥkāle yathābalam|

original: akaraṇe pratyavāya uktastatraiva -- uṣaḥpūjāṃ dhanurmāse yo na kurvīta vaiṣṇavīm| saptajanmasu riktaḥstāt kṣayarogī ca mūḍhadhīḥ|| iti| karaṇe phalāntaramuktaṃ tatraiva -- kodaṇḍasthe savitari mudgānnaṃ yo nivedayet| sahastravārṣikī pūjā dinenaikena sidhyati|| yathā tuṣyeddhanurmāse mudgānnena ramāpatiḥ|
analyzed: akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ uktaḥ tatra eva uṣaḥ pūjām dhanuḥ māse yaḥ na kurvīta vaiṣṇavīm sapta janmasu riktaḥ stāt kṣaya rogī ca mūḍha dhīḥ iti karaṇe phala antaram uktam tatra eva kodaṇḍa sthe savitari mudga annam yaḥ nivedayet sahastra vārṣikī pūjā dinena ekena sidhyati yathā tuṣyet dhanuḥ māse mudga annena ramāpatiḥ

original: na tathā vratadānadyairna tapobhirna cādhvaraiḥ|| kodaṇḍasthe divānāthe yo mudgānnaṃ sahārdrakam| nivedayeddhareḥ samyag jitvā śatrūn kṣaṇena saḥ|| sadadhyārdrakamudgānnaṃ yo dhanurmāsi viṣṇave| samarpayetsa dīrghāyurdhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ|| sahārdrakaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ yo'cyutāya nivedayet| kiṃ tasya gaṅgāsnānādyaiḥkiṃ japaiḥ kimihādhvaraiḥ||
analyzed: na tathā vrata dānadyaiḥ na tapobhiḥ na ca adhvaraiḥ kodaṇḍa sthe divānāthe yaḥ mudga annam saha ārdrakam nivedayet hareḥ samyak jitvā śatrūn kṣaṇena saḥ sa dadhi ārdraka mudga annam yaḥ dhanuḥ māsi viṣṇave samarpayet sa dīrgha āyuḥ dhana āḍhyaḥ vedapāragaḥ saha ārdrakam ca mudga annam yaḥ ucyutāya nivedayet kim tasya gaṅgā snāna ādyaiḥ kim japaiḥ kim iha adhvaraiḥ

original: āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ yadīcchetsadya eva hi|| iti| tathānyatra -- prīṇayet sa dhanurmāse mudnānnenāmbujekṣaṇam| nivedayitvā mudgānnaṃ purendrāṇī sahārdrakam|| viṣṇave duḥkhitā sādhvī nityaiśvaryamavāpa sā| idaṃ dvādaśavāraṃ tu japan lakṣmīṃ samarcaya|| nivedya guḍamudgānnaṃ dhanurmāse'rthasiddhaye| sadya evāpnuyāllakṣmīkaṭākṣeṇākṣayaṃ dhanam||
analyzed: āyuḥ ārogyam aiśvaryam yadi icchet sadyas eva hi iti tathā anyatra prīṇayet sa dhanuḥ māse mudna annena ambuja īkṣaṇam nivedayitvā mudga annam purā indrāṇī saha ārdrakam viṣṇave duḥkhitā sādhvī nitya aiśvaryam avāpa sā idam dvādaśa vāram tu japan lakṣmīm samarcaya nivedya guḍa mudga annam dhanuḥ māsa irtha siddhaye sadyas eva āpnuyāt lakṣmī kaṭākṣeṇa akṣayam dhanam

original: śrīdevī prathamaṃ nāma dvitīyamamṛtodbhavā| tṛtīyaṃ kamalā proktā caturthaṃ lokasundarī|| pañcamaṃ viṣṇupatnīti ṣaṣṭhaṃ śrīvaiṣṇavīti ca|| saptamaṃ tu varārohā aṣṭamaṃ harivallabhā|| navamaṃ śārṅgīṇī proktā daśamaṃ devadevikā| ekādaśaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ dvādaśaṃ lokasundarī||
analyzed: śrīdevī prathamam nāma dvitīyam amṛtodbhavā tṛtīyam kamalā proktā caturtham lokasundarī pañcamam viṣṇupatnī iti ṣaṣṭham śrīvaiṣṇavī iti ca saptamam tu varārohā aṣṭamam harivallabhā navamam śārṅgīṇī proktā daśamam devadevikā ekādaśam mahālakṣmīḥ dvādaśam lokasundarī

original: śrīḥ padmā kamalā mukundamahiṣī lakṣmīstrilokeśvarī mā kṣīrābdhisutāravindajananī vidyā sarojātmikā| sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradeti satataṃ nāmāni ye dvādaśa prātaḥ śuddhatarāḥ paṭhanti satataṃ sarvān labhante śubhān|| bhadralakṣmīstavaṃ nityaṃ puṇyametacchubhāvaham| taulau snātvāpi kāveryāṃ japa śrīvṛkṣasannidhau|| iti yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prati nāradavacanam|

original: tatraivānyatra -- dadhyārdrakaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ dadhyājyailāguḍojjvalam| susukhoṣṇaṃ sakandaṃ ca viṣṇave yaḥ samarpayet|| dṛṣṭvātacchubhamudgānnaṃ santuṣṭo bhaktavatsalaḥ| dadāti sakalān bhogān mokṣaṃ ca jagadīśvaraḥ|| ityādi tatra tatra bahu vistṛtamasti| granthagauravabhayānna likhyate||

original: mahāvyatīpātaḥ āgneyapurāṇe dhanurmāsavyatīpātaviṣaye -- yaḥ snātvoṣasi cāparkṣe bhāskare bhaktimānnaraḥ| nivedayenme mudgānnaṃ sa vai bhāgavatottamaḥ|| yaḥ kārmukārke mudgānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati| tasya muktiṃ prayacchāmi kiṃ punarbhogasampadaḥ|| agniṣṭomasahastrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca| mudgānnasya vyatīpāte cāpe nārhati tulyatām||
analyzed: mahāvyatīpātaḥ āgneyapurāṇe dhanuḥ māsa vyatīpāta viṣaye yaḥ snātvā uṣasi cāpa ṛkṣe bhāskare bhaktimān naraḥ nivedayet me mudga annam sa vai bhāgavata uttamaḥ yaḥ kārmuka arke mudga annam brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati tasya muktim prayacchāmi kim punar bhoga sampadaḥ agniṣṭoma sahastrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca mudga annasya vyatīpāte cāpe na arhati tulya tām

original: vedabhraṣṭo vratabhraṣṭaḥ suhṛdripuḥ| cāpe pāte ca mudgānnaṃ dattvā viprāya śudhyati|| devarṣipitaraḥ sarve sarve lokāḥ saheśvarāḥ| praśaṃsanti vyatīpāte mudgānnaṃ mārgaśīrṣake|| nivedayitvā mudgānnaṃ dhanuṣyuṣasi viṣṇave| pitṛn yo bhojayet pāte tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śrṛṇu|| gayākṣetre rāmasetau samyak śrāddhāyutaṃ bhavet|
analyzed: veda bhraṣṭaḥ vrata bhraṣṭaḥ suhṛd ripuḥ cāpe pāte ca mudga annam dattvā viprāya śudhyati deva ṛṣi pitaraḥ sarve sarve lokāḥ saha īśvarāḥ praśaṃsanti vyatīpāte mudga annam mārgaśīrṣake nivedayitvā mudga annam dhanuṣi uṣasi viṣṇave pitṛn yaḥ bhojayet pāte tasya puṇya phalam śrṛṇu gayā kṣetre rāmasetau samyak śrāddha ayutam bhavet

original: tadvaṃśyāścāpi pitaraḥ sarve yānti hareḥ padam|| nivedayitvā mudgānnaṃ śarkarājyaphalairyutam| uṣaḥkāle dhanurmāse brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati|| kāyakleśakaraistasya kiṃ tīrthairvratakoṭibhiḥ| ye'rcayanti hariṃ snātvā prātaścāpe bahirjale|| indrādyāstānupāsyanti sarvabhūtāni bibhyati| snātaḥ syātsarvatīrtheṣu kāveryādinadīṣu ca||
analyzed: tad vaṃśyāḥ ca api pitaraḥ sarve yānti hareḥ padam nivedayitvā mudga annam śarkarā ājya phalaiḥ yutam uṣaḥ kāle dhanuḥ māse brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati kāya kleśa karaiḥ tasya kim tīrthaiḥ vrata koṭibhiḥ ye īrcayanti harim snātvā prātar cāpe bahis jale indra ādyāḥ tān upāsyanti sarva bhūtāni bibhyati snātaḥ syāt sarva tīrtheṣu kāverī ādi nadīṣu ca

original: ardhodayasahastrāṇi vājapeyādayo'dhvarāḥ| mārgaśīrṣavyatīpātakalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm||mārgaśīrṣavyatīpāte pitṛnuddiśya tarpayan| arghyaṃ dadyāddhariṃ dhyāyan mūlamantreṇa mānavaḥ|| mūlamantraḥ -- vyatīpāta! mahāsatva! sarvapāpapraṇāśana!| sahastrabāho! viśvātman gṛhaṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te|| vyatīpāta! namaste'stu namaste viśvamaṅgala!|

original: asya dharmasya sauradhanurmāsasādhyatvādatra kathitaḥ||

original: kiñca tadviṣaye tatraiva viṣṇuśacīsaṃvāde viśeṣo'bhihitaḥ -- tasmānmāsi ca cāpākhye karma tyaktvāruṇodaye| mudgānnapūjāṃ yaḥ kuryāttasya muktiprado bhava|| dhanurmāse kṛtā pūjā madhyāhne niṣphalā bhavet| mukhyāruṇodaye pūjā madhyamā luptatārakā|| adhamā sūryasahitā madhyāhne niṣphalā bhavet| mudgaṃ taṇḍulamānaṃ syāduttamottamamucyate||
analyzed: kiñca tad viṣaye tatra eva viṣṇu śacī saṃvāde viśeṣaḥ abhihitaḥ tasmāt māsi ca cāpa ākhye karma tyaktvā aruṇa udaye mudga anna pūjām yaḥ kuryāt tasya mukti pradaḥ bhava dhanuḥ māse kṛtā pūjā madhyāhne niṣphalā bhavet mukhya aruṇa udaye pūjā madhyamā lupta tārakā adhamā sūrya sahitā madhyāhne niṣphalā bhavet mudgam taṇḍula mānam syāt uttamottamam ucyate

original: madhyamaṃ taṇḍulādardhaṃ tadardhamadhamaṃ bhavet| mudgaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ kecit praśaṃsanti munīśvarāḥ|| yathābalaṃ prakurvīta na hīyettaṇḍulārdhataḥ| yastu dāridyradurbudhyā mudgānnaṃ na nivedayet|| viṣṇave kārmuke prātaḥ saptajanmasu nirdhanaḥ| yaḥ karmahānimāśaṅkya nārcayeduṣasīśvaram|| cāpe'rke nirdhano rogī viṣṇudrohī patedadhaḥ|
analyzed: madhyamam taṇḍulāt ardham tad ardham adhamam bhavet mudgam tu dviguṇam kecid praśaṃsanti muni īśvarāḥ yathābalam prakurvīta na hīyet taṇḍula ardhataḥ yaḥ tu dāridyra durbudhyā mudga annam na nivedayet viṣṇave kārmuke prātar sapta janmasu nirdhanaḥ yaḥ karma hānim āśaṅkya na arcayet uṣasi īśvaram cāperke nirdhanaḥ rogī viṣṇu drohī patet adhas

original: yathā saṅkocya satkarma bhuṅkte'lpadvādaśīdine|| tathā prātardhanurmāse tyaktvā karmārcayecca māma|| jyotiḥśāstre bhāskarīye'pi -- ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātriruttaraṃ tu divā bhavet| daivaṃ tattadahorātraṃ cāpamāsaṃ vidurbudhāḥ|| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena cāpamāse dine dine| uṣaḥkāle tu samprāpte arcayitvā janārdanām|

original: upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmudgānnaṃ ca nivedayet|| iti| ādityapurāṇe'pi -- cāpe gate tathā sūrye pratyūṣe snānamācaret| arcayecca jagannāthaṃ yāvatsūryodayāt purā|| tataḥ prabhātasamaye arghyaṃ prakṣipya vai dvijaḥ| gāyatrīṃ ca tato japtvā upatiṣṭheta bhāskaram|| iti| smṛtyarthasāre'pi -- arcayitvā hariṃ paścāddhanurmāse'ntyayāmakam|
analyzed: upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ mudga annam ca nivedayet iti ādityapurāṇe pi cāpe gate tathā sūrye pratyūṣe snānam ācaret arcayet ca jagannātham yāvat sūrya udayāt purā tatas prabhāta samaye arghyam prakṣipya vai dvijaḥ gāyatrīm ca tatas japtvā upatiṣṭheta bhāskaram iti smṛtyarthasāre pi arcayitvā harim paścāt dhanuḥ māsentya yāmakam

original: paścāt sandhyāmupāsīta dharmalopo na vidyate|| iti| pañcarātre ca -- kodaṇḍasthe savitari pratyuṣaḥpūjanāddhareḥ| sahastrābdārcanaphalaṃ dinenaikena labhyate|| iti| pārameṣṭhaye ca -- cāpaṃgate dinakare pratyuṣaḥ pūjayeddharim| mahābhiṣekavidhinā vedapārāyaṇādibhiḥ|| iti| yāmale ca -- dhanurmāsi vyatīpāte'pyuṣaḥkāle viśeṣataḥ|
analyzed: paścāt sandhyām upāsīta dharma lopaḥ na vidyate iti pañcarātre ca kodaṇḍa sthe savitari prati uṣaḥpūjanāt hareḥ sahastra abda arcana phalam dinena ekena labhyate iti ca cāpam gate dinakare prati uṣaḥpūjanāt pūjayet harim mahā abhiṣeka vidhinā veda pārāyaṇa ādibhiḥ iti yāmale ca dhanuḥ māsi vyatīpāte pi uṣaḥkāle viśeṣataḥ

original: mudgānnaiścoṭikāyuktaiḥ pāyasena viśeṣataḥ|| nānāvidhairbhakṣyabhojyairdadhyodanasamanvitaiḥ| dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairviṣṇuṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ|| brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra prātaḥkāle viśeṣataḥ| viṣṇornaivedyaśeṣeṇa pāyasena viśeṣataḥ|| gobhūtilahiraṇyādidānaṃ kuryācca yatnataḥ| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti saudārye? dānato dvijaḥ|| iti|
analyzed: mudga annaiḥ coṭikā yuktaiḥ pāyasena viśeṣataḥ nānāvidhaiḥ bhakṣya bhojyaiḥ dadhi odana samanvitaiḥ dhūpaiḥ dīpaiḥ ca naivedyaiḥ viṣṇum sampūjya bhaktitaḥ brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra prātar kāle viśeṣataḥ viṣṇoḥ naivedya śeṣeṇa pāyasena viśeṣataḥ go bhū tila hiraṇya ādi dānam kuryāt ca yatnataḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnoti saudārye dānataḥ dvijaḥ iti

original: mātsye dānakhaṇḍe ca -- dhanurmāse tu saudārye? pratyūṣe haripūjanāt|| brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanena nānādānaiśca sattama!|| viṣṇulokamavāpnoti pitṛbhiḥsaha nityadā|| ityādi| saṅgrahe ca -- dhanurmāsaṃ gate bhānau prātarutthāya yo dvijaḥ| hareḥ pūjāṃ prakurvāṇo labhate harimandiram|| tathā -- dhanurmāse hareḥ prītyai mudgānnaṃ guḍasaṃyutam|
analyzed: mātsye dānakhaṇḍe ca dhanuḥ māse tu saudārye pratyūṣe hari pūjanāt brāhmaṇānām bhojanena nānā dānaiḥ ca sattama viṣṇu lokam avāpnoti pitṛbhiḥ saha nityadā ityādi saṅgrahe ca dhanuḥ māsam gate bhānau prātar utthāya yaḥ dvijaḥ hareḥ pūjām prakurvāṇaḥ labhate hari mandiram tathā dhanuḥ māse hareḥ prītyai mudga annam guḍa saṃyutam

original: yo'rpayet prātarutthāya sa viṣṇupadamaśnute|| ityāditanmāsapūjāsādhanadravyakālaviśeṣavacanāni draṣṭavyānīti||

original: cāturmāsyadharmāḥ māsaprasaṅgāccāturmāsyasvarūpaṃ tatra kartavyadharmāśca nirūpyante| tatpraśaṃsā varāhapurāṇe cāturmāsyamāhātmye dharaṇīvarāhasaṃvāde varāhaḥ -- asti priyatamaḥ kālaścāturmāsyābhidho mama| snānaṃ vrataṃ japo homastatrānantaguṇaṃ smṛtam|| māseṣvanyeṣu yatkiñcit kriyate mama toṣaṇam| tasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ māghemakarage ravau||
analyzed: cāturmāsya dharmāḥ māsa prasaṅgāt cāturmāsya svarūpam tatra kartavya dharmāḥ ca nirūpyante tad praśaṃsā varāhapurāṇe cāturmāsya māhātmye dharaṇī varāha saṃvāde varāhaḥ asti priyatamaḥ kālaḥ cāturmāsya abhidhaḥ mama snānam vratam japaḥ homaḥ tatra ananta guṇam smṛtam māseṣu anyeṣu yat kiñcid kriyate mama toṣaṇam tasmāt koṭi guṇam puṇyam māgha makara ge ravau

original: tato'pi koṭiguṇitaṃ vaiśākhe māsi labhyate| tato'pyanantaguṇitaṃ cāturmāsye na saṃśayaḥ|| ityādi| tatsvarūpaṃ ca tatraivoktam -- āṣāḍhādyāstu ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanamīritam| pauṣādyā devi! ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇamīritam|| cāndro māso dvidhā proktā darśāntaḥ paurṇimāntakaḥ| vratādau gṛhyate tatra paurṇimānto hi sūribhiḥ||
analyzed: tatas api koṭi guṇitam vaiśākhe māsi labhyate tatas api ananta guṇitam cāturmāsye na saṃśayaḥ ityādi tad svarūpam ca tatra eva uktam āṣāḍha ādyāḥ tu ṣaṣ māsāḥ dakṣiṇāyanam īritam pauṣa ādyāḥ devi ṣaṣ māsāḥ uttarāyaṇam īritam cāndraḥ māsaḥ dvidhā proktā darśa antaḥ paurṇimā antakaḥ vrata ādau gṛhyate tatra paurṇimā antaḥ hi sūribhiḥ

original: āṣāḍhe daśamīṃ śuklāmārabhya syāttu kārtikī| paurṇamāsī tāvadidaṃ cāturmāsyavratādikam|| ityādi| tasya sarvakālottamatvaṃ ca tatraivoktamākhyāyikayā| varāhaḥ -- purā sarvairdevagaṇairvṛto'haṃ merumastake| tathā yāmyāyanaṃ prāpya devāssarve'pyathocire|| bhagavan! rātrirasmākaṃ prāptā hi bhavadājñayā| svasvasthānaṃ prayāsyāma iti tāvadupasthitā||
analyzed: āṣāḍhe daśamīm śuklām ārabhya syāt tu kārtikī paurṇamāsī tāvat idam cāturmāsya vrata ādikam ityādi tasya sarva kāla uttama tvam ca tatra eva uktam ākhyāyikayā varāhaḥ purā sarvaiḥ deva gaṇaiḥ vṛtaḥ ham meru mastake tathā yāmyā ayanam prāpya devāḥ sarve api atha ūcire bhagavan rātriḥ asmākam prāptā hi bhavat ājñayā sva sva sthānam prayāsyāmaḥ iti tāvat upasthitā

original: śuklāmbaradharā nārī śyāmā paraśudhāriṇī| sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyāha rātristvāṃ prārthayāmyaham|| nahi yāmyāyane kiñcidvivāhopanayādikam| śubhaṃ karma prakurute tato'haṃ ninditā janaiḥ|| vṛthā me jīvanaṃ svāmin! yatsarvairgarhitāsmyaham| yadi tvamanugṛhṇāsi tarhi jīvāmi nānyathā|| tapa eva kariṣyāmi tvatprasādārthamatra vai|
analyzed: śukla ambara dharā nārī śyāmā paraśu dhāriṇī sa aṣṭāṅgam praṇipatya āha rātriḥ tvām prārthayāmi aham nahi yāmyā ayane kiñcid vivāha upanaya ādikam śubham karma prakurute tatas ham ninditā janaiḥ vṛthā me jīvanam svāmin yat sarvaiḥ garhitā asmi aham yadi tvam anugṛhṇāsi tarhi jīvāmi na anyathā tapaḥ eva kariṣyāmi tvad prasāda artham atra vai

original: ityuktvā praṇatā bhūyastato devā vijijñapuḥ|| nātha! nātha! kṛpāsindho! śaraṇagatavatsala!| vidhatsva karuṇāṃ rātrau vrajedyena kṛtārthatām|| tataḥ prasannahṛdayastasyai prādāṃ varottamam| priyā me te trayo yāmāstatrādyau dvau mahāpriyau|| syātāṃ tatra karma japadānavratādikam| anantaguṇameva syādaṣṭamāsakṛtādapi||
analyzed: iti uktvā praṇatāḥ bhūyas tatas devāḥ vijijñapuḥ nātha nātha kṛpā sindho śaraṇa gata vatsala vidhatsva karuṇām rātrau vrajet yena kṛtārtha tām tatas prasanna hṛdayaḥ tasyai prādām vara uttamam priyāḥ me te trayaḥ yāmāḥ tatra ādyau dvau mahā priyau syātām tatra karma japa dāna vrata ādikam ananta guṇam eva syāt aṣṭa māsa kṛtāt api

original: ādyaḥ syācchrāvaṇo māso nabhasyo'tha dvitīyakaḥ| tṛtīyaścāśvino māsaścaturthaḥ kārtikaḥ smṛtaḥ|| cāturmāsye'pi puṇyasya vṛddhiḥ syācca dine dine| na kārtikasamāvṛddhiḥ puṇyasyoktā manīṣibhiḥ|| iti vācaṃ mama śrutvā tuṣṭāssarve tadā surāḥ| rātridevī ca santuṣṭā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ|| tataḥ prabhṛti loke'smin cāturmāsyaṃ mama priyam|
analyzed: ādyaḥ syāt śrāvaṇaḥ māsaḥ nabhasya utha dvitīyakaḥ tṛtīyaḥ ca āśvinaḥ māsaḥ caturthaḥ kārtikaḥ smṛtaḥ cāturmāsye pi puṇyasya vṛddhiḥ syāt ca dine dine na kārtika samāvṛddhiḥ puṇyasya uktā manīṣibhiḥ iti vācam mama śrutvā tuṣṭāḥ sarve tadā surāḥ rātridevī ca santuṣṭā praṇanāma muhur muhur tatas prabhṛti loke smin cāturmāsyam mama priyam

original: prathitaṃ yatra kurvanti tasmin dānavratādikam|| dine dine'nantaguṇaṃ tatphalaṃ pradadāmyaham| atastatra viśeṣeṇa snānadānādikaṃ naraiḥ|| prakartavyaṃ mama prītyai bhaktyā saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ|| ityādi||
analyzed: prathitam yatra kurvanti tasmin dāna vrata ādikam tad phalam pradadāmi aham atas tatra viśeṣeṇa snāna dāna ādikam naraiḥ prakartavyam mama prītyai bhaktyā saṃsāra bhīrubhiḥ ityādi

original: atha tatra kartavyāni skānde vratakāṇḍe -- āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ samārabhet| kārtikasya site pakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ samāpayet|| upavāsasvarūpāṇi vratānyanyāni santi vai| tāni sarvāṇi viprenda! prabodhinyāṃ samāpayet|| dvādaśyāṃ kārayetteṣāṃ homaṃ brāhmaṇapūjanam| itarāṇi ca sarvāṇi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāpayet|| iti||
analyzed: atha tatra kartavyāni skānde vrata kāṇḍe āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyām samārabhet kārtikasya site pakṣe paurṇamāsyām samāpayet upavāsa svarūpāṇi vratāni anyāni santi vai tāni sarvāṇi vipra inda prabodhinyām samāpayet dvādaśyām kārayet teṣām homam brāhmaṇa pūjanam itarāṇi ca sarvāṇi paurṇamāsyām samāpayet iti

original: cāturmāsyavratam atha cāturmāsyavrataṃ tatraivoktam -- acyute śayanaṃ yāte dvijendrairbhāvitātmabhiḥ| nārībhirvā māsi kiṃ kartavyaṃ vrataṃ ca kim|| ko'yaṃ vidhiḥ ka ācāro vada me vadatāṃ vara!| brahmovāca -- āṣāḍhasya tu māsasya sūrye karkaṭage tathā| ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe devānāṃ rātririṣyate|| tanmadhyago mahāviṣṇurupendra iti saṃjñakaḥ|
analyzed: cāturmāsyavratam atha cāturmāsyavratam tatra eva uktam acyute śayanam yāte dvijendraiḥ bhāvitātmabhiḥ nārībhiḥ vā māsi kim kartavyam vratam ca kim kaḥ iyam vidhiḥ kaḥ ācāraḥ vada me vadatām vara brahmā uvāca āṣāḍhasya tu māsasya sūrye karkaṭa ge tathā ekādaśyām site pakṣe devānām rātriḥ iṣyate tad madhya gaḥ mahā viṣṇuḥ upendraḥ iti saṃjñakaḥ

original: avasthātrayamādāya nānāmūrtibhiravyayaḥ|| samastairvibudhaiḥ stutyo yoganidrāmupeyivān| samastamamalānāṃ ca devatā ca janārdanaḥ|| tasmiṃstu śayanaṃ yāte nodvāhādikriyā bhavet| caulopanayane caiva vivāhādyaṃ tyajedvudhaḥ|| ajñānādyadi kurvanti mṛtisteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ| kalyāṇadevatādṛṣṭihīnānāṃ tu kutaḥ sukham||
analyzed: avasthā trayam ādāya nānā mūrtibhiḥ avyayaḥ samastaiḥ vibudhaiḥ stutyaḥ yoganidrām upeyivān samastam amalānām ca devatā ca janārdanaḥ tasmin tu śayanam yāte na udvāha ādi kriyā bhavet caula upanayane ca eva vivāha ādyam tyajet vudhaḥ ajñānāt yadi kurvanti mṛtiḥ teṣām na saṃśayaḥ kalyāṇa devatā dṛṣṭi hīnānām tu kutas sukham

original: cāturmāsyavidhiṃ vakṣyeśrutismṛtyuditaṃ śubham| pūrvabhāṇḍāni sarvāṇi rasabhāṇḍavivarjitam|| visarjayennavamyāṃ tu śūrpādīn śodhayettathā|| gomayādyupalepena śuddhiṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ|| abhyantaraṃ gṛhasyaiva vāsobhiḥ kambalaistathā| kaṭaiśca kaśubhiścaiva sacelaṃ snānamācaret|| tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya daśamyāṃ tu śubhe dine|
analyzed: cāturmāsya vidhim vakṣye śruti smṛti uditam śubham pūrva bhāṇḍāni sarvāṇi rasa bhāṇḍa vivarjitam visarjayet navamyām tu śūrpa ādīn śodhayet tathā gomaya ādi upalepena śuddhim kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ abhyantaram gṛhasya eva vāsobhiḥ kambalaiḥ tathā kaṭaiḥ ca kaśubhiḥ ca eva sa celam snānam ācaret tatas prātar samutthāya daśamyām tu śubhe dine

original: snātvā nirvartya karmāṇi gṛhaṃ gatvā jitendriyaḥ|| devasyodvartanaṃ kuryādalaṃkuryācca maṇḍapam| pañcagavyaṃ prāśayitvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tanordṛḍham|| pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam| vratānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṅkalpaṃ vidhivaccaret|| naimittikānāṃ kāmyānāṃ nityānāṃ ca tathaiva ca| vratānyetāni sarvāṇi caturāśramavartinām||
analyzed: snātvā nirvartya karmāṇi gṛham gatvā jita indriyaḥ devasya udvartanam kuryāt alaṃkuryāt ca maṇḍapam pañcagavyam prāśayitvā śuddhim kṛtvā tanoḥ dṛḍham pūjayitvā yathānyāyam devadevam janārdanam vratānām vakṣyamāṇānām saṅkalpam vidhivat caret naimittikānām kāmyānām nityānām ca tathā eva ca vratāni etāni sarvāṇi catur āśrama vartinām

original: prathame māsi kartavyaṃ nityaṃ śākavrataṃ śubham| dvitīye māsi kartavyaṃ dadhivratamanuttamam|| payovrataṃ tṛtīye tu caturthe tu niśāmaya| dvidalaṃ bahubījaṃ ca varjayecchuddhimicchatā|| nityānyetāni viprendra!vratānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ| jambīraṃ rājamāṣaṃ ca tuvaraṃ rājamudgakam|| abhakṣyāṇi ca śākāni cāturmāsye tyajedvudhaḥ|
analyzed: prathame māsi kartavyam nityam śāka vratam śubham dvitīye māsi kartavyam dadhi vratam anuttamam payaḥ vratam tṛtīye tu caturthe tu niśāmaya dvi dalam bahu bījam ca varjayet śuddhim icchatā nityāni etāni vipra indra vratāni āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ jambīram rājamāṣam ca tuvaram rājamudgakam abhakṣyāṇi ca śākāni cāturmāsye tyajet vudhaḥ

original: dvādaśyāṃ tu daśamyāṃ ca śākaṃ daśavidhaṃ tyajet|| śākaṃ daśavidhaṃ proktaṃ varjyaṃ śākavrate śubhe| patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ nālaṃ mūlaṃ kuṅmalameva ca|| tilapiṣṭaṃ pallavaṃ cacchatrākaṃ cāmiṣaṃ tathā| śākaṃ daśavidhaṃ proktaṃ vratakarmasu niṣṭhitaiḥ|| kārtikyāṃ varjayedvidvān dvidalaṃ bahubījakam| bījameva samud‌bhūtaṃ dvidalaṃ cāṅkuraṃ vinā||
analyzed: dvādaśyām tu daśamyām ca śākam daśavidham tyajet śākam daśavidham proktam varjyam śāka vrate śubhe patram puṣpam phalam nālam mūlam kuṅmalam eva ca tila piṣṭam pallavam ca chatrākam ca āmiṣam tathā śākam daśavidham proktam vrata karmasu niṣṭhitaiḥ kārtikyām varjayet vidvān dvi dalam bahubījakam bījam eva samudbhūtam dvi dalam ca aṅkuram vinā

original: dṛśyate yatra sasyeṣu dvidalaṃ sadbhirucyate| śilayā bhidyamāne tu dvidalaṃ yatra dṛśyate|| dvidalaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śrṛṇu| māṣaṃ ca mudgakaṃ caiva caṇakaṃ ca masūrakam|| kulitthaṃ caiva niṣpāvamāḍhakaṃ rājamāṣakam| rājamudgaṃ tintriṇīṃ ca tathā vai nakhapañcakam|| nūtanānyatha jīrṇāni sarvāṇyetāni varjayet||
analyzed: dṛśyate yatra sasyeṣu dvi dalam sadbhiḥ ucyate śilayā bhidyamāne tu dvi dalam yatra dṛśyate dvi dalam tat hi vijñeyam tat me nigadataḥ śrṛṇu māṣam ca mudgakam ca eva caṇakam ca masūrakam kulittham ca eva niṣpāvam āḍhakam rājamāṣakam rājamudgam tintriṇīm ca tathā vai nakhapañcakam nūtanāni atha jīrṇāni sarvāṇi etāni varjayet

analyzed: sapiṇḍīkaraṇe nitye na adhimāsam vivarjayet iti garbhe puṃsavane vārdhuṣike vṛddhi viṣaye atra ābdika viṣaye viśeṣaḥ ucyate tathā ca hārītaḥ pratyabdaḥ dvādaśe māse kāryā piṇḍa kriyā dvijaiḥ kvacid trayodaśe api syāt ādyam muktvā tu vatsaram iti atra yadi api varṣe varṣe tu yat śrāddham mātā pitroḥ mṛta ihani

original: māsadvaye'pi tat kāryaṃ vyāsasyavacanaṃ yathe' tyevamādivacanaiḥ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhamubhayatrāpi kartavyamiti kālādarśe pratipāditam| tathāpi hemādrimādhavāparārkādimatāt prathamavārṣikaṃ malamāse, dvitīyādyābdikaṃ tu śuddhamāsa eva kāryam| asaṅkrānte'pi kartavyamābdikaṃ prathamaṃ dvijaiḥ| tathaiva māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā||
analyzed: māsa dvaye pi tat kāryam vyāsasya vacanam yathā iti evamādi vacanaiḥ sāṃvatsarika śrāddham ubhayatra api kartavyam iti kālādarśe pratipāditam tathā api hemādri mādhava aparārka ādi matāt prathama vārṣikam malamāse dvitīya ādi ābdikam tu śuddha māse eva kāryam asaṅkrānte api kartavyam ābdikam prathamam dvijaiḥ tathā eva māsikam śrāddham sapiṇḍīkaraṇam tathā

original: iti hārītokteḥ| `ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yat syāt tat kurvīta malimluca' iti smaraṇācca| `mālimāse nipatite bhavedyat prathamābdikam| dvādaśe māsi kartavyamanyeṣāmuttaratra hī'ti vyāsavacanāt `śuddhamāsamṛtānāṃ tu maline prathamābdikami'ti laugākṣivacanācca| dvādaśe māsi paripūrṇe sati anantaradine kāryamiti vyāsavacanasyārthaḥ|
analyzed: iti hārīta ukteḥ ābdikam prathamam yat syāt tat kurvīta malimlucaḥ iti smaraṇāt ca māli māse nipatite bhavet yat prathama ābdikam dvādaśe māsi kartavyam anyeṣām uttaratra hi iti vyāsa vacanāt śuddha māsa mṛtānām tu maline prathama ābdikam iti laugākṣi vacanāt ca dvādaśe māsi paripūrṇe sati anantara dine kāryam iti vyāsa vacanasya arthaḥ

original: `māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭe yo yasmin hi mṛto'hani| pratyabdaṃ tu tathābhūtaṃ kṣayāhaṃ tasya taṃ viduri'ti vacanāt| na ca `caturdaśe tu samprāpte kurvīta punarābdikami'ti vacanavirodha iti vācyam| punarābdikamiti dvitīyādivārṣikasyokteḥ| trayodaśe māse'tīte caturdaśādyadine kuryādityartha ityavirodhaḥ|
analyzed: māsa pakṣa tithi spṛṣṭe yaḥ yasmin hi mṛta uhani pratyabdam tu tathābhūtam kṣaya aham tasya tam viduḥ iti vacanāt na ca caturdaśe tu samprāpte kurvīta punar ābdikam iti vacana virodhaḥ iti vācyam punar ābdikam iti dvitīya ādi vārṣikasya ukteḥ trayodaśe māsa itīte caturdaśa ādya dine kuryāt iti arthaḥ iti avirodhaḥ

original: yat tu vṛddhavasiṣṭhavacanam `śrāddhīye'hani samprāpte'dhikamāso bhaved yadi| māsadvaye'pi kurvīta śrāddhamevaṃ na muhyati| yacca vyāsaḥ -- uttare devakāryāṇi pitṛkāryāṇi cobhayoriti| tanmāsikādiviṣayam| yaugādikaṃ māsikaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ cāparapakṣikam| manvādikaṃ tairthikaṃ ca kuryānmāsadvaye'pi ca|| iti candrikokteḥ|
analyzed: yat tu vṛddha vasiṣṭha vacanam śrāddhīya ihani samprāpta adhika māsaḥ bhavet yadi māsa dvaye api kurvīta śrāddham evam na muhyati yat ca vyāsaḥ uttare deva kāryāṇi pitṛ kāryāṇi ca ubhayoḥ iti tat māsika ādi viṣayam yauga ādikam māsikam ca śrāddham ca āparapakṣikam manu ādikam tairthikam ca kuryāt māsa dvaye api ca iti candrikā ukteḥ

original: tairthikaṃ ca pūrvadṛṣṭyā tīrthaśrāddham| tacca malamāse'pi kāryamiti tristhalīsetubhaṭṭāḥ| yadapi nirṇayāmṛte -- pūrvoktakālādarśavacanād malamāsaśrāddhadinasya vandhyatvanirāsārthaṃ pitruddeśena brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā śuddhamāse sapiṇḍaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt| piṇḍavarjaṃ tvasaṅkrānte saṅkrāntau piṇḍasaṃyutam|
analyzed: tairthikam ca pūrva dṛṣṭyā tīrtha śrāddham tat ca mala māse pi kāryam iti tristhalīsetu bhaṭṭāḥ yat api nirṇayāmṛte pūrva ukta kālādarśa vacanāt mala māsa śrāddha dinasya vandhya tva nirāsa artham pitṛ uddeśena brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā śuddha māse sapiṇḍam śrāddham kuryāt piṇḍa varjam tu asaṅkrānte saṅkrāntau piṇḍa saṃyutam

original: pratisaṃvatsaraṃ śrāddhameva māsadvaye'pi ca|| iti vṛddhaparāśarokteriti| tadapi cintyam| pūrvoktavacanasya kṣayapūrvabhāvyadhikamāsaviṣayatvāt| tatra hi māsadvaye śrāddhamuktam| tadāha satyavrataḥ -- eka eva yadā māsaḥ saṃkrāntidvayasaṃyutaḥ| māsadvayagataṃ śrāddhaṃ malamāse'pi śasyate|| iti| māsadvayagataṃ pūrvasaṅkrāntigataṃ kṣayagataṃ ca|
analyzed: pratisaṃvatsaram śrāddham eva māsa dvaye api ca iti vṛddha parāśara ukteḥ iti tat api cintyam pūrva ukta vacanasya kṣaya pūrva bhāvi adhika māsa viṣaya tvāt tatra hi māsa dvaye śrāddham uktam tat āha satyavrataḥ ekaḥ eva yadā māsaḥ saṃkrānti dvaya saṃyutaḥ māsa dvaya gatam śrāddham mala māse api śasyate iti māsa dvaya gatam pūrva saṅkrānti gatam kṣaya gatam ca

original: malamāse kṣayamāse| apiśabdāt tatpūrvādhimāse ceti hemādriḥ| malamāsamṛtānāṃ tu yadā kadācit eva samāyāti tasminneva sāṃvatsarikaṃ kartavyam| tadāha bhṛguḥ -- malamāsamṛtānāṃtu yacchrāddhaṃ prativatsaram| malamāse tu tat kāryaṃ nānyeṣāṃ tu kadācana|| iti| dvirāṣāḍho'pi adhikamāsaprabheda eva|
analyzed: malamāse kṣayamāse api śabdāt tad pūrva adhimāse ca iti hemādriḥ mala māsa mṛtānām tu yadā kadācid eva samāyāti tasmin eva sāṃvatsarikam kartavyam tat āha bhṛguḥ mala māsa mṛtānām tu yat śrāddham prati vatsaram mala māse tu tat kāryam na anyeṣām tu kadācana iti dvirāṣāḍhaḥ api adhika māsa prabhedaḥ eva

original: tadāha mihiraḥ -- yo'yamukto dvirāṣāḍho nānyaḥ syādadhimāsataḥ| saṃjñābhedāt sa evokto vivektuṃ śayanaṃ hareḥ|| iti| tadevāha meṣādimithunāntetu yadā darśadvayaṃ bhavet| abdāntare tadāvaśyaṃ mithunārke hariḥ svapet|| karkaṭāditrike cāpi yadā darśadvayaṃ bhavet| abdāntare tadāvaśyaṃ karkaṭārke hariḥ svapet| ityādi|
analyzed: tat āha mihiraḥ dvirāṣāḍhaḥ na anyaḥ syāt adhimāsataḥ saṃjñā bhedāt saḥ eva uktaḥ vivektum śayanam hareḥ iti tat eva āha meṣa ādi mithuna ante tu yadā darśa dvayam bhavet abda antare tadā avaśyam mithuna arke hariḥ svapet karkaṭa ādi trike ca api yadā darśa dvayam bhavet abda antare tadā avaśyam karkaṭa arke hariḥ svapet ityādi

original: dvirāṣāḍhe śayanaikādaśīnirṇayaviṣaye vidyāraṇyaśrutau vṛddhamihiraḥ -- kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau yadā saṃkramate raviḥ| dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe|| iti| marīcirapi -- kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau meṣaṃ gaccheddivākaraḥ| dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śete karkaṭake raviḥ|| ityādi| iti malamāsanirṇayaḥ|
analyzed: dvis āṣāḍhe śayana ekādaśī nirṇaya viṣaye vidyāraṇyaśrutau vṛddhamihiraḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣe daśamī ādau yadā saṃkramate raviḥ dvis āṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe iti marīciḥ api kṛṣṇa pakṣe daśamī ādau meṣam gacchet divākaraḥ dvis āṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śete karkaṭake raviḥ ityādi iti mala māsa nirṇayaḥ

original: pakṣanirṇayaḥ atha pakṣanirṇayaḥ kriyate| candrasya pañcadaśakalānāmāpūraṇaṃ kṣayo vā yatra parigṛhyate sa pakṣa ityādi| tatra taittirīyakahotṛbrāhmaṇe -- prajāpatikāmayatetyārabhya tau pūrvapakṣaścāparapakṣaścābhavatāṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ devā anvasṛjyanta aparapakṣamasurāḥ| tato devā abhavan parāsurāḥ| yaṃ kāmayīta vasīyān syāditi|
analyzed: pakṣa nirṇayaḥ atha pakṣa nirṇayaḥ kriyate candrasya pañcadaśa kalānām āpūraṇam kṣayaḥ vā yatra parigṛhyate sa pakṣaḥ ityādi tatra taittirīyaka hotṛ brāhmaṇe prajāpati kāmayata iti ārabhya tau pūrvapakṣaḥ ca aparapakṣaḥ ca abhavatām pūrvapakṣam devāḥ anvasṛjyanta aparapakṣam asurāḥ tatas devāḥ abhavan para asurāḥ yam kāmayīta vasīyān syāt iti

original: taṃ pūrvapakṣe yājayet| yaṃ kāmayīta pāpīyān syāditi tamaparapakṣe yājayet| pāpīyāneva bhavati| tasmāt pūrvapakṣo'parapakṣāt kāruṇyataraḥ|| iti| vasīyān vasumattaraḥ| pāpīyān dravyahīnaḥ| kartṛṇāṃ śubhaphalaprāpakatvena karuṇāmāvahatīti kāruṇyataraḥ ityarthaḥ| tatra viniyogo vārāhe uktaḥ -- sa māsa iti loke'smin gīyate pakṣayugmavān|
analyzed: tam pūrvapakṣe yājayet yam kāmayīta pāpīyān syāt iti tam aparapakṣe yājayet pāpīyān eva bhavati tasmāt pūrvapakṣa uparapakṣāt kāruṇyataraḥ iti vasīyān vasumattaraḥ pāpīyān dravya hīnaḥ kartṛṇām śubha phala prāpaka tvena karuṇām āvahati iti kāruṇyataraḥ iti arthaḥ tatra viniyogaḥ vārāhe uktaḥ sa māsaḥ iti loke smin gīyate pakṣa yugmavān

original: vardhamānakalaḥ śuklaḥ kṣīyamāṇakalo'sitaḥ|| devāśca pitaraścāpītyārabhya `tadā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā niyamaṃ kṛtavānaham| tatra sāmānyataḥ śuklaṃ devebhyo dattavānaham|| pitṛbhyaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ ce'tyādinā tadupayogakathanāt| tathā -- śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāmityādāvupayogastatra tatrābhidhīyate|| iti pakṣanirṇayaḥ||
analyzed: vardhamāna kalaḥ śuklaḥ kṣīyamāṇa kalā usitaḥ devāḥ ca pitaraḥ ca api iti ārabhya tadā tad vacanam śrutvā niyamam kṛtavān aham tatra sāmānyatas śuklam devebhyaḥ dattavān aham pitṛbhyaḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣam ca ityādinā tad upayoga kathanāt tathā śukla pakṣe caturdaśyām ityādau upayogaḥ tatra tatra abhidhīyate iti pakṣa nirṇayaḥ

original: tithisvarūpam| atha tithisāmānyanirṇayaḥ| tithisvarūpamuktaṃ siddhāntaśiromaṇau -- tanyante kalayā yasmāt tasmāttāstithayaḥ smṛtāḥ| iti| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva skāndepyuktam -- amādipaurṇamāsyāntā yā eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ| tithayastāssamākhyātāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva varānane|| iti|
analyzed: tithi svarūpam atha tithi sāmānya nirṇayaḥ tithi svarūpam uktam siddhāntaśiromaṇau tanyante kalayā yasmāt tasmāt tāḥ tithayaḥ smṛtāḥ iti etad abhiprāyeṇa eva skānde api uktam ama ādi paurṇamāsyā antāḥ yāḥ eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ tithayaḥ tāḥ samākhyātāḥ ṣoḍaśā eva varānane iti

original: tathāca tanoti vardhamānāṃ kṣīyamāṇāṃ vā candrakalāmekāṃ yaḥ kālaviśeṣaḥ sā tithiḥ, yathoktakalayā vā tanyate iti tithiḥ, ityuktaṃ bhavati| nanu pratipadādayaḥ pañcadaśeti, kathaṃ ṣoḍaśeti cet| kṣayodayatvayo divasavyavahāropayoginyaḥ pañcadaśa| amā ṣoḍaśabhāgena devī proktā mahākalā| saṃsthikā paramā māyā dehināṃ dehadhāriṇām||
analyzed: tathā ca tanoti vardhamānām kṣīyamāṇām vā candra kalām ekām yaḥ kāla viśeṣaḥ sā tithiḥ yathā ukta kalayā vā tanyate iti tithiḥ iti uktam bhavati nanu pratipad ādayaḥ pañcadaśa iti katham ṣoḍaśa iti ced kṣaya udaya tvayaḥ divasa vyavahāra upayoginyaḥ pañcadaśa amāḥ ṣoḍaśa bhāgena devī proktā mahākalā saṃsthikā paramā māyā dehinām deha dhāriṇām

original: iti vacanena candramaṇḍalaṣoḍaśabhāgena parimitā tithisaṃjñikā māhākaleti procyate| tāmādāya ṣoḍaśetyaviruddhaṃ vacanam|tāsāṃ kalānāṃ madhye ekaikāṃ kalāṃ vahnyādayaḥ prajāpatyantāḥ pañcadaśa devatāḥ krameṇa pibanti| tatra vahnipeyā kalā prathamaṃ pīyate iti prathametyucyate| tayā yuktaḥ kālaviśeṣaḥ prāthamyavācinā pratipacchabdenābhidhīyate|
analyzed: iti vacanena candra maṇḍala ṣoḍaśa bhāgena parimitā tithi saṃjñikā māhākalā iti procyate tām ādāya ṣoḍaśa iti aviruddham vacanam tāsām kalānām madhye ekaikām kalām vahni ādayaḥ prajāpati antāḥ pañcadaśa devatāḥ krameṇa pibanti tatra vahni peyā kalā prathamam pīyate iti prathamā iti ucyate tayā yuktaḥ kāla viśeṣaḥ prāthamya vācinā pratipad śabdena abhidhīyate

original: evaṃ dvitīyādīnāṃ pañcadaśyantānāṃ tithīnāṃ nāmānyavagantavyāni| etāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣatithayo bhavanti| punaśca tāḥ pītāḥ kalāḥ tenaiva krameṇa bahnyādidevatābhyo nirgatya candramaṇḍalaṃ pūrayanti| tābhiryuktāḥ kālaviśeṣāḥśuklapakṣagatāḥ pratipadādyāstithayo bhavanti| tadutpattiprapañcastu somotpattau draṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: evam dvitīya ādīnām pañcadaśī antānām tithīnām nāmāni avagantavyāni etāḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣa tithayaḥ bhavanti punar ca tāḥ pītāḥ kalāḥ tena eva krameṇa bahni ādi devatābhyaḥ nirgatya candra maṇḍalam pūrayanti tābhiḥ yuktāḥ kāla viśeṣāḥ śukla pakṣa gatāḥ pratipad ādyāḥ tithayaḥ bhavanti tad utpatti prapañcaḥ tu soma utpattau draṣṭavyaḥ

original: nanu smṛtyantare -- `candrārkagatyā kālasya paricchedo yadā bhavet| tadā tayoḥ pravakṣyāmi gatimāśritya nirṇayami'tyādinā candrakalānāṃ sūryapraveśanirgamau pratipāditau| somotpattau tu vahnyādidevatāsvityato virodha iti ced, na| tatra kalānāṃ sūrye vā vahnyādidevatāsu vā praveśanirgamau syātān|
analyzed: nanu smṛti antare candra arka gatyā kālasya paricchedaḥ yadā bhavet tadā tayoḥ pravakṣyāmi gatim āśritya nirṇayam ityādinā candra kalānām sūrya praveśa nirgamau pratipāditau soma utpattau tu vahni ādi devatāsu iti atas virodhaḥ iti ced na tatra kalānām sūrye vā vahni ādi devatāsu vā praveśa nirgamau syātān

original: tathāpi kalāprayuktā eva pratipadādayastithaya ityatra na virodha iti| tatra sāmānyatastithistrividhā kharvā darpā hiṃstrāceti| kharvā samatithiḥ| darpā vṛddhiyuktā| hiṃstrā kṣayayuktā| trividhāpi tithirdvividhā sampūrṇā khaṇ‍ḍā ceti| tatra sampūrṇā skānde darśitā -- pratipatprabhṛtayaḥ sarvā udayādudayādraveḥ|
analyzed: tathā api kalā prayuktāḥ eva pratipad ādayaḥ tithayaḥ iti atra na virodhaḥ iti tatra sāmānyatas tithiḥ trividhā kharvā darpā hiṃstrā ca iti kharvā sama tithiḥ darpā vṛddhi yuktā hiṃstrā kṣaya yuktā trividhā api tithiḥ dvividhā sampūrṇā khaṇḍā ca iti tatra sampūrṇā skānde darśitā pratipad prabhṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ udayāt udayāt raveḥ

original: sampūrṇā iti vikhyātā harivāsaravarjitāḥ| iti| yā naivaṃvidhā sā khaṇḍā| tatra vidhiniṣedhayoḥ sampūrṇāyāṃ tithau sandehābhāvāt khaṇḍa tithau vidhiniṣedhaḥ kriyate|
analyzed: sampūrṇāḥ iti vikhyātāḥ hari vāsara varjitāḥ iti yā na evaṃvidhā sā khaṇḍā tatra vidhi niṣedhayoḥ sampūrṇāyām tithau sandeha abhāvāt khaṇḍa tithau vidhi niṣedhaḥ kriyate

original: tatra pratipadādipaurṇimāntāḥ khaṇḍatithayo nirṇīyante|| tatra pratipacchabda upakrame vartate| cāndraḥ pakṣo māso vā pratipadyate ārabhyate yasyāṃ tithau sā pratipat| sā ca yadā sūryodayamārabhya punarudayaparyantā bhavati tadā śuddhatvāt pratipadi vihitaṃ sarvaṃ niśśaṅkatayānuṣṭheyam|
analyzed: tatra pratipad ādi paurṇimā antāḥ khaṇḍa tithayaḥ nirṇīyante tatra pratipad śabdaḥ upakrame vartate cāndraḥ pakṣaḥ māsaḥ vā pratipadyate ārabhyate yasyām tithau sā pratipad sā ca yadā sūrya udayam ārabhya punar udaya paryantā bhavati tadā śuddha tvāt pratipadi vihitam sarvam niśśaṅka tayā anuṣṭheyam

original: śuddhatvaṃ ca nāradīye darśitam -- ādityodayavelāyāmārabhyāṣaṣṭināḍikam| yā tithiḥ sā tu śuddhā syātsarvatithyorhyayaṃ vidhiḥ|| iti| yadā sā tithiḥ pratipadādiḥ pūrvottaradinābhyāṃ darśādidvitīyādibhyāṃ yujyate tadā khaṇḍā|
analyzed: śuddha tvam ca nāradīye darśitam āditya udaya velāyām ārabhya ṣaṣṭi nāḍikam yā tithiḥ sā tu śuddhā syāt sarva tithyoḥ hi ayam vidhiḥ iti yadā sā tithiḥ pratipad ādiḥ pūrva uttara dinābhyām darśa ādi dvitīya ādibhyām yujyate tadā khaṇḍā

original: tatra kiṃ darśādiyuktāyāṃ pratipadādau pratipadādiprayuktavratopavāsādikaṃ sarvamanuṣṭheyam, uta dvitīyādiyuktapratipadādāviti sandehe nirṇayaḥ kriyate| tatrāmāyuktapratipadyeva vratopavāsādikaṃ kāryam| yugmavākyāt| yugmavākyaṃ ca nigame -- yugmāgniyugabhūtānāṃ ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ| rudreṇa dvādaśī yuktā caturdaśyā tu pūrṇimā||

original: atraivaṃ vivekaḥ śuklapakṣe pūrvaviddhā grāhyā, kṛṣṇe paraviddhetyeva sāmānyataḥ| kvacidanyathā| viśeṣastu vacanaviśeṣādavagantavyaḥ| kṛṣṇapakṣe'ṣṭamī caiva kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī| pūrvaviddhā prakartavyā paraviddhā na kutracit|| iti vacanāt| vedhasvarūpaṃ paiṭhīnasinoktam -- pakṣadvaye'pi tithayastithiṃ pūrvāṃ tathottarām|
analyzed: atra evam vivekaḥ śukla pakṣe pūrva viddhā grāhyā kṛṣṇe paraviddhā iti eva sāmānyatas kvacid anyathā viśeṣaḥ tu vacana viśeṣāt avagantavyaḥ kṛṣṇa pakṣeḥ ṭamī ca eva kṛṣṇa pakṣe caturdaśī pūrva viddhā prakartavyā paraviddhā na kutracid iti vacanāt vedha svarūpam paiṭhīnasinā uktam pakṣa dvaye pi tithayaḥ tithim pūrvām tathā uttarām

original: tribhirmuhūrtairvidhyanti sāmānyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ|| iti| hemādrau tu dvimuhūrto'pyuktaḥ -- udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cāstamite ravau| dvimuhūrtā trirahnaśca sā tithirhavyakavyayoḥ|| iti| dvimuhūrtatvaṃ cānukalpaḥ| dvimuhūrtāpi kartavyā yā tithirvṛddhigāminī'ti dakṣokteḥ| ayaṃ vedhaḥ prātareva|
analyzed: tribhiḥ muhūrtaiḥ vidhyanti sāmānyaḥ ayam vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ iti hemādrau tu dvi muhūrtaḥ api uktaḥ udite daivatam bhānau pitryam ca astamite ravau dvi muhūrtā tris ahnaḥ ca sā tithiḥ havya kavyayoḥ iti dvi muhūrta tvam ca anukalpaḥ dvi muhūrtā api kartavyā yā tithiḥ vṛddhi gāminī iti dakṣa ukteḥ ayam vedhaḥ prātar eva

original: sāyaṃ tu trimuhūrtavedha eva|' yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya yātyastaṃ padminīpatiḥ| sā tithistaddine proktātrimuhūrtaiva yā bhavet||' iti skāndokteḥ| yāni tu -- `vratopavāsasnānādau ghaṭikaikāpi yā bhavat| udaye sā tithirgrāhyā viparītā tu paitṛke||' ityādīni skāndavacanāni, tāni svāvayavaghaṭikādistutidvarā trimuhūrtapraśaṃsāparāṇi||
analyzed: sāyam tu tri muhūrta vedhaḥ eva yām tithim samanuprāpya yāti astam padminīpatiḥ sā tithiḥ tad dine proktā tri muhūrtā eva yā bhavet iti skānda ukteḥ yāni tu vrata upavāsa snāna ādau ghaṭikā ekā api yā bhavat udaye sā tithiḥ grāhyā viparītā tu paitṛke ityādīni skānda vacanāni tāni sva avayava ghaṭikā ādi stuti dvarā tri muhūrta praśaṃsā parāṇi

original: ata eva bodhāyanaḥ -- udayasthā tithiryā hi trimuhūrtā tu sā tithiḥ| vratakarmaṇi śastā tu snānadānajapādiṣu|| iti| evaṃ trimuhūrtaprādhānyapratipādakāni vacanāni bahūni santi, tāni granthavistarabhayānna likhyante| atra trimuhūrtādikālamanādṛtya karmakālavyāpinyāṃ prayogaparyāptāyāṃ vratādyanuṣṭheyam|
analyzed: atas eva bodhāyanaḥ udaya sthā tithiḥ yā hi tri muhūrtā tu sā tithiḥ vrata karmaṇi śastā tu snāna dāna japa ādiṣu iti evam tri muhūrta prādhānya pratipādakāni vacanāni bahūni santi tāni grantha vistara bhayāt na likhyante atra tri muhūrta ādi kālam an ādṛtya karma kāla vyāpinyām prayoga paryāptāyām vrata ādi anuṣṭheyam

original: taduktaṃ vyāsena -- trimuhūrtātmake kāle dānaṃ dātuṃ na śakyate| grāhyā prayogaparyāptā sarvadāneṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ| iti| tathā viṣṇudharmottare -- karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālastatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ| tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam|| iti| etadasambhave trimuhūrtapakṣaḥ| yattu `kharvo darpastathā hiṃstrastrividhaṃ tithilakṣaṇam|
analyzed: tat uktam vyāsena tri muhūrta ātmake kāle dānam dātum na śakyate grāhyā prayoga paryāptā sarva dāneṣu ayam vidhiḥ iti tathā viṣṇudharmottare karmaṇaḥ yasya yaḥ kālaḥ tad kāla vyāpinī tithiḥ tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsa vṛddhī na kāraṇam iti etat asambhave tri muhūrta pakṣaḥ yat tu kharvaḥ darpaḥ tathā hiṃstraḥ trividham tithi lakṣaṇam

original: kharvadarpau parau pūjyau histrā syāt pūrvakālikī||' iti vyāghravacanam, tattu ekoddiṣṭādiśrāddhaviṣayam| `pratyābdikādiśrāddhādau vṛddhihrāsādicodane'tyādinigamokteḥ| yattu smṛtyantaraṃ -- madhyāhnavyāpinī yā syāt tithiḥ pūrvā parāpi vā| tatra karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam|| iti, tadekabhuktaviṣayam ekoddiṣṭaviṣayaṃ ca|
analyzed: kharva darpau parau pūjyau histrā syāt pūrvakālikī iti vyāghra vacanam tat tu ekoddiṣṭa ādi śrāddha viṣayam pratyābdika ādi śrāddha ādau vṛddhi hrāsa ādi codanā ityādi nigama ukteḥ yat tu smṛti antaram madhyāhna vyāpinī yā syāt tithiḥ pūrvā parā api vā tatra karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsa vṛddhī na kāraṇam iti tat eka bhukta viṣayam ekoddiṣṭa viṣayam ca

original: atra karmakālavyāptyabhāve tu karmopakramakālavyāptaiva grāhyā| `karmopakramakālagā nanu tathirgrāhyā na yugmādayaḥ (raḥ)' iti dīpikokteḥ| yāni tu -- yāṃtithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ| sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu|| ityādīni, tāni vacanāni trimuhūrtādistutiparāṇi|
analyzed: atra karma kāla vyāpti abhāve tu karma upakrama kāla vyāptā eva grāhyā karma upakrama kāla gā nanu tathiḥ grāhyā na yugma ādayaḥ iti dīpikā ukteḥ yāni tu yām tithim samanuprāpya udayam yāti bhāskaraḥ sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dāna adhyayana karmasu ityādīni tāni vacanāni tri muhūrta ādi stuti parāṇi

original: atra pūrvaviddhāyāṃ trimuhūrtādhikāyāṃ karmakālavyāpinyāṃ vā yo'yamupavāsadānādirvihitastatra pūrvatithau vā karmatithau vā saṅkalpasnānādikaṃ kāryamiti sandehe dakṣaḥ -- prātaḥ saṅkalpayodvidvānupavāsavratādikam| tattithau karma kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam|| iti| skānde'pi -- prātarārabhya matimān kuryānnaktavratādikam|
analyzed: atra pūrva viddhāyām tri muhūrta adhikāyām karma kāla vyāpinyām vā yaḥ yam upavāsa dāna ādiḥ vihitaḥ tatra pūrva tithau vā karma tithau vā saṅkalpa snāna ādikam kāryam iti sandehe dakṣaḥ prātar tad tithau karma kurvīta hrāsa vṛddhī na kāraṇam iti skānde api prātar ārabhya matimān kuryāt naktavrata ādikam

original: nāparāhṇe na madhyāhne pitryakālau hi tau smṛtau|| iti| evamādivacanabalāt prātareva saṅkalpaḥ kāryaḥ| yadyapi `ye yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇastadupakrame| vidyamāno bhavedaṅgaṃ nojjhitopakrameṇa ca||' iti vacanena saṅkalpakāle'vaśyaṃ pratipadā bhāvyam. tathāpi tadānīṃ jyotiśśāstraprasiddhapratipadabhāve'pi smṛtiṣūpapāditāyāḥ pratipadaḥ sattvāt|
analyzed: na aparāhṇe na madhyāhne pitrya kālau hi tau smṛtau iti evamādi vacana balāt prātar eva saṅkalpaḥ kāryaḥ yadi api ye yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇaḥ tad upakrame vidyamānaḥ bhavet aṅgam na ujjhita upakrameṇa ca iti vacanena saṅkalpa kāla ivaśyam pratipadā bhāvyam tathā api tadānīm jyotiḥśāstra prasiddha pratipad abhāve pi smṛtiṣu upapāditāyāḥ pratipadaḥ sattvāt

original: ata eva devalaḥ -- yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ| sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu|| iti| atra pūrvaviddhāyāṃ pratipadi balyutsavaḥ kāryaḥ| `śrāvaṇī durganavamī tathā durgāṣṭamī ca yā pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā śivarātrirbalerdinam||' ityādismṛteḥ| sa cotsavo brahmapurāṇe vāmanapurāṇe bhaviṣyottarapurāṇe cābhihitaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva devalaḥ yām tithim samanuprāpya astam yāti divākaraḥ sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dāna adhyayana karmasu iti atra pūrva viddhāyām pratipadi bali utsavaḥ kāryaḥ śrāvaṇī durga navamī tathā durgā aṣṭamī ca yā pūrva viddhā tu kartavyā śivarātriḥ baleḥ dinam ityādi smṛteḥ sa ca utsavaḥ brahmapurāṇe vāmanapurāṇe bhaviṣyottara purāṇe ca abhihitaḥ

original: tathā varāhapurāṇe tatra kartavyaviśeṣo'bhihitaḥ -- pratipadyapi tailena tataḥ snāyād‌balerdine| pūrva baliḥ svargarājyamāptavān kṛpayā mama|| varaṃ tu dattavānasmai yo naraḥ pratipaddine| harṣeṇa vātha roṣeṇa duḥkhenātha sukhena vā|| yukto'vatiṣṭhate tadvat prāyo varṣaṃ kramedasau| atastatra prakurvīta viśeṣānmaṅgalodayam||
analyzed: tathā varāhapurāṇe tatra kartavya viśeṣaḥ abhihitaḥ pratipadi api tailena tatas snāyāt baleḥ dine baliḥ svarga rājyam āptavān kṛpayā mama varam tu dattavān asmai yaḥ naraḥ pratipad dine harṣeṇa vā atha roṣeṇa duḥkhena atha sukhena vā yuktaḥ uvatiṣṭhate tadvat prāyas varṣam kramet asau atas tatra prakurvīta viśeṣāt maṅgala udayam

original: brāhmaṇebhyastathā dānaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam| vastrāṇyaśvān gajān gāśca rathān divyaparicchadān|| brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyācca vividhāni dhanāni ca| yathā yathotsavaṃ tasyāṃ kuryādbhaktyā narottamaḥ|| tathā tathā bhavettasya hyutsave janmajanmani|| iti| pratipadi viśeṣaḥ -- `pratipattu site pakṣe darśaviddhā śubhā smṛtā||
analyzed: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ tathā dānam mahā puṇya phala pradam vastrāṇi aśvān gajān gāḥ ca rathān divya paricchadān brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradadyāt ca vividhāni dhanāni ca yathā yathā utsavam tasyām kuryāt bhaktyā nara uttamaḥ tathā tathā bhavet tasya hi utsave janma janmani iti pratipadi viśeṣaḥ pratipad tu site pakṣe darśa viddhā śubhā smṛtā

original: kṛṣṇe dvitīyayā viddhā trimuhūrtā bhavedyadi||' iti| jyotiḥkāśyapo'pi pratipacchuklapakṣe tu pūrvaviddhā śubhāvahā| kṛṣṇapakṣe śubhā jñeyā saṅgavasparśinī bhavet|| ityādi| balyutsave'pi viśeṣo'bhihito matsyapurāṇe -- samprāpte kārtike māsi sitā yā pratipadbhavet| balyutsavastu kartavyaḥ sammukhā yā tithirbhavet||
analyzed: kṛṣṇe dvitīyayā viddhā tri muhūrtā bhavet yadi iti jyotiḥkāśyapaḥ pi pratipad śukla pakṣe tu pūrva viddhā śubha āvahā kṛṣṇa pakṣe śubhā jñeyā saṅgava sparśinī bhavet ityādi bali utsave pi viśeṣaḥ abhihitaḥ matsyapurāṇe samprāpte kārtike māsi sitā yā pratipad bhavet bali utsavaḥ tu kartavyaḥ sammukhā yā tithiḥ bhavet

original: pratipatsammukhā kāryā śuklapakṣasya kārtike|| sammukhā sāyāhnavyāpinī| gargaḥ -- balyutsavaṃ ca pūrvedyustrisuhūrtā yadā bhavet| vṛddhagargaḥ -- mukhāyāḥ pūrvaviddhāyāḥ pratipadyadyasambhave| balyutsavastu kartavyo dyūtādīnyuttare'hani|| saṅgave pūrvaviddhe vā niṣiddhā parasammitā|| ityādi| evaṃ vatsarādipratipadādāvapi bodhyam|

original: ekabhuktakālanirṇayaḥ| athaikabhuktakālanirṇayaḥ| tatraikabhuktaṃ trividhaṃ svatantramanyāṅgamupavāsapratinidhirūpaṃ ceti| tatra svatantraikabhuktaviṣaye devalaḥ -- dinārdhasamaye'tīte bhujyate niyamena yat| ekabhuktamiti proktaṃ nyūnaṃ grāsatrayeṇa tu|| iti| skānde'pi -- dinārdhasamaye'tīte bhujyate niyamena yat|
analyzed: eka bhukta kāla nirṇayaḥ atha eka bhukta kāla nirṇayaḥ tatra eka bhuktam trividham svatantram anya aṅgam upavāsa pratinidhi rūpam ca iti tatra svatantra eka bhukta viṣaye devalaḥ dina ardha samaya itīte bhujyate niyamena yat eka bhuktam iti proktam nyūnam grāsa trayeṇa tu iti skānde api dina ardha samaya itīte bhujyate niyamena yat

original: ekabhuktamiti proktamatastat syāddivaiva hi|| iti| atra dinārdhasyopari sārdhamuhūrtaḥ kāla ekabhuktasya mukhyakāla ityāhuḥ| apare tu pañcadhā vibhaktasyāhno'parabhāgo mukhyakāla iti| hemādrau tu tredhāvibhaktasyāhno madhyabhāgo madhyāhna ityuktam| atrāhnastridhā dvedhā vibhāgāpekṣayāpañcadhāvibhāgasya mukhyatvāt sa evāśrayaṇīyaḥ|
analyzed: eka bhuktam iti proktam atas tat syāt divā eva hi iti atra dina ardhasya upari sārdha muhūrtaḥ kālaḥ eka bhuktasya mukhya kālaḥ iti āhuḥ apare tu pañcadhā vibhaktasya ahnā upara bhāgaḥ mukhya kālaḥ iti hemādrau tu tredhā vibhaktasya ahnaḥ madhyabhāgaḥ madhyāhnaḥ iti uktam atra ahnaḥ tridhā dvedhā vibhāga apekṣayā a pañcadhā vibhāgasya mukhya tvāt saḥ eva āśrayaṇīyaḥ

original: atrāhno vibhāgavibhedāḥ śātātapagobhilaśaṅkhaprabhṛtivacanaiḥ pravartitāḥ| tatra dvedhā vibhāgaḥ skānde -- `āvartanāttu pūrvāhṇa aparāhṇastataḥ para' iti| tadevābhipretya manurāha -- yadā caivāparaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvapakṣāg viśiṣyate| tadā śrāddhasya pūrvāhṇādaparāhṇe viśiṣyate|| iti|
analyzed: atra ahnaḥ vibhāga vibhedāḥ śātātapa gobhila śaṅkha prabhṛti vacanaiḥ pravartitāḥ tatra dvedhā vibhāgaḥ skānde āvartanāt tu pūrvāhṇa aparāhṇaḥ tatas paraḥ iti tat eva abhipretya manuḥ āha yadā ca eva aparaḥ pakṣaḥ viśiṣyate tadā śrāddhasya pūrvāhṇāt aparāhṇe viśiṣyate iti

original: tridhā vibhāgo'pi skāndapurāṇe darśitaḥ -- ūrdhvaṃ sūryodayāt proktaṃ muhūrtānāṃ tu pañcakam| pūrvāhṇaḥ pañcakaṃ prokto madhyāhnastu tataḥ param|| aparāhṇastataḥ prokto muhūrtānāṃ tu pañcakam|| iti| gobhilaścāturdhā vibhāgamāha -- pūrvāhnaḥ praharaścādyo madhyāhnaḥ praharastataḥ| tṛtīyamaparāhṇaḥ syāt sāyāhnaḥ syāt tataḥ param|| iti|
analyzed: tridhā vibhāgaḥ upi skāndapurāṇe darśitaḥ ūrdhvam sūrya udayāt proktam muhūrtānām tu pañcakam pūrvāhṇaḥ pañcakam proktaḥ madhyāhnaḥ tu tatas param aparāhṇaḥ tatas proktaḥ muhūrtānām tu pañcakam iti gobhilaḥ cāturdhā vibhāgam āha pūrvāhnaḥ praharaḥ ca ādyaḥ madhyāhnaḥ praharaḥ tatas tṛtīyam aparāhṇaḥ syāt sāyāhnaḥ syāt tatas param iti

original: pañcadhā vibhāgaṃ vyāsaḥ -- muhūrtatritayaṃ prātastāvāneva tu saṅgavaḥ| madhyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syādaparāhṇaśca tādṛśaḥ|| sāyāhnastrimuhūrtastu sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ|| iti| pañcadaśadhā vibhāgaḥ śaṅkena darśitaḥ -- raudraścaitraśca maitraśca tathaivārabhaṭastathā|| sāvitraśca jayantaśca gāndharvaḥ kutapastathā||
analyzed: pañcadhā vibhāgam vyāsaḥ muhūrta tritayam prātar tāvān eva tu saṅgavaḥ madhyāhnaḥ tri muhūrtaḥ syāt aparāhṇaḥ ca tādṛśaḥ sāyāhnaḥ tri muhūrtaḥ tu sarva karma bahiṣkṛtaḥ iti pañcadaśadhā vibhāgaḥ śaṅkena darśitaḥ raudraḥ caitraḥ ca maitraḥ ca tathā eva ārabhaṭaḥ tathā sāvitraḥ ca jayantaḥ ca gāndharvaḥ kutapaḥ tathā

original: rauhiṇaśca viriñcaśca vijayo nairṛtastathā| māhendro vāruṇaścaiva dhṛtaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ|| iti| eteṣu sakalaśrautasmārtopayogitayā pañcadhā vibhāgo mukhyaḥ| ataḥ pañcadhā vibhakta (dinatṛtīyāṃśa)madhyāhnasyāparabhāga ekabhuktamukhyakālaḥ| dinārdhe'tīte sati samanantarabhāvitvāt| astamayāt prācīnaḥ kālo gauṇaḥ| divaivetyabhyanujñānāt|
analyzed: rauhiṇaḥ ca viriñcaḥ ca vijayaḥ nairṛtaḥ tathā māhendraḥ vāruṇaḥ ca eva dhṛtaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ iti eteṣu sakala śrauta smārta upayogi tayā pañcadhā vibhāgaḥ mukhyaḥ atas pañcadhā vibhakta dina tṛtīya aṃśa madhyāhnasya apara bhāgaḥ eka bhukta mukhya kālaḥ dina ardha itīte sati samanantara bhāvi tvāt astamayāt prācīnaḥ kālaḥ gauṇaḥ divā eva iti abhyanujñānāt

original: evaṃ vyavasthite sati mukhyakālavyāpinī tithirgrāhyā| ata eva padmapurāṇam -- madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā ekabhukte sadā tithiriti| bodhayano'pi -- udaye tūpavāsasya naktasyāstamaye tithiḥ| madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā ekabhuktavrate tithiḥ|| iti| madhyāhnavyāpinītyatra nirṇetavyo'rthaḥ ṣoḍhā|
analyzed: evam vyavasthite sati mukhya kāla vyāpinī tithiḥ grāhyā atas eva padmapurāṇam madhyāhna vyāpinī grāhyā eka bhukte sadā tithiḥ iti bodhayanā upi udaye tu upavāsasya naktasya astamaye tithiḥ madhyāhna vyāpinī grāhyā eka bhukta vrate tithiḥ iti madhyāhna vyāpinī iti atra nirṇetavyaḥ ṛthaḥ ṣoḍhā

original: pūrvedyureva madhyāhnavyāptiḥ, paredyureva tad‌vyāptiḥ, ubhayatra tad‌vyāptiḥ, ubhayatra sāmyena tadekadeśavyāptiḥ, ubhayatra vaiṣamyeṇa tadekadeśavyāptiriti| tatra prathamadvitīyayormadhyāhnavyāpitvasyaiva nirṇāyakatvam| tṛtīye tu pūrvaviddhā grāhyā, mukhyakālavyāpteḥ samatve'pi gauṇakālavyāpteradhikatvāt|

original: yadātu paredyurmadhyāhnaikadeśamadhikaṃ vyāpnoti, tadā gauṇakālavyāptyabhāve'pi mukhyakālavyāptyādhikyāt paredyureva grāhyeti| iti svatantraikabhuktanirṇayaḥ||
